jobs.title: Senior Operator/Biotechnologist Ibex® m/f/d
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

Ibex® Solutions (www.ibex.lonza.com) is a modular build complex to develop and manufacture biological products. It enables companies to get access to a complete solution, gaining speed and achieving a simplified value chain.
The Ibex® Complex is our contribution to the medicine of tomorrow and possibly the next step in your career?

At our location in Visp, in the canton of Valais, we are constantly looking for Biotechnologists with a relevant background at all levels in Life Sciences in order to support our growth in several business units.

Key responsibilities:

• Assignment in various functions within the production facilities in compliance with safety regulations and consideration of cGMP quality requirements.

• Recognition, interpretation and elimination of deviations

• Execution of production steps incl. recording and calculations

• Support in training of new team members

Key requirements:

• Completed chemical / biopharmaceutical education

• Professional experience in pharmaceutical production as an operator/production technician etc

• Safety-conscious work

• Knowledge of process engineering

• Fluent English

• German language skills advantageous

• Willingness to work in shifts (e.g. 4-shift pattern) with flexible work scheduling

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in tre continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte. Ibex® Solutions (www.ibex.lonza.com) è un complesso modulare per lo sviluppo e la produzione di prodotti biologici. Consente alle aziende di accedere a una soluzione completa, di ottenere velocità e di raggiungere una catena di valori semplificata. Il complesso Ibex® è il nostro contributo alla medicina di domani e forse il prossimo passo nella tua carriera? Nella nostra posizione a Visp, nel cantone del Vallese, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di biotecnologi con un background rilevante a tutti i livelli in Scienze della Vita per sostenere la nostra crescita in diverse unità aziendali. Responsabilità chiave:
• Assegnazione in varie funzioni all'interno degli impianti di produzione in conformità alle normative di sicurezza e alla considerazione dei requisiti di qualità cGMP.
• Riconoscimento, interpretazione e eliminazione delle deviazioni
• Esecuzione delle fasi di produzione, comprese le registrazioni e i calcoli
• Supporto per la formazione di nuovi membri del team Requisiti chiave:
• Formazione chimica completa / biofarmaceutica
• Esperienza professionale nella produzione farmaceutica come operatore / tecnico di produzione ecc
• Lavoro sicuro
• Conoscenza dell'ingegneria dei processi
• Inglese fluido
• competenze linguistiche tedesche vantaggiose
• Volontà di lavoro a turni (ad esempio modello a 4 turni) con programmazione flessibile del lavoro Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente. La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Heute ist Lonza ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biowissenschaften, der auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Während wir in der Wissenschaft arbeiten, gibt es keine magische Formel, wie wir es tun. Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Menschen, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen. Ibex® Solutions (www.ibex.lonza.com) ist ein modularer Baukomplex zur Entwicklung und Herstellung biologischer Produkte. Es ermöglicht Unternehmen den Zugang zu einer Komplettlösung, gewinnt an Geschwindigkeit und erreicht eine vereinfachte Wertschöpfungskette. Der Ibex® Komplex ist unser Beitrag zur Medizin von morgen und möglicherweise der nächste Schritt in Ihrer Karriere? An unserem Standort in Visp, im Wallis, sind wir ständig auf der Suche nach Biotechnologen mit einem relevanten Hintergrund auf allen Ebenen der Life Sciences, um unser Wachstum in mehreren Geschäftsbereichen zu unterstützen. Hauptzuständigkeiten:
• Zuweisung in verschiedenen Funktionen innerhalb der Produktionsanlagen unter Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften und unter Berücksichtigung der cGMP-Qualitätsanforderungen.
• Anerkennung, Interpretation und Beseitigung von Abweichungen
• Durchführung von Produktionsschritten inkl. Aufzeichnung und Berechnungen
• Unterstützung bei der Schulung neuer Teammitglieder Hauptanforderungen:
• Abgeschlossene chemische / biopharmazeutische Ausbildung
• Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion als Bediener/Produktionstechniker etc.
• Sicherheitsbewusstes Arbeiten
• Kenntnisse der Verfahrenstechnik
• fließendes Englisch
• Deutschkenntnisse vorteilhaft
• Bereitschaft, in Schichten zu arbeiten (z. B. 4-Schicht-Muster) mit flexibler Arbeitsplanung Die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns ist das nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird. Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um die Herausforderung und Kreativität zu meistern, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem sinnvollen Unterschied einhergeht. Lonza ist weltweit führend in der Pharma- und Biotech-Fertigung. Das Unternehmen betreibt große Produktionsstätten in Visp (Valais), Basel, und Stein (Aargau), Schweiz.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie sur trois continents. Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des gens talentueux, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie. Ibex® Solutions (www.ibex.lonza.com) est un complexe modulaire de fabrication de produits biologiques. Il permet aux entreprises d'accéder à une solution complète, de gagner en vitesse et de réaliser une chaîne de valeur simplifiée. Le Complexe Ibex® est notre contribution à la médecine de demain et peut-être la prochaine étape de votre carrière? Sur notre site à Viège, dans le canton du Valais, nous recherchons en permanence des biotechnologues ayant une formation pertinente à tous les niveaux en Sciences de la Vie afin de soutenir notre croissance dans plusieurs unités commerciales. Principales responsabilités :
• Attribution de diverses fonctions dans les installations de production conformément aux règles de sécurité et à la prise en compte des exigences de qualité des BPFc.
• Reconnaissance, interprétation et élimination des écarts
• Exécution des étapes de production incluant enregistrement et calculs
• Soutien à la formation des nouveaux membres de l'équipe Principales exigences:
• Formation chimique / biopharmaceutique terminée
• Expérience professionnelle dans la production pharmaceutique en tant qu'opérateur/technicien de production, etc.
• Travail soucieux de la sécurité
• Connaissance de l'ingénierie des procédés
• Anglais couramment
• Compétences linguistiques allemandes avantageuses
• Volonté de travailler par équipes (par exemple, 4 postes) avec un horaire de travail flexible Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès sinon un succès éthique. Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative. Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.title: BIO Operator P1P2 4 Schicht (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Am Standort Visp suchen wir einen BIO Operator (m/w/d):

Aufgaben:

• Selbstständiges Fahren der ihm vertrauten Teile der Produktionsanlage gemäss Vorgabedokumenten (Herstellungsprotokolle/ Bedienungsanleitungen / Arbeitsanweisungen / SOP)

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung  vorausgesetzt

• Chemische oder pharmatechnologische Ausbildung sowie GMP und / oder BICO Ausbildung von Vorteil

• Akkurate Arbeits- und Dokumentationsweise

• Ausführung der Arbeiten mit hohem Sicherheits- und Qualitätsbewusstsein

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

• Completare i lavori di monitoraggio, manutenzione e pulizia, nonché segnalare e correggere i difetti e i difetti dell'impianto, compresa la loro documentazione

• Independent driving of the parts of the production plant familiar to him in accordance with specifications (production protocols/operating instructions/work instructions/SOP)
• Safe and correct work execution in compliance with safety regulations taking into account the cGMP quality requirements
• Responsibility for cleanliness and order in the workplace and the assigned rooms and warehouses
• Completing monitoring, maintenance and cleaning work as well as reporting and correcting defects and faults in the plant, including their documentation

• Vocational training completed subject to:
• Chemical or pharmatechnological training as well as GMP and/or BICO training beneficial
• Good knowledge of German in words, writing and understanding
• Accurate working and documentation methods
• Execution of work with high safety and quality awareness

jobs.description:
This position is located in Stein, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

For our successful and growing Drug Product focused branch located in Basel and Stein, Switzerland, we have exciting opportunities. Become part of a group that enables its customers to meet some of the greatest challenges in patient treatment and join us by applying for the Global MSAT DP Qualification & Validation Lead position.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Stein: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

What you will do:

• Lead global process control strategy for drug product manufacturing

• Own global strategies for equipment qualification (PQ), process validation (PPQ), and continued process verification (CPV)

• Define and govern global SOPs, standards, templates, and tools aligned with regulations and best practice

• Own qualification strategy for key unit operations: thawing, compounding, filling, lyophilization, and crimping

• Guide Tech Transfer and local MSAT teams on validation strategies, scale‑up, and sampling plans

• Review and approve validation documentation; analyze production data using appropriate statistical methods

• Act as subject‑matter expert during health authority inspections on validation and CPV/OPV

What we are looking for:

• Ph.D. in pharmaceutical sciences, engineering, biochemistry, or related field; or equivalent experience

• Expertise in equipment qualification for aseptic drug product manufacturing

• Extensive experience in process validation for sterile biologics, including lyophilized and liquid formats

• Proven experience with regulatory submissions and pre‑approval inspections

• Strong statistical skills for qualification, validation, and CPV; Data Science certification or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt preferred

• Knowledge of risk assessment, deviation management, change control, and root cause analysis

• Excellent English communication, documentation, leadership, and cross‑functional collaboration skills

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

titleByLocale.it: Ingegnere dei Bioprocessi in USP / DSP / BioConiugati
titleByLocale.en: Bioprocess Engineer in USP / DSP / BioConjugates

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

As the global manufacturing partner for many different customers, we are increasing manufacturing capacity. As other businesses face increasing economic uncertainty, we are fortunate to have opportunities for expansion. Through this new collaboration, our work will have a significant, direct and long-term impact on the management of this global pandemic.
In order to support our continued growth Lonza is seeking Bioprocess Engineers with a relevant background in Life Sciences and a passion for Biotechnology to join our talent community in Visp, Switzerland. Become part of this great opportunity and join our team by applying for the position as Bioprocess Engineer in Upstream Processing or Downstream Processing or BioConjugate Manufacturing.

Key responsibilities:

• Ensure that operational activities for clinical and/or commercial manufacturing are performed on-time and within given safety and quality standards

• Act as the functional lead for preparation, manufacturing execution, cleaning and changeover in the assigned area

• Lead of one or more defined USP areas (e.g. seed train, main cultivation or harvest) for the production of therapeutic proteins with either mammalian or microbial expressions systems (Bioprocess Engineer USP)

• In charge of one or more defined DSP areas (e.g. gain, polishing or filling) for the purification of therapeutic proteins from either mammalian or microbial cells (Bioprocess Engineer DSP)

• Responsible for entire processes or process units for clinical and commercial manufacturing projects in therapeutic BioConjugates like Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADC) (Bioprocess Engineer BioConjugates)

Key requirements:

• Master’s Degree or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry or related Life Science subject, or Bachelor’s holder with experience in pharma production

• Knowledge in either USP (such as bioreactors) or DSP units (such as chromatography)

• Working experience in biomanufacturing would be an advantage

• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology

• Excellent communication skills in English, good German skills of advantage

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:

La nostra soluzione scientifica più grande è dedicata persone che lavorano insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possiede la loro carriera. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, veramente migliorare il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo fare.

Come partner mondiale per molti clienti, stiamo aumentando la capacità produttiva. Poiché altre aziende devono affrontare un'incertezza economica crescente, siamo fortunati ad avere opportunità di espansione. Attraverso questa nuova collaborazione, il nostro lavoro avrà un impatto significativo, diretto e a lungo termine sulla gestione di questa pandemia globale. Al fine di sostenere la nostra crescita continua Lonza sta cercando ingegneri Bioprocess con un background rilevante in Scienze della Vita e una passione per la biotecnologia per entrare nella nostra comunità di talenti a Visp, Svizzera.

Diventate parte di questa grande opportunità e unitevi al nostro team facendo domanda per la posizione di ingegnere Bioprocess in Upstream Processing o Downstream Processing o BioConjugate Manufacturing.

Responsabilità - Garantire che le attività operative per la produzione clinica e/o commerciale siano svolte in tempo e nei limiti di determinati standard di sicurezza e qualità - Leggere come lead funzionale per la preparazione, l'esecuzione della fabbricazione, la pulizia e il passaggio all'area assegnata - Lead di una o più aree USP definite (ad esempio treno di sementi, coltivazione principale o raccolta) per la produzione di proteine terapeutiche con sistemi di espressione mammiferi o microbici (Ingegnere di bioprocesso USP) - Responsabile di una o più aree DSP definite (ad esempio:

guadagno, lucidatura o riempimento) per la purificazione delle proteine terapeutiche da cellule di mammiferi o microbiche (Bioprocess Engineer DSP) - Responsabile di interi processi o unità di processo per progetti di produzione clinica e commerciale in BioConjugates terapeutiche come Conjugates Anticorpi Drug (ADC) (Bioprocess Engineer BioConjugates)

Requisiti - Master.s Laurea o esperienza equivalente in Biotecnologie, Ingegneria Biochimica, Biochimica o materia relativa Life Science, o Bachelor.s titolare con esperienza nella produzione farmaceutica - Conoscenza in unità USP (come bioreattori) o DSP (come cromatografia) - L'esperienza di lavoro in bioproduzione sarebbe un vantaggio - esperienza GMP e comprensione della tecnologia dei processi biologici - Ottime competenze di comunicazione in inglese, buone competenze tedesche di vantaggio

Ciò che offriamo Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi Lonza.s hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungiamo i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante come i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo che raggiungiamo non è un successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con il miglioramento delle vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è leader mondiale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti impianti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea, e Stein (Argovia), Svizzera.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.
At our location in Visp, in the canton of Valais, we are constantly looking for Biotechnologists with a relevant background at all levels in Life Sciences in order to support our growth in several business units!

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

What you’ll do:

• Assignment in various functions within the production facilities in compliance with safety regulations and consideration of cGMP quality requirements.

• Recognition, interpretation and elimination of deviations

• Execution of production steps incl. recording and calculations

• Support in training of new team members

What we’re looking for:

• Completed chemical / biopharmaceutical education

• Professional experience in pharmaceutical production as an operator/production technician etc

• Safety-conscious work

• Knowledge of process engineering

• Fluent English with German language skills advantageous

• Willingness to work in shifts (e.g. 4-shift pattern) with flexible work scheduling

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Heute ist Lonza ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Life Sciences auf fünf Kontinenten. Während wir in der Wissenschaft arbeiten, gibt es keine magische Formel, wie wir es tun. Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung ist engagierte Menschen, die zusammen arbeiten, Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Austausch, wir lassen unsere Leute ihre Karriere. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, wirklich verbessern die Welt. Und das, die Art von Arbeit, die wir wollen, um Teil zu sein.

An unserem Standort in Visp im Kanton Wallis suchen wir ständig Biotechnologen mit relevantem Hintergrund auf allen Ebenen in den Life Sciences, um unser Wachstum in mehreren Geschäftsbereichen zu unterstützen!

Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie opérant sur cinq continents. Chaque jour, Lonza, ses produits et services ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. Du trägst massgebend zur laufenden Optimierung von Prozessen, Anlagen und internen Abläufen bei. Du bist für die Sicherstellung des nötigen fachtechnischen Wissensstands des Anlagepersonals sowie der Engineering-Gruppen mitverantwortlich.

Deine Karriere bei Lonza in Visp

Was wir Dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen finden Sie auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Deine Aufgaben:

• Erstellen von Inbetriebnahme- und Qualifizierungsunterlagen für Neuanlagen, sowie die Betreuung von Umbau-, Ausbau- und Neubauprojekten; aufgegliedert wird dies in PQs auf Neubauprojekten für kritische Systeme und die SLC Betreuung aller Systeme nach der Produktivstellung

• Betreuung von Abweichungen, Änderungen (GEP und GMP), sowie CAPAs

• Koordination von internen Gruppen, sowie externen Dienstleistern und Lieferanten

• Verantwortung für die Präsentation der Qualifizierungsunterlagen bei Audits und Inspektionen

Dein Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (ETH, FH, HF) ODER vergleichbare Berufserfahrung

• Gute Berufserfahrung im regulierten Umfeld bezüglich Inbetriebnahme, Qualifizierung und Validierung z.B. Kühl- und Gefrierschränke, Reinmedienräume, sowie verfahrenstechnischem Equipment - ein Vorteil

• Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office werden vorausgesetzt, Kenntnisse in COMOS (Plant Engineering Softwarelösung), DMS, TrackWise und SAP sind von Vorteil

• Deutsch (fliessend in Wort und Schrift) und Englisch (verhandlungssicher)

• Selbständiges und flexibles Arbeiten mit gutem Kommunikationsstil, ausserdem strukturiertes, fokussiertes und gut organisiertes Arbeitsverhalten

​
Über Lonza:

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Bewerben Sie sich jetzt.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

A proposito di Lonza:

A Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra forza più grande. I nostri team in rete a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno in oltre 30 località in cinque continenti per produrre droga di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali: cooperazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di ogni individuo, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale per migliorare milioni di vite, ed è esattamente ciò che vogliamo condividere.

L'innovazione prospera quando persone di ogni origine portano le loro prospettive uniche. A Lonza apprezziamo la diversità e sosteniamo un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie pratiche, siamo lieti di darvi il benvenuto a bordo.

Pronto a contribuire a plasmare il futuro delle Scienze della Vita? Applica ora.

If necessary, eligible candidates and their families will be assisted in moving.

As a CQV engineer (m/w/d) you are responsible for the qualification and validation of process equipment and facilities. You contribute to the ongoing optimization of processes, plants and internal processes. You are responsible for ensuring the necessary technical knowledge of the plant staff and the engineering groups.

Your career at Lonza in Visp

What we offer you:

• A career in the company and a dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Remuneration programmes that recognise high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. You can also find the full list of our global services at https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Your tasks:

• Creation of commissioning and qualification documents for new plants, as well as the supervision of conversion, expansion and new construction projects; this is divided into PQs into new construction projects for critical systems and the SLC supervision of all systems after production

• Support for deviations, changes (GEP and GMP), and CAPAs

• Coordination of internal groups, as well as external service providers and suppliers

• Responsibility for presenting the qualification documents during audits and inspections

Your requirement profile:

• Completed training (ETH, FH, HF) OR comparable professional experience

• Good professional experience in the regulated environment regarding commissioning, qualification and validation e.g. refrigerators and freezers, clean media rooms, as well as process engineering equipment - an advantage

• Good knowledge in Microsoft Office is provided that knowledge of COMOS (Plant Engineering Software Solution), DMS, TrackWise and SAP are beneficial

• German (in German and in German) and English (in English)

• Self-employed and flexible working with good communication style, as well as structured, focused and well-organised work behaviour

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. Our globally networked teams work together every day at over 30 locations on five continents to produce tomorrow's drugs. Our core values: cooperation, responsibility, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Each individual's ideas, whether large or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that is exactly what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people of all origins bring their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and advocate an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to turn the groundbreaking ideas of our customers into practical therapies, we are pleased to welcome you on board.

Ready to help shape the future of Life Sciences? Apply now.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

Il supporto per il trasloco è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie in caso di necessità.

Lonza è oggi un'azienda leader a livello mondiale nel settore delle scienze della vita, che opera in tre continenti. Siamo attivi nella scienza, ma non esiste una formula magica per come affrontiamo il lavoro. La nostra principale soluzione scientifica è costituita da collaboratori di talento che collaborano e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti gestiscono la loro carriera in modo indipendente. Perché le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro a cui vogliamo partecipare.

Presso la sede di Visp si cerca un operatore automatico AFC.

Cosa ti offriamo

- Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica
- Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico
- Programmi di remunerazione che riconoscono prestazioni elevate
- Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, ti aspettano numerosi vantaggi in termini di stile di vita, famiglia e tempo libero. L'elenco completo dei nostri servizi globali è disponibile anche all'indirizzo: assetstream.aspx

I tuoi compiti

- Esecuzione dei lavori di messa in servizio e risoluzione dei problemi degli impianti EMR (elettrotecnica, tecnologia di misurazione e regolazione)
- Manutenzione preventiva degli impianti EMR
- Calibrazione, controllo e manipolazione degli strumenti di misurazione
- Documentazione secondo le linee guida GxP (integrità dei dati)
- Presa in carico del servizio di picchetto in caso di necessità

Il tuo profilo

-
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

Removal assistance is available to eligible candidates and their families if necessary.

Lonza is now a world leader in the Life Sciences business, which operates on three continents. We are active in science, but there is no magic formula for how we work. Our most important scientific solution is to create talented employees who work together and develop ideas that help other companies to help people. In return, our employees manage their careers independently. Because their ideas, whether large or small, improve the world. And this is the kind of work we want to have part in.

An automatic EFZ is being searched for at the Visp site.

What we offer you

- A career in the city of Alejan and a dynamic work culture - An inclusive and ethical workplace - Remuneration programs that acknowledge high performance - In addition to a competitive salary, you will find numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. You can also find the complete list of our global services under: assetstream.aspx

Your Tasks

- Implementation of commissioning and troubleshooting of EMR systems (electrical, measurement and control technology) - Preventive maintenance of EMR systems - Calibration, control and handling of measuring devices - Documentation according to GxP guidelines (data integrity) - Transfer of piket service if necessary

Your profile

- Completed training for automatic EFZ, electro-installator EFZ, electroniceer EFZ or a related profession - Basic knowledge Measurement and control technology are of benefit - readiness to continuous further training - joy in cross-departmental work as well as independent and flexible working in a team - reliability, resilience as well as entrepreneurial action and open, direct communication - German knowledge in word and writing, English knowledge of advantage

Lonza, the products and services have a daily positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great honour, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important for us as our successes themselves. At Lonza, respect is a great asset and we protect our employees as well as our environment. Success for us means morally acceptable progress.

Lonza is where people come to meet challenges and develop new ideas for complex issues with their creativity in the field of life science. Together, we contribute to improving the lives of many people around the world, offering them the certainty and satisfaction of making a real difference with their work.

Ready to help shape the future of Life Sciences? Then apply now!

The Visp site in Switzerland is growing rapidly, driven by our Advanced Synthesis Business Platform, which includes Bioconjugates and Small Molecules. Our teams specialize in developing and manufacturing drug substances under GMP, helping bring innovative therapies to patients worldwide.

We are hiring (Senior) Program Managers to join our Advanced Synthesis organization. In this role, you’ll be the main link between Lonza and our customers, leading cross-functional teams through the full project lifecycle—from contract to GMP manufacturing and delivery.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ

This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week).

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:

• Lead and deliver customer programs across their full lifecycle—from technology transfer to GMP manufacturing and project closure—ensuring quality, timeliness, and cost-effectiveness.

• Act as a trusted partner and main point of contact for customers, fostering transparent communication and long-term collaboration.

• Inspire and coordinate diverse, cross-functional teams in a matrix environment, promoting shared ownership and high performance.

• Drive program success by managing scope, timelines, and financials, while aligning with strategic business goals.

• Collaborate across functions to manage scope changes, support commercial strategies, and contribute to future opportunities.

• Identify and address risks proactively, ensuring smooth issue resolution and continuous improvement.

• Mentor and support team members, fostering a culture of learning, inclusion, and professional development.

What we are looking for:

• Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, or a related field; PhD is a plus.

• Experience in project or program management, ideally in pharma or CDMO.

• Strong understanding of technical, commercial, and organizational factors.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and deliver complex programs.

• Knowledge of GMP manufacturing and drug substance development.

• Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.

• Fluent in English; German is a plus.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, ensuring a smooth transition to our welcoming community in Visp.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

For our site in Visp, we are currently seeking several qualified Pipe Fitters / Metalworkers.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• Along with competitive salaries, you’ll find a wide range of lifestyle, family and leisure benefits available.

Your Responsibilities:

• Professionally and cost-effectively measure, fabricate, and install complex piping systems and support structures in industrial piping construction

• Prepare isometric drawings and piping spool assemblies in accordance with technical specifications and project requirements

• Plan and organize work processes based on P&ID flow diagrams for project work and plant modifications

• Apply PED directives and work according to internal piping classes, plant standards, and quality assurance requirements

Your Profile:

• Completed vocational training as a technician specializing in piping construction, pipefitting, heating installation, or plumbing installation.

• Several years of professional experience as a pipefitter or piping preparator/fabricator is an advantage

• Willingness to pursue continuous professional development

• Enjoy working across departments and capable of working independently and flexibly within a team

• Reliable, resilient, entrepreneurial mindset, with open and direct communication skills

• Good command of German, both written and spoken; English skills are an advantage

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Lead a high-impact MSAT team through a demanding CAPEX growth project ramp-up—driving Performance Qualifications (PPQs), aseptic process simulations (media fills), and equipment/process qualifications (PQs) for sterile fill & finish lines, supporting technology transfers, and ensuring successful operational readiness. Build accountability, manage performance, deliver under pressure, and shape a resilient, future-ready culture.
We are seeking an authentic leader with proven people leadership experience (including performance management and difficult conversations), strong resilience, and deep expertise in MSAT and sterile fill-finish manufacturing. Experience with lyophilization and/or ADCs is a strong advantage. You will lead the team through facility ramp-up, PPQ execution, aseptic process simulations, technology transfers, inspection readiness, and operational challenges while inspiring a diverse organization through growth and change.

Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!
This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Lead and develop a high-performing MSAT organization responsible for facility ramp-up, process implementation, technology transfers, aseptic process simulations (media fills), process performance qualifications (PPQs), and lifecycle process support. Provide full people leadership responsibility, including talent development, performance management, succession planning, and organizational design. Foster a culture of accountability, empowerment, innovation, resilience, and continuous improvement while ensuring effective utilization of personnel, equipment, materials, and facility resources.

• Own the technical implementation and qualification strategy for manufacturing processes within the facility, ensuring compliance with Lonza standards, customer requirements, GMP regulations, and industry best practices. Drive successful execution of process qualifications, validation activities, and operational readiness milestones to support commercial manufacturing.

• Ensure inspection readiness at all times and serve as a key representative during regulatory inspections, customer audits, and due diligence visits. Present technical strategies, validation approaches, process performance, and investigation outcomes to customers and health authorities with confidence and credibility.

• Partner with Operation and Engineering teams to define and deliver strategic priorities, operational objectives, and long-term capability development plans aligned with site, business unit, and corporate goals. Contribute actively to the overall leadership and performance of the site.

• Collaborate across functions and sites including Operations, Quality, Engineering, Validation, Process Development, Analytical Development, Regulatory Affairs, and Global MSAT to ensure seamless technology transfers, robust process control strategies, and successful commercialization of new products. Act as deputy to the Head of Drug Product Operations Stein as required.

• Establish and continuously improve MSAT standards, systems, and processes, including qualification and validation strategies, single-use technologies, process monitoring, continued process verification, and lifecycle management. Ensure application of scientific and risk-based approaches to process design, qualification, and optimization.

• Lead complex product and process investigations, deviations, CAPAs, complaints, and troubleshooting activities. Apply strong scientific, engineering, and statistical expertise to analyze data, identify root causes, assess process capability, and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.

• Serve as technical authority for manufacturing science and technology, providing expert support and coaching to scientific, technical, and production teams. Drive knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous improvement to enhance process robustness, operational excellence, and product quality.

What we are looking for:

• Proven team leadership experience, including conducting performance discussions and managing performance effectively (experience from MSAT, QA, or Manufacturing environments)

• Strong resilience, with the ability to stay composed and lead under pressure in a demanding and evolving environment

• Demonstrated expertise in sterile fill & finish manufacturing (essential)

• Ability to lead with authenticity and positivity, providing clear direction, perspective, and fostering accountability within the team

• Solid background in MSAT operations, with experience in technology transfer and process implementation (highly preferred)

• Scientific degree (natural sciences) preferred; additional expertise in lyophilization and/or ADC (antibody-drug conjugates) is a strong advantage

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è in Stein, AG, Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario. Condurre un team MSAT ad alto impatto attraverso un'impegnativa ramp-up del progetto di crescita CAPEX—driving Performance Qualifications (PPQs), simulazioni di processo asettiche (media fills) e qualifiche di equipaggiamento/processo (PQs) per linee di riempimento e finitura sterili, trasferimenti di tecnologia di supporto, e garantire la disponibilità operativa di successo. Costruire la responsabilità, gestire le prestazioni, fornire sotto pressione, e modellare una cultura resiliente e pronto per il futuro. Stiamo cercando un leader autentico con comprovata esperienza di leadership delle persone (tra cui la gestione delle prestazioni e conversazioni difficili), forte resilienza, e profonda esperienza nella produzione MSAT e sterile riempimento-finish. L'esperienza con liofilizzazione e/o ADC è un vantaggio forte. Potrai guidare il team attraverso la ramp-up struttura, l'esecuzione PPQ, simulazioni di processo asettiche, trasferimenti tecnologici, la prontezza di ispezione e le sfide operative, ispirando una organizzazione diversificata attraverso la crescita e il cambiamento. Scopri il tuo Career in Drug Product Services a Lonza! Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza. Cosa otterrai:
• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.
• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.
• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni. Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero. L'elenco completo dei nostri benefici globali è disponibile qui: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits Cosa farai:
• Guidare e sviluppare un'organizzazione MSAT altamente performante responsabile per il potenziamento delle strutture, l'implementazione dei processi, i trasferimenti di tecnologia, le simulazioni di processo asettiche (completi multimediali), le qualifiche di performance di processo (PPQ), e il supporto del processo del ciclo di vita. Fornire piena responsabilità di leadership persone, tra cui sviluppo del talento, gestione delle prestazioni, pianificazione di successione e progettazione organizzativa. Promuovere una cultura di responsabilità, empowerment, innovazione, resilienza e miglioramento continuo, garantendo un utilizzo efficace del personale, delle attrezzature, dei materiali e delle risorse di struttura.
• Possedere alla strategia tecnica di implementazione e qualificazione per i processi produttivi all'interno della struttura, garantendo il rispetto degli standard Lonza, dei requisiti dei clienti, delle normative GMP e delle best practice del settore. Guidare l'esecuzione di successo delle qualifiche di processo, le attività di validazione e le pietre miliari di prontezza operative per sostenere la produzione commerciale.
• Assicurare la disponibilità di ispezione in ogni momento e servire come rappresentante chiave durante le ispezioni di regolazione, controlli dei clienti e visite di due diligence. Presentare strategie tecniche, approcci di validazione, prestazioni di processo e risultati di indagine a clienti e autorità sanitarie con fiducia e credibilità.
• Partner con i team Operazione e Ingegneria per definire e fornire priorità strategiche, obiettivi operativi e piani di sviluppo delle capacità a lungo termine allineati con gli obiettivi di sito, business unit e corporate. Contribuisci attivamente alla leadership generale e alle prestazioni del sito.
• Collaborare tra funzioni e siti tra cui operazioni, qualità, ingegneria, convalida, sviluppo dei processi, sviluppo analitico, affari regolamentari e MSAT globale per garantire trasferimenti tecnologici senza soluzione di continuità, strategie di controllo di processo robuste e una commercializzazione di successo di nuovi prodotti. Agire come vice al capo delle operazioni del prodotto della droga Stein come richiesto.
• Stabilire e migliorare continuamente gli standard, i sistemi e i processi MSAT, comprese le strategie di qualificazione e validazione, le tecnologie a uso singolo, il monitoraggio dei processi, la verifica dei processi e la gestione del ciclo di vita. Assicurare l'applicazione di approcci scientifici e basati sui rischi per la progettazione, la qualificazione e l'ottimizzazione del processo.
• condurre indagini complesse sui prodotti e sui processi, deviazioni, CAPAs, reclami e attività di risoluzione dei problemi. Applicare forti competenze scientifiche, ingegneristiche e statistiche per analizzare i dati, identificare le cause principali, valutare le capacità di processo e implementare azioni correttive e preventive sostenibili.
• Servire come autorità tecnica per la produzione di scienza e tecnologia, fornendo supporto esperto e coaching ai team scientifici, tecnici e produttivi. Guida la condivisione della conoscenza, l'innovazione e il miglioramento continuo per migliorare la robustezza del processo, l'eccellenza operativa e la qualità del prodotto. Cosa stiamo cercando:
• Provata esperienza di leadership del team, tra cui condurre discussioni sulle prestazioni e gestire efficacemente le prestazioni (esperienza da ambienti MSAT, QA o Manufacturing)
• Forte resilienza, con la capacità di rimanere composta e portare sotto pressione in un ambiente esigente ed in evoluzione
• Competenza dimostrata nella produzione sterile di riempimento e finitura (essenziale)
• Capacità di condurre con autenticità e positività, fornendo una chiara direzione, una prospettiva e una maggiore responsabilità all'interno del team
• Sfondo solido nelle operazioni MSAT, con esperienza nel trasferimento tecnologico e nell'implementazione del processo (molto preferito)
• Grado scientifico (scienze naturali) preferito; esperienza aggiuntiva nella liofilizzazione e/o ADC (congiunti anticorpo-droga) è un forte vantaggio Informazioni su Lonza A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte. L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo. Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

• Fähigkeit, mit Authentizität und Positivität zu führen, klare Richtung, Perspektive zu geben und die Verantwortlichkeit innerhalb des Teams zu fördern
• Solider Hintergrund in MSAT-Operationen, mit Erfahrung in Technologietransfer und Prozessimplementierung (sehr bevorzugt)
• Wissenschaftlicher Abschluss (Naturwissenschaften) bevorzugt; zusätzliche Expertise in Lyophilisation und / oder ADC (Antikörper-Wirkstoff-Konjugate) ist ein starker Vorteil Über Lonza Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'emplacement réel de ce travail est à Stein, AG, Suisse. Une aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats admissibles et à leur famille, au besoin. Diriger une équipe MSAT à fort impact grâce à un projet de croissance exigeant de CAPEX : qualifications de performance en conduite (PPQ), simulations de processus aseptiques (remplissage des médias) et qualifications d'équipement/processus (PQ) pour les lignes de remplissage et de finition stériles, soutien des transferts de technologie et garantie d'une bonne préparation opérationnelle. Renforcer la responsabilisation, gérer le rendement, offrir sous pression et façonner une culture résiliente et prête à l'avenir. Nous recherchons un leader authentique avec une expérience de leadership éprouvée (y compris la gestion du rendement et les conversations difficiles), une forte résilience et une expertise approfondie en MSAT et en fabrication stérile. L'expérience de la lyophilisation et/ou des CDA est un avantage important. Vous dirigerez l'équipe à travers la mise en place d'installations, l'exécution de PPQ, les simulations de processus aseptiques, les transferts de technologie, la préparation aux inspections et les défis opérationnels tout en inspirant une organisation diversifiée par la croissance et le changement. Découvrez votre carrière dans les services de médicaments à Lonza! C'est un rôle entièrement basé sur le site. Travailler ensemble en personne soutient une collaboration étroite en temps réel et la précision technique nécessaire pour fabriquer des médicaments répondant aux normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées. Ce que vous obtiendrez :
• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.
• Un lieu de travail inclusif et éthique.
• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé. En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreuses prestations de vie de famille et de loisirs. La liste complète de nos avantages globaux peut être consultée ici: https://www.lonza.com/careers/bénéfices Ce que vous ferez :
• Diriger et développer une organisation MSAT hautement performante chargée de la mise en place des installations, de la mise en œuvre des processus, des transferts de technologie, des simulations de processus aseptiques (compléments de médias), des qualifications de performance des processus (QPP) et de l'appui aux processus du cycle de vie. Assurer la pleine responsabilité des dirigeants, y compris le perfectionnement des talents, la gestion du rendement, la planification de la relève et la conception organisationnelle. Favoriser une culture de responsabilisation, d'autonomisation, d'innovation, de résilience et d'amélioration continue tout en assurant une utilisation efficace du personnel, du matériel, des matériaux et des ressources des installations.
• Posséder la stratégie technique de mise en œuvre et de qualification des procédés de fabrication au sein de l'installation, en assurant le respect des normes Lonza, des exigences des clients, des règlements BPF et des meilleures pratiques de l'industrie. Conduire l'exécution réussie des qualifications des procédés, des activités de validation et des étapes de préparation opérationnelle pour soutenir la fabrication commerciale.
• Assurer la préparation à l'inspection en tout temps et servir de représentant clé lors des inspections réglementaires, des vérifications des clients et des visites de diligence raisonnable. Présenter les stratégies techniques, les approches de validation, le rendement des processus et les résultats des enquêtes aux clients et aux autorités sanitaires avec confiance et crédibilité.
• Établir des partenariats avec les équipes d'exploitation et d'ingénierie afin de définir et d'exécuter des priorités stratégiques, des objectifs opérationnels et des plans de développement des capacités à long terme alignés sur les objectifs du site, de l'unité opérationnelle et de l'entreprise. Contribuer activement au leadership général et au rendement du site.
• Collaborer entre les fonctions et les sites, y compris les opérations, la qualité, l'ingénierie, la validation, le développement de processus, le développement analytique, les affaires réglementaires et le MSAT mondial, afin d'assurer des transferts de technologie sans faille, des stratégies de contrôle de processus robustes et la commercialisation réussie de nouveaux produits. Agir comme adjoint du chef des opérations de produits pharmaceutiques Stein au besoin.
• Établir et améliorer en permanence les normes, systèmes et processus MSAT, y compris les stratégies de qualification et de validation, les technologies à usage unique, la surveillance des processus, la vérification continue des processus et la gestion du cycle de vie. Assurer l'application d'approches scientifiques et axées sur le risque pour la conception, la qualification et l'optimisation des processus.
• Diriger les enquêtes complexes sur les produits et les procédés, les écarts, les APC, les plaintes et les activités de dépannage. Appliquer une solide expertise scientifique, technique et statistique pour analyser les données, identifier les causes profondes, évaluer la capacité des processus et mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives et préventives durables.
• Servir d'autorité technique pour la science et la technologie de fabrication, en fournissant un soutien et un encadrement spécialisés aux équipes scientifiques, techniques et de production. Favoriser le partage des connaissances, l'innovation et l'amélioration continue afin d'améliorer la robustesse des processus, l'excellence opérationnelle et la qualité des produits. Ce que nous cherchons:
• Expérience éprouvée du leadership d'équipe, y compris la conduite de discussions sur les performances et la gestion efficace des performances (expérience des environnements MSAT, QA ou Manufacturing)
• Forte résilience, avec la capacité de rester composé et de mener sous pression dans un environnement exigeant et en évolution
• Expertise démontrée dans la fabrication de finitions stériles (essentielle)
• Capacité de diriger avec authenticité et positivité, en fournissant une orientation claire, une perspective et en favorisant la responsabilisation au sein de l'équipe
• Une solide expérience des opérations MSAT, avec une expérience en transfert de technologie et en mise en œuvre des processus (fortement préférée)
• Diplôme scientifique (sciences naturelles) préféré; l'expertise supplémentaire en lyophilisation et/ou en CDA (conjugés anti-médicaments) est un avantage important À propos de Lonza À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez. L'innovation prospère lorsque les gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous nous réjouissons de vous accueillir à bord. Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant. Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Independent operation and execution of upstream related activities according to specified instructions (manufacturing protocols / operating instructions / work instructions / SOP)

• Safe and correct execution of work in compliance with safety regulations, taking into account the cGMP quality requirements

• Responsibility for cleanliness and order at the workplace as well as the assigned rooms and storage areas

• Performing monitoring, maintenance, and cleaning tasks, as well as reporting and rectifying defects and malfunctions in the facility, including their documentation

• Every employee is involved as an equal team member through their active participation in continuous improvement processes

What we are looking for:

• Completed professional training (Apprenticeship)

• Chemical or pharmaceutical-technical training as well as GMP and/or BICO training advantageous

• Good skills in speaking, writing, and comprehension in German or English required.

• Accurate work and documentation practices

• Execution of tasks with a high level of safety and quality awareness

• Willingness to work shifts (4-shift operation) with flexibility in work scheduling

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp or Basel, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

As part of Advanced Synthesis (ADS), the Supply Chain & Inventory Lead plays a critical role in driving Supply Chain performance across all ADS sites. This position is accountable for inventory management strategy, KPI definition, performance reporting, and cross‑site process improvement. The role is essential for ensuring operational efficiency, optimized inventory levels, and continuous improvement within the ADS Supply Chain organization.

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. We offer flexibility to work remotely for no more than 20% of your time. Requests are considered on a case‑by‑case basis, in line with business needs.

What you will get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here:  https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Develop and implement inventory management strategies to optimize stock levels and minimize excess inventory

• Lead platform forums to address cross‑site inventory topics (e.g., excess inventory, customer liability)

• Build and maintain dashboards and reporting tools for inventory projections, write‑offs, and provisions

• Monitor and analyze Supply Chain KPIs to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities

• Collaborate with cross‑functional and cross‑site teams to design and streamline Supply Chain processes

• Conduct regular performance assessments and provide insights and recommendations to ADS senior management

• Define and implement ADS‑wide processes (e.g., inventory reporting for S&OP) and ensure adherence across sites

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or related fields; Master’s degree preferred

• Proven experience in material and inventory management with a strong track record in SC KPI performance improvement

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to work with complex data sets

• Demonstrated leadership capabilities and experience in matrix organizations

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions and platforms

• Fluency in English; German and Chinese are an advantage

• Ability to adapt global standards to ADS‑specific needs with a strong process‑focused mindset

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. • Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Forum della piattaforma di piombo per affrontare argomenti di inventario cross-site (ad esempio, inventario in eccesso, responsabilità del cliente)

• Monitorare e analizzare i KPI della Supply Chain per identificare tendenze, rischi e opportunità di miglioramento
• Collabora con team interfunzionali e cross-site per progettare e ottimizzare i processi Supply Chain
• Condurre valutazioni regolari delle prestazioni e fornire informazioni e raccomandazioni alla gestione senior ADS
• Definire e implementare i processi ADS-wide (ad esempio, la segnalazione di inventario per S&OP) e garantire l'adesione di siti Cosa stiamo cercando:
• Corso di laurea in Gestione della Supply Chain, Business Administration, Ingegneria, o campi correlati; Master’s laurea preferito
• Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione del materiale e dell'inventario con un forte record nel miglioramento delle prestazioni SC KPI
• Forte capacità analitiche e la capacità di lavorare con set di dati complessi
• Capacità di leadership dimostrate e l'esperienza nelle organizzazioni di matrice
• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di collaborare tra funzioni e piattaforme
• Fluency in inglese; tedesco e cinese sono un vantaggio

A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo. Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applica ora. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join Lonza as an Associate Director, Technology Transfer (Global MSAT) and play a pivotal role in bringing complex drug products from development to commercial reality. You’ll lead end-to-end technology transfers—from process scale-up and PPQ to regulatory filings, inspection readiness, and successful launch with a focus on aseptic fill&finish processes.
Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza !

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Manage, drive and guide high‑complexity and high-impact drug product commercial transfers from New Product Introduction to PPQ, regulatory filing, pre-approval health authority inspections and first commercial launch.

• Act as global Subject Matter Expert for Process Technology Transfer, shaping technical strategy, ensuring global standard alignment, and driving customer‑centric excellence across sites and product lifecycles.

• Provide technical authority and act as senior escalation point for complex technical challenges, provide tech transfer leadership for late‑phase and commercial programs.

• Serve as the primary technical point of contact for all technology‑transfer‑related manufacturing topic of assigned projects within internal and customer project teams. Define and monitor project scope, timing and progress of assigned stages.

• Lead process setup, scale‑up, and implementation activities at GMP drug product manufacturing sites, including on‑site technical support during batch execution.

• Responsible for new product introduction, process implementation, process control strategy and technical transfer and process validation documentation of assigned projects, including review of dossier modules for regulatory filing.

• Drive GMP change management strategy of assigned projects as well as initiate and manage GMP change control in system. Lead and support critical GMP product / process deviations and corresponding implementation of corrective/preventive actions (CAPAs).

• Ensure all activities are performed according to current standards (Good Manufacturing Practice, Health Safety Environment, Regulatory etc.).

What we are looking for:

• Industry-leading expertise in biotech/pharma/CDMO environments, with strong experience in drug product development, tech transfer especially within aseptic fill&finish processes (e.g. lyophilization, prefilled syringes). Proven ability to translate scientific depth into strategic decision‑making.

• Deep knowledge of GMP, regulatory, and CMC requirements, with the ability to translate strategy into robust manufacturing execution

• Proven ability to influence and lead complex manufacturing strategies and resolve high-impact technical challenges across global, cross-site operations

• Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, influencing senior leaders and navigating complex decision-making environments

• University degree in Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Science or similar field (PhD preferred)

• Excellent project, risk, and data management capabilities, paired with clear technical writing; fluent in English (German is a plus)

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences?
Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è in Stein, AG, Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario. La nostra lista completa di benefici locali su misura può essere trovata di seguito. Vantaggi in Stein: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk Cosa farai:
