• Fornire l'autorità tecnica e agire come punto di escalation senior per complesse sfide tecniche, fornire la leadership di trasferimento tecnico per i programmi di tardo-fase e commerciali.
• Servire come punto di contatto tecnico primario per tutti i temi di produzione legati alla tecnologia dei progetti assegnati all'interno dei team di progetto interni e dei clienti. Definire e monitorare la portata del progetto, la tempistica e il progresso delle fasi assegnate.
• Configurazione del processo di piombo, scala-up e attività di implementazione nei siti di produzione di prodotti farmaceutici GMP, incluso il supporto tecnico in loco durante l'esecuzione in batch.
• Responsabile per l'introduzione di nuovi prodotti, l'implementazione del processo, la strategia di controllo del processo e la documentazione tecnica di trasferimento e convalida dei processi di progetti assegnati, compresa la revisione dei moduli di dossier per il deposito normativo.
• Guidare GMP cambiare strategia di gestione dei progetti assegnati, nonché avviare e gestire il controllo di cambiamento GMP nel sistema. Guidare e sostenere le deviazioni critiche del prodotto/processo GMP e la corrispondente implementazione delle azioni correttive/preventive (CAPA).
• Assicurarsi che tutte le attività siano eseguite secondo gli standard attuali (Good Manufacturing Practice, Health Safety Environment, Regulatory ecc.). Cosa stiamo cercando:
• MSc o PhD in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Ingegneria Farmaceutica, Chimica, Biochimica, Bioingegneria o campo correlato. Prove capacità di tradurre la profondità scientifica nel processo decisionale strategico.
• Competenza leader del settore in biotecnologia/farmaco/CDMO; sviluppo del prodotto farmaceutico, trasferimento tecnologico, produzione asettica di prodotti proteici, processo di liofilizzazione altamente auspicabile e/o esperienza di produzione in siringhe preriempite. Capacità dimostrata di influenzare la strategia della piattaforma e guidare l'innovazione all'interno di ambienti operativi complessi.
• Conoscenza profonda di GMP, aspettative normative e requisiti CMC per le biologiche di fine fase e commerciali. Capacità eccezionale nel tradurre gli obiettivi del programma in robusti processi produttivi operativi.
• Ottima comunicazione, gestione delle parti interessate e competenze di supervisione con la capacità di influenzare a livello senior e executive. Forte comando di gestione del rischio e pianificazione dello scenario.
• Semplari capacità di pianificazione e organizzazione, tra cui la gestione del progetto, la gestione del rischio, l'interpretazione e la comunicazione di dati scientifici complessi, competenze di scrittura tecnica.
• Prove esperienze guidando la strategia di produzione, risolvendo problemi tecnici ad alto impatto, e supervisionando iniziative cross-site.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e comando dell'inglese sia scritto che orale. Il tedesco è un vantaggio. Informazioni su Lonza A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte. L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo. Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Diriger et appuyer les écarts critiques entre les produits et les procédés BPF et la mise en oeuvre correspondante des mesures correctives/préventives.

• Connaissance approfondie des BPF, des attentes réglementaires et des exigences en matière de CMC pour les produits biologiques en retard et commerciaux. Capacité exceptionnelle de traduire les objectifs du programme en processus de fabrication opérationnels robustes.
• Excellente capacité de communication, de gestion des intervenants et de supervision avec la capacité d'influence aux niveaux supérieur et supérieur. Forte maîtrise de la gestion des risques et de la planification des scénarios.
• Compétences exemplaires en planification et en organisation, y compris gestion de projet, gestion des risques, interprétation et communication de données scientifiques complexes, compétences en rédaction technique.
• Expérience éprouvée en matière de stratégie de fabrication, de résolution des problèmes techniques à impact élevé et de supervision des initiatives inter-site.

jobs.description:
Der Standort dieser Position ist in Visp, Schweiz. Bei Bedarf steht für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Was wir Ihnen bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

Zusätzlich zu einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt können Sie zahlreiche Vorteile für Lebensstil, Familie und Freizeit erwarten. Die vollständige Liste unserer lokal zugeschnittenen Benefits finden Sie unten.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Einhaltung der relevanten SOPs (Standardarbeitsanweisungen) und Vorschriften (z.B. Hygienekonzept, Sicherheitsvorschriften)

• Selbstständiges Bedienen von Produktionsanlagen und -geräten, einschliesslich Vorbereitung, Betrieb und Nachbereitung gemäss SOPs

• Durchführung von Herstellungsaktivitäten gemäss cGMP-Richtlinien in der BioAtrium AG im Bereich der Puffer- und Medienvorbereitung für die Herstellung mit Säugetierzellen, einschliesslich Bedienung von Kleinteilewaschanlage und Autoklav

• Überwachung der Produktionsprozesse, Erkennen und Melden potenzieller Probleme sowie aktive Mitwirkung an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozessen

• GMP-konformes Arbeiten und zeitgerechte Dokumentation der Tätigkeiten (z.B. in Computersystemen (MES) oder Logbüchern)

• Probenahmen, Durchführung von In-Prozess-Kontrollen (IPC) und Auswertung von Testergebnissen

• Verantwortung für die Schulung des Produktionspersonals zu spezifischen Geräten oder Standardprozessen (betrifft Senior Operatoren)

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:
Wir heissen KandidatInnen aus allen Erfahrungsstufen willkommen. Ob Sie bereits Expertise in der pharmazeutischen Produktion haben oder als QuereinsteigerIn mit relevanten Qualifikationen starten möchten - wenn Sie motiviert sind, an der Herstellung modernster Wirkstoffe mitzuwirken, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

• Berufseinsteiger: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung in der Pharma-, Chemie- oder Biotechnologiebranche oder ein entsprechender Hochschulabschluss

• Erfahrene Fachkräfte: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion, idealerweise mit GMP- und Reinraumerfahrung

• Sicherheits- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Deutsch erforderlich, Englisch von Vorteil

• Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im Schichtbetrieb (4-Schicht-System)

• Teamfähigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Flexibilität

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeitenden unsere grösste Stärke. Mit über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams jeden Tag zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Kernwerte – Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität – spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Jede Idee, ob gross oder klein, hat das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern – und genau an dieser Arbeit möchten wir Sie beteiligen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Hintergründen ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in umsetzbare Therapien zu verwandeln, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie an Bord zu begrüssen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Bewerben Sie sich jetzt.

English Version:

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. The full list of our local tailored benefits can also be found below.

What you will do:

• Compliance with relevant SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and regulations (e.g., hygiene concept, safety regulations)

• Independent operation of production systems and equipment, including preparation, operation, and follow-up according to SOPs

• Execution of manufacturing activities according to cGMP guidelines at BioAtrium AG in the area of buffer and media preparation for mammalian cell production, including operation of the small‑parts washer and autoclave

• Monitoring of production processes, identifying and reporting potential issues, and actively contributing to continuous improvement initiatives

• Performing GMP-compliant work and timely documentation of activities (e.g., in computer systems such as MES or in logbooks)

• Sampling, performing in-process controls (IPC), and evaluating test results

• Responsibility for training production staff on specific equipment or standard processes (applies to Senior Operators)

What we are looking for:

We welcome candidates from all experience levels. Whether you already have expertise in pharmaceutical production or are entering from another field with relevant qualifications — if you are motivated to contribute to the manufacture of state‑of‑the‑art active ingredients, we look forward to your application.

• Entry-level candidates: Completed vocational training in the pharmaceutical, chemical, or biotechnology sector, or a relevant university degree

• Experienced professionals: Several years of experience in pharmaceutical production, ideally with GMP and cleanroom experience

• Strong safety awareness and sense of responsibility

• German required; English is an advantage

• Willingness to work in shift operations (4‑shift system)

• Team spirit, reliability, and flexibility

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.description:
Director Operational Excellence & PMO – Microbial Operations

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

This role is based at our Visp manufacturing site and plays a critical role in driving operational excellence and strategic project delivery across the Microbial Operations network, directly impacting performance, innovation, and scalability.

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location

• The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do

• Define and execute the Operational Excellence strategy across Microbial Operations to drive performance and competitiveness

• Lead continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Six Sigma, delivering measurable business impact across assets

• Establish and run a robust PMO framework, ensuring strong governance, prioritization, and execution of strategic initiatives

• Oversee the full project portfolio, ensuring clarity of scope, milestones, risks, resources, and benefits realization

• Partner with senior leadership to enable alignment, decision-making, and execution of cross-functional priorities

• Drive governance and planning processes including OE roadmaps, business reviews, and business continuity planning

• Build organizational capability by coaching leaders and embedding a culture of continuous improvement and accountability

What we are looking for

• Significant experience in manufacturing operations, operational excellence, or project/program management in a complex environment

• Strong expertise in Lean Six Sigma methodologies (Black Belt certification preferred)

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence without formal authority

• Excellent project portfolio management and governance capabilities

• Strong strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution mindset

• Advanced communication and stakeholder management skills across senior leadership levels

• Degree in a relevant field (e.g., engineering, life sciences); postgraduate qualification preferred

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• Förderung eines effizienten und erfolgreichen Arbeitsumfelds sowie effektive Kommunikation mit Teammitgliedern aus verschiedenen Abteilungen und Kunden.

• Anpassung an sich ändernde Prioritäten und gleichzeitiges Management mehrerer Projekte.

Dein Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossenes Studium (PhD, Master) in der Fachrichtung Chemie- oder Verfahrenstechnik.

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der chemischen und/oder pharmazeutischen Produktion erwünscht

• Kenntnisse im Bereich GMP sowie betriebswirtschaftliche Kompetenzen sind von Vorteil.

• Fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

• Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und Kommunikationsstärke.

• Proaktive und flexible Arbeitsweise mit der Fähigkeit, unter Druck zu arbeiten.

• Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und sich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. • Studi completi (PhD, Master) nel campo dell'ingegneria chimica o di processo.
• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nella produzione chimica e/o farmaceutica desiderata

• Conoscenza fluente del tedesco e dell'inglese nelle parole e nella scrittura.

I nostri valori fondamentali: collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, ed è esattamente ciò che vogliamo che tu condivida. L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di diversa provenienza portano nelle loro prospettive uniche. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo in un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti a tradurre le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo. Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applicare ora Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician QC Microbiology (m/f/d) 60%
jobs.description:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Am Standort Visp  wird ein/e Laborant/in der QC Mikrobiologie gesucht. Als Mitglied unseres jungen und dynamischen Mikrobiologie-Teams, bist du unter Einhaltung der GMP- und Sicherheitsrichtlinien verantwortliche für die Routine-Durchführung von verschiedenen mikrobiologischen Methoden.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Durchführung analytischer Methoden im Aufgabenbereich, Auswertung, Review und Berichten der Ergebnisse.

• Erstellen von Analysenprotokollen, Prüfanweisungen und Kurzberichten.

• Dokumentation aller Labortätigkeiten entsprechend GMP und internen Richtlinien.

• Einhaltung der Qualitäts- (SOP und GMP) und der Sicherheitsvorschriften.

• Sauberkeit und Ordnung im Labor.

• Methodischer Hauptfokus: Keim Identifizierungen und Endotoxin Messungen.

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Laborant/in, BTA, oder BSC mit Fachrichtung Biologie, Biochemie oder ähnlichem Bereich.

• Fliessend Deutsch und English von Vorteil.

• Hands-on Labor Erfahrung (insbesondere Erfahrung mit mikrobiologischen Analysetechniken) sind ein Plus.

• Kenntnisse im Bereich GMP ist ein Plus .

Lonza’s Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Lonza è oggi leader mondiale nelle scienze della vita, operante in tre continenti. Lavoriamo nella scienza, ma non c'è formula magica per come ci avviciniamo al lavoro. La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante è dipendenti di talento che collaborano e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti guidano la loro carriera in modo indipendente. Perché le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano il mondo. E questo e' il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo fare.

Al sito di Visp, un assistente di laboratorio al QC Mikrobiologie è ricercato. Come membro del nostro team di microbiologia giovane e dinamica, sei responsabile per l'implementazione di routine di vari metodi microbiologici in conformità con GMP e linee guida di sicurezza.

I loro compiti:

• Attuazione dei metodi analitici nell'area di attività, valutazione, revisione e reporting dei risultati.

• Creare registri analitici, istruzioni di prova e brevi report.

• Documentazione di tutte le attività di laboratorio secondo GMP e linee guida interne.

• Rispetto della qualità (SOP e GMP) e delle norme di sicurezza.

• Pulizia e ordine in laboratorio.

• Focus metodologico principale: identificazione dei germi e misurazioni dell'endotossina.

Il vostro profilo di requisito:

• Formazione completa come assistente di laboratorio, BTA, o BSC specializzata in biologia, biochimica o campo simile.

• Flusso tedesco e inglese è benefico.

• L'esperienza di laboratorio Hands-on (specialmente l'esperienza con le tecniche di analisi microbiologiche) è un plus.

• La conoscenza di GMP è un vantaggio.

I prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone ogni giorno. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande onore, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante per noi come i nostri successi stessi. A Lonza, il rispetto è una priorità e proteggiamo sia i nostri dipendenti che il nostro ambiente. Il successo per noi significa progresso moralmente accettabile.

Lonza è unito da persone che assumono sfide e usano la loro creatività per sviluppare nuove idee per problemi complessi. Nel sito di Visp, si cerca un polimeccanico studentesco. Come polimeccanico a Lonza, si producono pezzi e dispositivi e strumenti per la produzione. Dai diversi materiali, ma soprattutto dai metalli, si producono singoli componenti o interi impianti di produzione. Quando si producono singole parti o prototipi di costruzione, si lavora su torni, fresatura, foratura e rettificatrici. Con strumenti di misura e di prova ad alta precisione, si controlla finalmente la qualità dei pezzi. I polimeccanici sono responsabili dell'assemblaggio, manutenzione e messa in servizio di dispositivi, apparati, macchine e impianti. Nuovi ordini sono discussi nella squadra e nuove idee sono sviluppate insieme.

La tua istruzione
L'insegnamento dura quattro anni. I polimeccanici sono formati nella scuola di insegnamento e frequentano la scuola professionale per un massimo di due giorni alla settimana. Durante la prima metà dell'insegnamento, una vasta base di conoscenze e competenze è prevista nella formazione di base. Il focus è sulle tecniche di lavoro come la tecnologia di produzione manuale e meccanica, la tecnologia di assemblaggio, la tecnologia di unione,
Commissione, manutenzione e sicurezza tecnica sul lavoro. Nella seconda metà dell'apprendistato, la formazione al centro si svolge nelle aree operative di attività. In questa fase di formazione, i tirocinanti approfondiscono le loro conoscenze e competenze attraverso l'apprendimento esemplare sui contratti di produzione e progetti.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Lonza is today a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

At the Visp site, a student polymechanic is sought. As a polymechanic at Lonza, you produce workpieces as well as devices and tools for production. From different materials, but mainly from metals, you produce individual components or entire production plants. When manufacturing individual parts or building prototypes, you work on lathes, milling, drilling and grinding machines. With high-precision measuring and testing instruments, you finally check the quality of the workpieces. Polymechanics are responsible for the assembly, maintenance and commissioning of devices, apparatuses, machines and plants. New orders are discussed in the team and new ideas are developed together.

Your education
The teaching lasts four years. Polymechanics are trained in the teaching establishment and attend vocational school for a maximum of two days per week. During the first half of teaching, a broad foundation of knowledge and skills is laid in basic training. The focus is on working techniques such as manual and mechanical production technology, assembly technology, joining technology,
Commissioning, maintenance and technical safety at work. In the second half of the apprenticeship, the focus training follows in operational areas of activity. In this training phase, the trainees deepen their knowledge and skills through exemplary learning on production contracts and projects.

Your profile

• Interest in technical relationships and mechanics

• Precise and careful working methods

• Good spatial imagination

• Concentration, patience and endurance

• Teamwork

• Reliability

• Very good knowledge of German (minimum B2 level)

We offer
At Lonza, we firmly believe that in addition to learning a profession, personal development from day one is important. We therefore train our learners not only as qualified professionals, but also as independent personalities. This enables you to make a promising start to your career.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Lonza è oggi leader mondiale nelle scienze della vita, operante in tre continenti. Lavoriamo nella scienza, ma non c'è formula magica per come ci avviciniamo al lavoro. La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante è dipendenti di talento che collaborano e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti guidano la loro carriera in modo indipendente. Perché le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano il mondo. E questo e' il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo fare.

Nel sito di Visp si cerca un tecnico di laboratorio di apprendista. Come laboratori, lavoriamo in un team sotto la responsabilità di biologi o chimici nelle aree di ricerca, sviluppo, controllo della qualità e piccole quantità di produzione. Sono incluse anche attività come lo sviluppo di processi biotecnologici, il monitoraggio delle celle su piccola scala, la pulizia e il controllo dei prodotti con dispositivi specializzati. Per i professionisti in un'azienda farmaceutica, la costante conformità con la data sicurezza e la normativa sul lavoro è comune. La documentazione esatta delle fasi di lavoro e la valutazione dei risultati sul computer è di grande importanza. Lavorano con ricercatori di diversi paesi e quindi spesso comunicano in inglese.

La tua istruzione
L'insegnamento dura tre anni. I primi 6 mesi della formazione, tutti gli specialisti di laboratorio completano la biologia insieme nel laboratorio di formazione Lonza. Successivamente, si procederà a una rotazione di 5-6 mesi ciascuno in varie aree di laboratorio di Lonza, come la ricerca, lo sviluppo, il controllo di qualità e piccole quantità di produzione. Si frequentano lezioni di scuola professionale di uno e mezzo giorno alla settimana durante l'intero apprendistato.

• Interessi di ricerca e sperimentazione

• Buone capacità di osservazione e pensiero in rete

• Competenze motorie

• Lavoro pulito e preciso

• Alta affidabilità

• Interessato a trattare dispositivi elettronici e attrezzature complesse

descriptionByLocale.en:
Lonza is today a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

At the Visp site, an apprentice laboratory technician is sought. As laboratories, we work in a team under the responsibility of biologists or chemists in the areas of research, development, quality control and small quantities of production. Tasks such as developing biotechnological processes, monitoring cells on a small scale, cleaning and controlling products with specialized devices are also included. For professionals in a pharmaceutical company, the constant compliance with the given safety and labor regulations is commonplace. The exact documentation of the work steps and evaluation of the results on the computer is of great importance. They work with researchers from different countries and therefore often communicate in English.

Your education
The teaching lasts three years. The first 6 months of the training, all laboratory specialists complete biology together in the Lonza training laboratory. Afterwards, you will go on a rotation of 5-6 months each in various laboratory areas of Lonza, such as research, development, quality control and small quantities of production. You attend vocational school lessons on one and a half days a week during the entire apprenticeship.

Your profile

• Interest in research and experimentation

• Good observation skills and networked thinking

• Fine motor skills

• Clean and accurate work

• High reliability

• Interested in dealing with electronic devices and complex equipment

• Very good knowledge of German (minimum B2 level)

We offer
At Lonza, we firmly believe that in addition to learning a profession, personal development from day one is important. We therefore train our learners not only as qualified professionals, but also as independent personalities. This enables you to make a promising start to your career.

Vous contrôlez et surveillez les usines de fabrication automatisées pour la production d'ingrédients actifs pour les médicaments, les produits chimiques fins ou les produits phytopharmaceutiques. Souvent vous travaillez en équipe, parce que plusieurs personnes sont nécessaires pour les activités de processus. Mais aussi des travaux qui doivent être effectués à la main, comme la préparation de produits chimiques, le remplissage, l'échantillonnage et la préparation du produit sont nécessaires. En cas de déviation ou de perturbation, vous prenez immédiatement les mesures nécessaires. En plus de la production, les pièces de l'usine sont nettoyées, des contrôles fonctionnels et des travaux d'entretien mineurs sont effectués.

Votre éducation
L'enseignement dure trois ans. La formation pratique est complétée par des spécialistes en chimie et en pharmacotechnologie dans plusieurs entreprises de production de l'industrie chimique, biotechnologique ou pharmaceutique. Lonza is today a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

At the Visp site, an apprentice plant and apparatus manufacturer is sought. As a plant and apparatus manufacturer at Lonza, you produce different products based on technical drawings. You mainly process various sheets, profiles and pipes. You combine them into components, containers, pipe systems or apparatus, which are then integrated into systems and plants. In addition, you take over the associated assembly, repair and repair work.
In the training workshop, the different techniques can be practiced on the different materials in order to later prepare the product correctly for the respective customer from production.

Your education
Plant and apparatus manufacturers* are trained for 4 years in teaching and specialist workshops with up to two days of vocational school visit per week.
During the basic training in the first half, knowledge and skills with a focus on sheet metal, metal profile and pipe processing will be applied through traditional tools as well as training on computer-controlled bending machines, welding robots and laser cutting equipment.
In the second half, there will be a focus training in operational areas of activity and specialist workshops, with deepening of expertise through practical learning projects for Lonza.

From the third year of apprenticeship, you will specialize in one of the different disciplines:

• Design technology

• Tube construction technology

• Welding technique

Your profile

• Interest in technical contexts and craftsmanship

• Good spatial imagination

• Good technical understanding

• Reliable, independent work

• No allergies to metals, fats and oils

• Teamwork

• Very good knowledge of German (minimum B2 level)

We offer
At Lonza, we firmly believe that in addition to learning a profession, personal development from day one is important. We therefore train our learners not only as qualified professionals, but also as independent personalities. This enables you to make a promising start to your career.

• Professional trainers*

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

We are hiring (Senior) Program Managers to join our Integrated Biologics organization. In this role, you’ll be the main link between Lonza and our customers, leading cross-functional teams through the full project lifecycle—from contract to GMP manufacturing and delivery.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:

• Lead and deliver customer programs across their full lifecycle—from technology transfer to GMP manufacturing and project closure—ensuring quality, timelines, and cost-effectiveness.

• Act as a trusted partner and main point of contact for customers, fostering transparent communication and long-term collaboration.

• Inspire and coordinate diverse, cross-functional teams in a matrix environment, promoting shared ownership and high performance.

• Drive program success by managing scope, timelines, and financials, while aligning with strategic business goals.

• Collaborate across functions to manage scope changes, support commercial strategies, and contribute to future opportunities.

• Identify and address risks proactively, ensuring smooth issue resolution and continuous improvement.

• Mentor and support team members, fostering a culture of learning, inclusion, and professional development.

What we are looking for:

• Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, or a related field; PhD is a plus.

• Experience in project or program management, ideally in pharma or CDMO.

Lonza Ltd. offre un stage commercial dans l'équipe HR Operations Switzerland pour soutenir le département. Pendant le stage, vous aurez un aperçu des activités quotidiennes d'une entreprise active internationale et des activités du département Ressources humaines. Tout au long de votre stage, vous supporterez les tâches administratives sur une base quotidienne, et vous aurez la possibilité de contribuer en tant que membre actif de notre équipe.

C'est un premier rôle de bureau. Travailler ensemble en personne soutient une collaboration étroite en temps réel et l'alignement de l'équipe, ce qui nous permet de réaliser notre meilleur travail. Vous travaillerez principalement au bureau, avec la flexibilité de travailler à distance pour 20% de votre temps (un jour par semaine).

Ce que vous obtiendrez :

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.

• Divers avantages dépendent du rôle et de l'emplacement.

Ce que vous ferez :

• Les membres de l'équipe de soutien avec toutes les activités administratives du processus d'embarquement pour les nouveaux débutants.

• Gérer les tâches liées au cycle de vie des employés, y compris le processus de sortie, afin de garantir des transitions harmonieuses.

• Coopérer étroitement avec les partenaires RH, y compris les recruteurs et les partenaires opérationnels RH.

• Coordonner les événements mensuels pour les nouveaux employés.

• Gérer les tâches administratives générales, comme le traitement des frais d'entrevue et la gestion des demandes spontanées.

Ce que nous cherchons:

• Un excellent coéquipier avec une capacité éprouvée de collaborer efficacement au sein d'équipes diverses.

• Intérêt véritable pour les RH, avec un désir d'apprendre et de grandir dans le domaine.

• Automotivé avec des compétences exceptionnelles en administration et en organisation.

• Excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite, avec maîtrise de l'allemand et bonne connaissance de l'anglais.

• Attention méticuleuse au détail et à la capacité de travailler avec précision.

• Fortes compétences interpersonnelles et face à la clientèle, améliorant l'expérience globale des employés.

• Flexibilité et empressement à acquérir de nouvelles connaissances et à s'adapter aux nouveaux défis.

• Compétence en logiciel Microsoft Office.

• L'engagement à contribuer à un environnement de travail positif et inclusif.

À propos de Lonza
À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.

L'innovation prospère lorsque les gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous nous réjouissons de vous accueillir à bord.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

jobs.description:
Umzugsunterstützung: Verfügbar für berechtigte Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten sowie deren Familien.

Als Automation Technician / Automatiker / Elektriker (m/w/d) an unserem sterilen Produktionsstandort in Stein, Kanton Aargau, spielst du eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Sicherstellung eines zuverlässigen, sicheren und GMP-konformen Betriebs unserer Produktionsanlagen, Versorgungsanlagen und technischen Systeme. Ob dein Hintergrund in der Automatisierungs- oder Elektrotechnik liegt – mit deinem technischen Know-how unterstützt du die Wartung, Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung unserer hochautomatisierten Anlagen und trägst damit direkt zur Herstellung lebenswichtiger Medikamente bei.

Was auf Dich wartet:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen.

Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Dich zahlreiche Vorteile für Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Unsere vollständige Liste der lokalen Benefits findest Du unten:

• Benefits in Stein: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

Deine Aufgaben:

• Durchführung von Wartungs-, Instandhaltungs- und Reparaturarbeiten an Produktionsanlagen, technischen Versorgungssystemen sowie gebäudetechnischen Einrichtungen

• Fehleranalyse und Störungsbehebung an elektrischen, elektromechanischen und automatisierten Anlagen zur Sicherstellung einer hohen Anlagenverfügbarkeit

• Unterstützung bei FAT-, SAT-, Commissioning-, Qualifizierungs- und Inbetriebnahmeaktivitäten neuer Anlagen und Automatisierungssysteme

• Betreuung und Optimierung von SPS-Steuerungen, Sensorik, Aktorik sowie Prozessleitsystemen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Produktion, Engineering und Maintenance

• Durchführung und Dokumentation vorbeugender Wartungsmassnahmen gemäss GMP-, Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsanforderungen

• Mitarbeit in Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Anlagenperformance, Betriebssicherheit und Effizienz sowie Sicherstellung der Ersatzteilverfügbarkeit

• Schulung von Mitarbeitenden und Unterstützung bei technischen Aufgaben als polyvalenter Techniker innerhalb des Betriebs

Dein Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung als Automatiker EFZ, Automatiktechniker, Elektroinstallateur EFZ oder vergleichbare Fachausbildung

• Berufserfahrung in der Instandhaltung von Produktionsanlagen, idealerweise in der Pharma-, Biotech-, Chemie- oder Lebensmittelindustrie

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, SPS-Steuerungen und industrieller Messtechnik

• Erfahrung im GMP-regulierten Umfeld sowie Kenntnisse relevanter Sicherheits- und Qualitätsanforderungen von Vorteil

• Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägtem technischem Verständnis

• Teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit Freude an einer vielseitigen technischen Allrounder-Funktion

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil; NIV 13 ist ein Plus

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.
Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen.

Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten?

descriptionByLocale.it:
Supporto di trasferimento: Disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie.

In qualità di ingegnere tecnico/automatico/elettricista (m/f/d) presso il nostro sito di produzione sterile a Stein, Canton Aargau, svolgete un ruolo decisivo nel garantire un funzionamento affidabile, sicuro e conforme a GMP dei nostri impianti di produzione, impianti di fornitura e sistemi tecnici. Che si tratti di automazione o ingegneria elettrica – con il tuo know-how tecnico supporti la manutenzione, l'ottimizzazione e l'ulteriore sviluppo dei nostri sistemi altamente automatizzati e quindi contribuisca direttamente alla produzione di medicinali vitali.

Cosa ti aspetta:

• Una cura Agile e cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi vantaggi per lo stile di vita, la famiglia e il tempo libero. Trova la nostra lista completa dei vantaggi locali Di seguito:

• Vantaggi in pietra: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

I vostri compiti:

• Realizzazione di lavori di manutenzione, manutenzione e riparazione di impianti di produzione, sistemi di approvvigionamento tecnico e servizi di costruzione

• Analisi dei guasti e risoluzione dei problemi dei sistemi elettrici, elettromeccanici e automatizzati per garantire elevata disponibilità degli impianti

• Supporto per le attività di FAT, SAT, commissioning, qualificazione e messa in servizio di nuovi impianti e sistemi di automazione

• Supporto e ottimizzazione dei controlli PLC, sensori, attuatori e sistemi di controllo dei processi in stretta collaborazione con produzione, ingegneria e manutenzione

• Attuazione e documentazione delle misure di manutenzione preventiva secondo GMP, requisiti di qualità e sicurezza

• Cooperazione nei progetti volti a migliorare continuamente le prestazioni degli impianti, la sicurezza operativa e l'efficienza nonché a garantire la disponibilità dei pezzi di ricambio

• Formazione dei dipendenti e supporto nei compiti tecnici come tecnico polivalente all'interno dell'azienda

Il vostro profilo di requisito:

• Formazione tecnica completa come ingegnere automatico (EFZ), tecnico automatico, installatore elettrico (EFZ) o formazione tecnica equivalente

• Esperienza professionale nel mantenimento di impianti di produzione, idealmente nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico, chimico o alimentare

• Conoscenza approfondita dell'ingegneria elettrica, tecnologia di automazione, sistemi di controllo PLC e tecnologia di misura industriale

• Esperienza nell'ambiente regolamentato GMP e conoscenza dei requisiti di sicurezza e qualità rilevanti

• Metodo di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione con una forte comprensione tecnica

• Personalità orientata al team con piacere in una versatile funzione tecnica del tuttofare

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese è vantaggioso; NIV 13 è un plus

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra massima forza. In più di 30 sedi in cinque continenti, i nostri team di rete a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali: collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, ed è quello che vogliamo che tu condividi.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di diversa provenienza portano nelle loro prospettive uniche. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo in un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti a tradurre le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita?
Applicare ora

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Relocation support: Available for eligible candidates and their families.

As an Automation Technician / Automatic Engineer / Electrician (m/f/d) at our sterile production site in Stein, Canton Aargau, you play a decisive role in ensuring reliable, safe and GMP-compliant operation of our production facilities, supply facilities and technical systems. Whether your background lies in automation or electrical engineering – with your technical know-how you support the maintenance, optimization and further development of our highly automated systems and thus directly contribute to the production of vital medicines.

What is waiting for you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical working environment

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits for lifestyle, family and leisure. Find our full list of local benefits You below:

• Benefits in stone: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

Your tasks:

• Carrying out maintenance, maintenance and repair work on production facilities, technical supply systems and building services

• Fault analysis and troubleshooting of electrical, electromechanical and automated systems to ensure high plant availability

• Support for FAT, SAT, commissioning, qualification and commissioning activities of new plants and automation systems

• Support and optimization of PLC controls, sensors, actuators and process control systems in close cooperation with production, engineering and maintenance

• Implementation and documentation of preventive maintenance measures in accordance with GMP, quality and safety requirements

• Cooperation in projects to continuously improve plant performance, operational safety and efficiency as well as ensuring spare parts availability

• Training of employees and support in technical tasks as a polyvalent technician within the company

Your requirement profile:

• Completed technical training as an automatic engineer (EFZ), automatic technician, electrical installer (EFZ) or equivalent technical training

• Professional experience in the maintenance of production facilities, ideally in the pharmaceutical, biotech, chemical or food industry

• In-depth knowledge in electrical engineering, automation technology, PLC control systems and industrial measurement technology

• Experience in the GMP-regulated environment as well as knowledge of relevant safety and quality requirements

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented working method with a strong technical understanding

• Team-oriented personality with pleasure in a versatile technical all-rounder function

• Very good knowledge of German and English is advantageous; NIV 13 is a plus

About Lonza
At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.
Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences?
Apply now

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

We are looking to recruit a Manufacturing Lead (Director) to build up the operations organization for the Payload-Linker capacity expansion in Visp.  Leads a team of  production leaders, supervisors and specialists You will manage the operational readiness and provide leadership to the CQ-project team incl. the post OQ Start-up within the investment / Capex Project. After becoming operational, you will oversee the operational activities of the manufacturing unit with overall responsibility of manufacturing execution regarding safety, quality and on-time-in full delivery, as well as for the performance and results of the assigned area including cost control.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Lead a team of production managers (chemists/chemical engineers), supervisors, and specialists, with full responsibility for all aspects of people management, including qualification, development, coaching, hiring, compensation decisions, and performance or conduct issues.

• Manage the operational readiness within the CAPEX project and provide leadership to the CQ-project team incl. the post OQ Start-up

• Accountable for executing all production campaigns in the manufacturing unit, ensuring compliance with safety, quality, and environmental requirements.

• Maintain oversight of production costs and provide POV forecasts for all campaigns within the area of responsibility. Contribute to budgeting and the preparation of product cost calculations for standard pricing.

• As a member of the Functional Leadership Team, support overall production management, including housekeeping, team conduct, training activities, and general operational controls.

• Serve as an operational specialist and regular point of contact for BU team members on production planning (S&OP), technical assessments, and feasibility requests.

• Responsible for routine performance monitoring, including weekly reports, dashboards, Hoshin boards, and other reporting tools.

What we are looking for:

• Advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, or equivalent) in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.

• Demonstrated leadership skills with strong self-motivation, integrity, perseverance, and results orientation.

• Extensive experience in chemical manufacturing in the pharmaceutical industry, in leadership roles.

• Strong knowledge of GMP and EHS requirements.

• Fluency in English, German is an advantage

• Experience with Operational Excellence / LEAN principles is an advantage.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. As a Mechanical Technician (m/f/d) at our sterile production site in Stein, Canton Aargau, you will become part of our production team and contribute significantly to the reliable and compliant production of sterile liquid and freeze-drying products. In this role, you make an important contribution to technical excellence, operational stability and continuous improvement while always ensuring compliance with all GMP and regulatory requirements.

What is waiting for you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical working environment

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• Benefits in stone: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

Your tasks:

• Production of sterile products (liquid and lyophilized vials) under GMP-compliant and aseptic conditions, including independent aseptic abrasion

• Construction, dismantling and qualification of filling and production equipment, including mechanical activities under clean room conditions

• Ensuring technical monitoring of production equipment, process monitoring, support during troubleshooting and function as a specialist for complex topics on the filling line

• Execution of mechanical tasks such as installation and de-installation of movable equipment, loading and unloading of freeze dryers and carrying out filter integrity tests

• GMP-compliant documentation in MES, logbooks and forms, including reporting of deviations and cooperation in root-cause analyses

• Support for preventive maintenance, unplanned repairs and participation in continuous improvement initiatives

• Implementation of microbiological environmental monitoring, in-process controls and support for the training of new team members

Your requirement profile:

• Completed mechanical or technical vocational training (e.g. mechatronics, building technology, polymechanics) or equivalent qualification with a strong technical understanding

• Experience in sterile production as well as sound process understanding, e.g. in batch production, filling or visual inspection

• Ability to operate complex automated systems; Knowledge of MES and SAP is an advantage

• Careful, reliable and quality-oriented working method combined with a high level of initiative and teamwork

• Willingness to work flexible hours, shifts and participation in the piketting service

• Very good knowledge of German; English skills are desired

• Strong awareness of GMP, EHS and compliance requirements

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.
Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. jobs.description:
Location: the actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

The QA Infrastructure and Logistics group provides key QA oversight and support for the Switzerland-VISP site. This group supports the site utilities, warehousing, and movement of raw materials and products in and out of facilities.

This position will focus on implementing and managing robust cross-functional support of legacy and new facilities. You will be responsible for assuring Quality Assurance of Lonza’s sites and facilities, whilst ensuring shared utility systems and logistics areas are carried out by Lonza's standards, industry best practices, and the requirements of national and international regulatory agencies.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.
Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Provide QA support for Project and Operations internal customers in the following areas: GMP & Compliance, Cold-chain, supply chain, good warehousing practice, and Clean utilities.

• Provide Quality Assurance oversight to the site and facilities focusing on shared utility systems and logistics areas.

• Organize and lead Deviation Review Boards for Utilities & Logistics related deviations.

• Review and assess Change Requests and Corrective and Preventative Actions (CAPA).

• Review and approve standard operation procedures for shared utility systems and logistics.

• Review and assess GMP impact of utility and cold-chain alarms and incidents.

• Assist with operational readiness activities and assess their risks in the relevant areas.

• Support internal and external audits, and inspections and represent the Quality function at relevant meetings.

• Leads or supports local implementation of global Quality policies and standards in his/her area of responsibility.

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences/ Biochemistry or Supply Chain/Logistics or related field.

• Relevant work experience in Quality Assurance and/or Production/Supply Chain/Logistics and/or Quality Control in pharmaceutical industries and cGMP-controlled environments.

• Knowledge of Swiss, EU, and US GMP regulations relevant to audit/inspections and compliance systems.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills (English required, German is an advantage).

• Ability to communicate quality and compliance requirements to varying levels and functions of the organization.

• Strong collaborative mindset and the ability to build relationships quickly.

• Strong organizational skills, and ability to balance multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Ability to solve problems, understand details and strategic picture, providing practical solutions.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Posizione: la posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Visp, Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.

Il gruppo QA Infrastructure and Logistics fornisce la supervisione e il supporto QA chiave per il sito Svizzera-VISP. Questo gruppo supporta le utilità del sito, il deposito e il movimento di materie prime e prodotti in e fuori strutture.

Questa posizione si concentrerà sull'implementazione e la gestione di un robusto supporto interfunzionale dell'eredità e delle nuove strutture. Sarete responsabili della garanzia della qualità dei siti e delle strutture di Lonza, assicurando al contempo i sistemi di utilità e le aree logistiche condivise sono effettuati dagli standard di Lonza, dalle best practice del settore e dai requisiti delle agenzie di regolamentazione nazionali e internazionali.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero. La nostra lista completa di benefici locali su misura può essere trovata di seguito.
Vantaggi in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Cosa farai:

• Fornire il supporto QA per i clienti interni di Project and Operations nelle seguenti aree: GMP & Compliance, Cold-chain, supply chain, buona pratica di warehousing e utilità Clean.

• Fornire la supervisione di qualità al sito e alle strutture che si concentrano su sistemi di utilità condivisi e aree logistiche.

• Organizzare e guidare i comitati di valutazione della deviazione per le deviazioni relative ai servizi di utilità e logistica.

• Verificare e valutare le richieste di cambiamento e le azioni correttive e preventive (CAPA).

• Revisione e approvazione delle procedure di funzionamento standard per sistemi di utilità condivisa e logistica.

• Verificare e valutare l'impatto GMP di utilità e allarmi e incidenti a catena fredda.

• Assistere con le attività di prontezza operativa e valutare i loro rischi nei settori interessati.

• Sostenere gli audit interni ed esterni e le ispezioni e rappresentare la funzione Qualità nelle riunioni pertinenti.

• Guida o supporta l'implementazione locale di politiche e standard di qualità globali nel suo settore di responsabilità.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Laurea accademica in Scienze Farmaceutiche/ Biochimica o Supply Chain/Logistica o campo relativo.

• Esperienza lavorativa rilevante nell'assicurazione della qualità e/o nella catena/logistica e/o nel controllo della qualità nelle industrie farmaceutiche e negli ambienti controllati da cGMP.

• Conoscenza delle normative GMP svizzere, UE e USA relative ai sistemi di audit/ispezione e conformità.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta (obbligatorio inglese, tedesco è un vantaggio).

• Capacità di comunicare requisiti di qualità e conformità a vari livelli e funzioni dell'organizzazione.

• Forte mentalità collaborativa e la capacità di costruire rapidamente le relazioni.

• Forte capacità organizzative e capacità di bilanciare più priorità contemporaneamente.

• Capacità di risolvere problemi, comprendere dettagli e quadro strategico, fornendo soluzioni pratiche.

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, il nostro popolo è la nostra più grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.
Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applica ora.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Standort: Der tatsächliche Standort dieses Jobs befindet sich in Visp, Schweiz. Umzugshilfe ist für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien zur Verfügung, wenn nötig.

Die QA Infrastructure and Logistics Group bietet wichtige QA-Aufsicht und Unterstützung für den Standort Switzerland-VISP. Diese Gruppe unterstützt die Dienstprogramme, die Lagerhaltung und den Transport von Rohstoffen und Produkten in und aus Einrichtungen.

Diese Position wird sich auf die Implementierung und Verwaltung einer robusten funktionsübergreifenden Unterstützung von Altanlagen und neuen Anlagen konzentrieren. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, die Qualitätssicherung der Lonza-Standorte und -Einrichtungen sicherzustellen und gleichzeitig sicherzustellen, dass gemeinsame Versorgungssysteme und Logistikbereiche nach den Standards, den Best Practices der Branche und den Anforderungen nationaler und internationaler Regulierungsbehörden durchgeführt werden.

Was Sie bekommen werden:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz.

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung erkennen.

Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt können Sie zahlreiche Lifestyle-, Familien- und Freizeitvorteile erwarten. Unsere vollständige Liste der maßgeschneiderten lokalen Vorteile finden Sie unten.
Vorteile in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Was Sie tun werden:

• QA-Unterstützung für interne Projekt- und Betriebskunden in den folgenden Bereichen: GMP & Compliance, Cold-Chain, Supply Chain, Good Warehousing Practice und Clean Utilities.

• Bereitstellung einer Qualitätssicherungsaufsicht für den Standort und die Einrichtungen mit Schwerpunkt auf gemeinsamen Versorgungssystemen und Logistikbereichen.

• Organisieren und leiten Sie Deviation Review Boards für Utilities & Logistics-bezogene Abweichungen.

• Überprüfung und Bewertung von Change Requests und Corrective and Preventative Actions (CAPA).

• Überprüfung und Genehmigung von Standardbetriebsverfahren für gemeinsame Versorgungssysteme und Logistik.

• Überprüfen und bewerten Sie die GMP-Auswirkungen von Versorgungs- und Kühlkettenalarmen und -vorfällen.

• Unterstützung bei Aktivitäten zur Einsatzbereitschaft und Bewertung ihrer Risiken in den relevanten Bereichen.

• Unterstützen Sie interne und externe Audits und Inspektionen und vertreten Sie die Qualitätsfunktion bei relevanten Sitzungen.

• Leitet oder unterstützt die lokale Umsetzung globaler Qualitätsrichtlinien und -standards in seinem Verantwortungsbereich.

Was wir suchen:

• Akademischer Abschluss in Pharmazeutischen Wissenschaften / Biochemie oder Supply Chain / Logistik oder verwandten Bereichen.

• Relevante Arbeitserfahrung in der Qualitätssicherung und/oder Produktion/Lieferkette/Logistik und/oder Qualitätskontrolle in der pharmazeutischen Industrie und in cGMP-kontrollierten Umgebungen.

• Kenntnis der schweizerischen, EU- und US-amerikanischen GMP-Vorschriften, die für Audit-/Inspektions- und Compliance-Systeme relevant sind.

• Starke verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten (Englisch erforderlich, Deutsch ist von Vorteil).

• Fähigkeit, Qualitäts- und Compliance-Anforderungen an unterschiedliche Ebenen und Funktionen der Organisation zu kommunizieren.

• Starke kollaborative Denkweise und die Fähigkeit, Beziehungen schnell aufzubauen.

• Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig auszugleichen.

• Fähigkeit, Probleme zu lösen, Details und strategisches Bild zu verstehen und praktische Lösungen zu bieten.

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. Mit mehr als 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere weltweit vernetzten Teams jeden Tag zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Alle Ideen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der Sie teilnehmen sollen.
Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen mit allen Hintergründen ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven auf den Tisch bringen. Bei Lonza legen wir Wert auf Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter zu schaffen. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzuwandeln, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.
Bereit, die Zukunft der Biowissenschaften zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Lieu: l'emplacement réel de ce travail est à Viège, Suisse. L'aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats admissibles et à leur famille, au besoin.

Le groupe Infrastructure et logistique de l'AQ assure la supervision et le soutien clés de l'AQ pour le site Suisse-VISP. Ce groupe soutient les services publics du site, l'entreposage et le mouvement des matières premières et des produits dans et hors des installations.

Ce poste sera axé sur la mise en oeuvre et la gestion d'un solide soutien interfonctionnel des installations existantes et nouvelles. Vous serez chargé d'assurer l'assurance de la qualité des sites et installations de Lonza, tout en veillant à ce que les systèmes d'utilité partagés et les zones logistiques soient réalisés selon les normes de Lonza, les meilleures pratiques de l'industrie et les exigences des organismes de réglementation nationaux et internationaux.

Ce que vous obtiendrez :

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé.

En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreuses prestations de vie de famille et de loisirs. Notre liste complète des prestations locales sur mesure se trouve ci-dessous.
Avantages dans le Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Ce que vous ferez :

• Fournir un soutien en matière d'AQ aux clients internes des projets et des opérations dans les domaines suivants : BPF et conformité, chaîne froide, chaîne d'approvisionnement, bonnes pratiques d'entreposage et services publics propres.

• Assurer la surveillance de l'assurance de la qualité du site et des installations en mettant l'accent sur les systèmes d'utilité partagés et les secteurs logistiques.

• Organiser et diriger les commissions d'examen des écarts pour les services publics et la logistique.

• Examiner et évaluer les demandes de changement et les mesures correctives et préventives.

• Examiner et approuver les procédures d'exploitation normalisées pour les systèmes d'utilité partagée et la logistique.

• Examiner et évaluer l'impact des BPF des alarmes et des incidents de la chaîne du froid et des services publics.

• Aider aux activités de préparation opérationnelle et évaluer leurs risques dans les domaines pertinents.

• Appuyer les audits internes et externes et les inspections et représenter la fonction Qualité aux réunions pertinentes.

• Dirige ou appuie la mise en œuvre au niveau local de politiques et de normes de qualité mondiales dans son domaine de responsabilité.

Ce que nous cherchons :

• Diplôme universitaire en sciences pharmaceutiques/biochimie ou chaîne d'approvisionnement/logistique ou domaine connexe.

• Expérience de travail pertinente dans l'assurance de la qualité et/ou la production/la chaîne d'approvisionnement/la logistique et/ou le contrôle de la qualité dans les industries pharmaceutiques et les environnements contrôlés par cGMP.

• Connaissance de la réglementation suisse, de l'UE et des États-Unis en matière de BPF en matière d'audit/inspections et de systèmes de conformité.

• Forte capacité de communication verbale et écrite (anglais requis, allemand est un avantage).

• Capacité de communiquer les exigences de qualité et de conformité à divers niveaux et fonctions de l'organisation.

• Une solide mentalité collaborative et la capacité d'établir des relations rapidement.

• Des compétences organisationnelles solides et la capacité d'équilibrer simultanément plusieurs priorités.

• Capacité de résoudre les problèmes, de comprendre les détails et l'image stratégique, de fournir des solutions pratiques.

À propos de Lonza
À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites répartis sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et ça, c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.
L'innovation prospère lorsque des gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous avons hâte de vous accueillir à bord.
Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.description:
Umzugsunterstützung steht berechtigen Kandidaten und ihren Familien bei Bedarf zur Verfügung.

Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Für unseren Standort in Visp suchen wir einen Anlagen- und Apparatebauer Rohrbau EFZ.

Was wir dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten dich zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen findest du auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Deine Aufgaben:

• Fachgerechtes und wirtschaftliches Ausmessen, Herstellen und Montieren von anspruchsvollen Rohrleitungen und Stützsystemen im Rohrleitungsbau

• Erstellen von Isometrien und Rohrleitungssegmenten entsprechend den technischen Vorgaben und Projektanforderungen

• Planen und Organisieren der Arbeitsabläufe anhand von R&I‑Fliessbildern,  bei Projektarbeiten und Anlagenanpassungen

• Anwenden von PED‑Richtlinien sowie Arbeiten nach internen Rohrklassen, Werknormen und qualitätssichernden Vorgaben

Dein Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Anlagen- und Apparatebauer EFZ in Rohrleitungsbau, Rohrschlosser, Heizungsmonteur oder Sanitär-Installateur

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Rohrschlosser oder Vorrichter von Vorteil

• Bereitschaft zu kontinuierlicher Weiterbildung

• Freude an abteilungsübergreifender Arbeit sowie selbstständiges und flexibles Arbeiten im Team

• Zuverlässigkeit, Belastbarkeit sowie unternehmerisches Handeln und offene, direkte Kommunikation

• Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!
