jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Based in Visp, the Group Leader Development / MSAT Drug Linker-Toxin will lead the assigned Process Development and/or MSAT chemists working on pipeline development and portfolio optimization of Drug Linker-Toxin products.
You will ensure close alignment between your team and the supported production facilities, while collaborating with the ADS Portfolio Optimization and Pipeline Development organizations. In this role, you will be responsible for the roadmap and strategy for continuous improvement, technical capabilities, and capacity of the assigned Development & MSAT scientist team.
This is a highly visible role for a scientist who wants to combine deep technical expertise with people leadership, customer-facing scientific impact, and strategic contribution to a growing ADC manufacturing organization.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Lead, coordinate, execute, control, and monitor the performance of assigned Drug Linker-Toxin Process Development and/or MSAT chemists in line with agreed objectives and commitments.

• Support the responsible Drug Linker Organization Head, in alignment with the Lab Team Group Leader and lab production managers, in managing and allocating required chemist resources.

• Guide Development and/or MSAT chemists to enable efficient, robust transfer of Drug Linker-Toxin production processes into supported GMP manufacturing facilities.

• Drive the development and implementation of innovative technologies to increase capability, capacity, and efficiency within Drug Linker-Toxin operations.

• Act as a technical and scientific expert for Drug Linker-Toxin projects internally and externally, including creation of external scientific content to enhance reputation and visibility.

• Facilitate the exchange of best practices in Drug Linker-Toxin projects and containment technology across teams and functions.

• Lead all HR-related aspects for the assigned team and actively contribute to the scientific development of scientists in their areas of expertise.

• Ensure compliance with GMP and safety regulations throughout all activities.

• Support the Head of Drug Linker Organization in assigned initiatives and strategic duties.

What we are looking for:

• PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline; PhD in Organic Chemistry preferred.

• Approximately 5-10 years of experience in pharmaceutical process development, API development, clinical supply, or manufacturing sciences.

• Proven experience leading complex projects in a matrix organization within clinical supply, development, or manufacturing operations.

• Strong knowledge of chemical process development, scale-up, technology transfer, and GMP manufacturing requirements.

• Good knowledge of Drug Linker-Toxin technology and understanding of safe work execution in containment assets.

• People management experience or strong motivation to develop into an expanded leadership role, including coaching and talent development.

• Demonstrated experience managing project budgets and delivering against performance targets.

• Fluent English language skills; German proficiency is a strong asset.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

This is a fully site-based role. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• The opportunity to lead a highly skilled, multidisciplinary manufacturing team within a growing biologics manufacturing environment.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace where collaboration and innovation are encouraged.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance and leadership impact.

• Professional development opportunities across a global life sciences organization.

• The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do

• Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team of process engineers, specialists, and manufacturing professionals, fostering a culture of safety, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Take ownership of operational performance within the DSP manufacturing area, ensuring production readiness, execution, and reliable on-time delivery.

• Drive the resolution of manufacturing challenges and complex production issues in close collaboration with MSAT, Production Support, QA, and Upstream Processing teams.

• Provide leadership for risk assessments, workplace inspections, technical change management, and compliance activities within the manufacturing unit.

• Represent the DSP organization during customer interactions, audits, and regulatory inspections, serving as a trusted operational expert.

• Contribute to capital investment projects, including facility design, equipment implementation, startup, and commissioning activities.

• As a member of the Production Leadership Team, champion operational excellence, innovation, employee development, and continuous improvement initiatives across the production organization.

What we are looking for

• Experience leading teams and operations within a GMP-regulated biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment.

• Strong expertise in downstream processing and biologics manufacturing, with knowledge of mammalian cell culture processes.

• Demonstrated ability to build, develop, coach, and engage high-performing technical teams.

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with experience managing complex manufacturing or production challenges.

• Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple functions and communicate confidently with customers, leadership teams, and regulatory inspectors.

• Degree in Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Strong English communication skills, with German an advantage, combined with a structured mindset, initiative, and a team-oriented approach.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Cosa farai

• Guidare e sviluppare un team multidisciplinare di ingegneri di processo, specialisti e professionisti della produzione, promuovendo una cultura di sicurezza, qualità, responsabilità e miglioramento continuo.

• Assumere la proprietà delle prestazioni operative all'interno dell'area di produzione DSP, assicurando la disponibilità di produzione, l'esecuzione e la consegna affidabile in tempo.

• Contribuire a progetti di investimento di capitale, tra cui la progettazione di impianti, l'implementazione di attrezzature, l'avvio e le attività di messa in servizio.

Cosa stiamo cercando

• Esperienza di team e operazioni leader all'interno di un ambiente di produzione biofarmaceutica regolamentato GMP.

• Forte competenza nella lavorazione a valle e nella produzione di biologici, con la conoscenza dei processi di coltura delle cellule mammali.

• Dimostrata capacità di costruire, sviluppare, allenare e coinvolgere team tecnici altamente performanti.

• Forte capacità di problem solving e decision-making, con esperienza di gestione complesse sfide di produzione o di produzione.

• Capacità di collaborare efficacemente attraverso molteplici funzioni e comunicare con fiducia con clienti, team di leadership e ispettori normativi.

• Laurea in Biotecnologia, Bioingegneria, Ingegneria chimica, Chimica, o una disciplina scientifica correlata, o equivalente esperienza rilevante.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione inglese, con tedesco un vantaggio, combinato con una mentalità strutturata, iniziativa e un approccio orientato al team.

Informazioni su Lonza

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti i background portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applica ora.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

L'emplacement réel de ce travail est à Viège, Suisse. Une aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats admissibles et à leur famille, au besoin.

Rejoignez notre équipe grandissante de Solutions IbexTM à Viège et jouez un rôle clé dans la promotion de la fabrication innovante de produits biologiques. En tant que directeur associé, Manufacturing Downstream Processing (DSP), vous dirigerez une équipe opérationnelle hautement performante, stimulerez l'excellence dans la fabrication et contribuerez à la livraison réussie de thérapies qui changent la vie de nos clients et patients dans le monde entier.

C'est un rôle entièrement basé sur le site. Travailler ensemble en personne soutient une collaboration étroite en temps réel et la précision technique nécessaire pour fabriquer des médicaments selon les normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées.

Ce que vous obtiendrez

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.

• L'occasion de diriger une équipe de fabrication multidisciplinaire hautement qualifiée dans un environnement de fabrication de produits biologiques en croissance.

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique où la collaboration et l'innovation sont encouragées.

• Les programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé et l'impact du leadership.

• Possibilités de perfectionnement professionnel dans une organisation mondiale des sciences de la vie.

• La liste complète de nos avantages globaux peut être consultée ici: https://www.lonza.com/careers/bénéfices

Ce que vous ferez

• Diriger et former une équipe multidisciplinaire d'ingénieurs, de spécialistes et de professionnels de la fabrication, en favorisant une culture de sécurité, de qualité, de responsabilité et d'amélioration continue.

• S'approprier la performance opérationnelle dans la zone de fabrication du DSP, en assurant la préparation à la production, l'exécution et la livraison à temps fiable.

• Diriger la résolution des défis de fabrication et des problèmes de production complexes en étroite collaboration avec les équipes MSAT, Support de production, QA et Upstream Processing.

• Diriger les évaluations des risques, les inspections en milieu de travail, la gestion du changement technique et les activités de conformité au sein de l'unité de fabrication.

• Représenter l'organisation du PSD pendant les interactions avec les clients, les vérifications et les inspections réglementaires, en servant d'expert opérationnel de confiance.

• Contribuer à des projets d'investissement, y compris la conception d'installations, la mise en oeuvre de l'équipement, le démarrage et les activités de mise en service.

• En tant que membre de l'équipe de leadership de la production, championne de l'excellence opérationnelle, de l'innovation, du perfectionnement des employés et des initiatives d'amélioration continue dans l'ensemble de l'organisation de production.

Ce que nous cherchons

• Expérience des équipes et des opérations de premier plan dans un environnement de fabrication biopharmaceutique réglementé par les BPF.

• Une solide expertise dans le traitement en aval et la fabrication de produits biologiques, avec une connaissance des processus de culture cellulaire des mammifères.

• Capacité démontrée de créer, de développer, d'entraîner et d'engager des équipes techniques performantes.

• Fortes capacités de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décisions, avec une expérience de gestion des défis complexes de fabrication ou de production.

• Capacité de collaborer efficacement à plusieurs fonctions et de communiquer en toute confiance avec les clients, les équipes de direction et les inspecteurs réglementaires.

• Diplôme en biotechnologie, bioingénierie, génie chimique, chimie, ou une discipline scientifique connexe, ou une expérience pertinente équivalente.

• Fortes compétences de communication anglaise, avec un avantage allemand, combiné à une mentalité structurée, une initiative, et une approche axée sur l'équipe.

À propos de Lonza

À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites répartis sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.

L'innovation prospère lorsque des gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous avons hâte de vous accueillir à bord.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

Si nécessaire, un soutien est offert aux candidats admissibles et à leur famille lorsqu'ils déménagent.

Lonza est aujourd'hui un leader mondial des sciences de la vie, opérant sur trois continents. Nous travaillons dans la science, mais il n'y a pas de formule magique pour notre approche du travail. Notre solution scientifique la plus importante est les employés talentueux qui collaborent et développent des idées qui aident d'autres entreprises à aider les gens. En retour, nos employés dirigent leur carrière de façon indépendante. Parce que leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie !

En tant que Scientist Sterility Testing QC, vous faites partie de la microbiologie de contrôle de la qualité au site de Visp et soutenez divers projets de QC en mettant l'accent sur les activités de test et de vérification de la stérilité dans l'environnement des BPF. Ils travaillent dans un environnement dynamique et hautement réglementé et apportent une contribution importante à la qualité et à la sécurité de nos produits.

Ce que nous vous offrons:

• Une carrière agile dans une entreprise de sciences de la vie de renommée internationale.

• Un environnement de travail inclusif, éthique et diversifié.

• Programmes de rémunération et de reconnaissance fondés sur les résultats

• Beaucoup d'avantages attrayants.

Leurs tâches:

• Collaboration à des projets de microbiologie du QC, l'accent étant mis sur les tests de stérilité et la vérification.

• Effectuer des vérifications et des tests de stérilité de routine sur les produits pharmaceutiques.

• Collecte, analyse et évaluation des données de vérification

• Identification et évaluation des vulnérabilités ainsi que planification, mise en oeuvre et suivi des mesures correctives.

• Établissement de plans de vérification, de rapports et de documents techniques.

• Coopération en matière de mise au point et de vérification des méthodes

• Appui à d'autres ministères pour les questions liées à la qualité.

• Coopération dans l'organisation des laboratoires (par exemple gestion des matériaux, nettoyage hebdomadaire des laboratoires).

• Soutien actif de continu. Processus d'amélioration au sein de QC Microbiologie.

Ce que nous cherchons

• Études terminées dans le domaine des sciences (BSc/MSc/PhD) portant sur la microbiologie, la biologie ou une qualification comparable.

• Expérience professionnelle dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, idéalement dans le domaine de la microbiologie / biocharge.

• L'expérience avec les systèmes logiciels de QC tels que MODA, LIMS, TrackWise ou systèmes similaires est avantageuse.

• L'expérience des systèmes d'isolation et de leur qualification est souhaitable.

• La connaissance des BPF est bénéfique.

• L'expérience dans le développement des méthodes est avantageuse.

• Méthode de travail indépendante, fiable et soucieuse de la qualité.

• Profitez de travailler dans un environnement dynamique et réglementé

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais.

À propos de Lonza :

À Lonza, nos employés sont notre plus grande force. Dans plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes en réseau mondial travaillent tous les jours pour produire les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales : collaboration, responsabilité, excellence, passion et intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est ce que nous voulons que vous partagez.

L'innovation prospère lorsque des personnes de différents horizons apportent leurs perspectives uniques. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à traduire nos clients en thérapies viables, nous sommes impatients de vous accueillir à bord.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Appliquer maintenant

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

titleByLocale.fr: Global Category Manager Fournitures de laboratoire 80-100 (h/f/d)

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Tower, Switzerland.

As Global Category Manager Laboratory Supplies, you will play a key role in shaping global sourcing strategies that support research, development and manufacturing activities across Lonza. You will collaborate with stakeholders across the business to drive value, strengthen supplier partnerships and ensure reliable access to critical laboratory supplies and services.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:

• Develop and implement global category and sourcing strategies for laboratory supplies, equipment and related services

• Lead sourcing initiatives, supplier negotiations and contracting activities to deliver value, improve service and reduce risk

• Partner with stakeholders across R&D, Quality, Manufacturing, Finance and Operations to align procurement strategies with business needs

• Build and maintain a pipeline of cost savings and value creation opportunities, ensuring accurate forecasting and tracking

• Manage strategic supplier relationships and drive performance through governance, business reviews and continuous improvement initiatives

• Monitor market trends, supplier capabilities and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for innovation and optimization

• Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements and risk management standards across the category.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor or Master Degree in Economics / Supply Chain Management / Procurement or a related field

• Extensive experience within category management, strategic sourcing or procurement within the pharma or life sciences industry or comparable industry

• Proven ability to lead complex sourcing initiatives and deliver measurable business value

• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to build partnerships and influence decision-making

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, combined with a customer-focused mindset

• Fluency in English is required

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Esperienza estesa all'interno della gestione delle categorie, approvvigionamento strategico o approvvigionamento all'interno dell'industria farmaceutica o delle scienze biologiche o industria comparabile

• Capacità comprovata di condurre complesse iniziative di approvvigionamento e fornire valore commerciale misurabile

• Forte capacità di gestione degli stakeholder con la capacità di costruire partenariati e influenzare il processo decisionale

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e negoziazione

• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving, combinato con una mentalità focalizzata sul cliente

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

• Überwachen Sie Markttrends, Lieferantenfähigkeiten und neue Technologien, um Innovationsmöglichkeiten und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Unternehmensrichtlinien, regulatorischen Anforderungen und Risikomanagementstandards in der gesamten Kategorie.

Was wir suchen:

• Bachelor oder Master in Wirtschaft / Supply Chain Management / Beschaffung oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Umfangreiche Erfahrung im Category Management, Strategic Sourcing oder Einkauf in der Pharma- oder Life-Science-Branche oder vergleichbaren Branche

• Bewährte Fähigkeit, komplexe Sourcing-Initiativen zu leiten und messbaren Geschäftswert zu liefern

• Starke Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management mit der Fähigkeit, Partnerschaften aufzubauen und Entscheidungen zu beeinflussen

• Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten

• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten, kombiniert mit einer kundenorientierten Denkweise

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. Mit mehr als 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere weltweit vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Kernwerte Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Alle Ideen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der Sie teilnehmen sollen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen mit allen Hintergründen ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza legen wir Wert auf Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter zu schaffen. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzuwandeln, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Biowissenschaften zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join Lonza's growing Biologics organization in Visp and play a key role in ensuring the highest standards of equipment cleaning and contamination control for innovative bioconjugate manufacturing processes. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the production of life-changing therapies while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

This is a fully site-based role. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

What you will do

• Lead and coordinate GMP investigations related to cleaning.

• Own end-to-end cleaning deviation management, from investigation and root cause analysis to impact assessment, documentation, and timely closure, while driving CAPAs and continuous improvements to enhance process robustness and operational performance.

• Review manufacturing data, electronic batch records, process parameters, equipment logs, and analytical results to support deviation investigations and product impact assessments.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, MSAT, Engineering, Validation, and QC to resolve complex operational and GMP issues.

• Support regulatory inspections, customer audits, and internal audits by presenting investigation outcomes, CAPA strategies, and quality system effectiveness.

• Provide coaching and guidance to manufacturing personnel on deviation reporting, investigation practices, GMP documentation, and quality culture.

• Contribute to process monitoring, risk management activities, and operational excellence projects to improve compliance, productivity, and process reliability.

What we are looking for

• Degree in Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Biochemical Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD).

• Experience in biopharmaceutical, biotechnology, or GMP-regulated manufacturing environments, particularly in upstream or downstream processing.

• Understanding of equipment cleaning, cleaning validation, contamination control, or related process engineering activities.

• Knowledge of GMP requirements, quality systems, and manufacturing documentation practices.

• Familiarity with USP/DSP equipment and process equipment design within biotechnology production environments.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple functions and stakeholders.

• A structured, solution-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous improvement, learning, and driving operational excellence.

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. descriptionByLocale.it:
Ingegnere di bioprocesso, esperto di pulizia

Ubicazione: Visp, Svizzera

Supporto di trasferimento disponibile

La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Visp, in Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.
Unisciti alla crescente organizzazione di Biologics di Lonza a Visp e gioca un ruolo chiave nel garantire i più elevati standard di pulizia e controllo della contaminazione delle apparecchiature per i processi produttivi innovativi di bioconjugate. Questa è un'opportunità emozionante per contribuire alla produzione di terapie che cambiano la vita, mentre guida l'eccellenza operativa e il miglioramento continuo.

Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.
Che cosa si otterrà

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

• Una varietà di vantaggi dipende dal ruolo e dalla posizione.

Cosa farai

• Guidare e migliorare continuamente le strategie di pulizia e i concetti per le apparecchiature di processo all'interno dell'area di produzione assegnata.

• Condurre valutazioni dei rischi per la pulizia dei prodotti nuovi e esistenti, implementando controlli adeguati per garantire la qualità del prodotto e la sicurezza dei pazienti.

• Supporta le operazioni di produzione GMP attraverso la supervisione esperta dei processi di pulizia delle attrezzature, delle attività di indagine e della risoluzione dei problemi.

• Preparare, rivedere e mantenere la documentazione di produzione, record di lotti elettronici, deviazioni, controlli di cambiamento e CAPAs relativi alle attività di pulizia.

• Assicurarsi che i processi di pulizia rimangano qualificati, convalidati e conformi durante il loro ciclo di vita in conformità con i requisiti GMP e le procedure del sito.

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Validation e altri stakeholder interfunzionali, rappresentando l'area durante le verifiche e le visite dei clienti.

• Guidare l'innovazione e progetti di miglioramento continuo e fornire formazione e coaching agli operatori sulle procedure correlate alla pulizia, comprese le attività di swabbing e ispezione visiva.

Cosa stiamo cercando

• Laurea in Biotecnologia, Biochimica, Ingegneria Biochimica, Scienze della Vita, o una disciplina scientifica correlata (Bachelor's, Masters, o PhD).

• Esperienza in ambienti di produzione biofarmaceutici, biotecnologici o regolamentati da GMP, in particolare nella lavorazione a monte o a valle.

• Comprensione della pulizia delle attrezzature, della validazione delle pulizie, del controllo della contaminazione o delle relative attività di ingegneria dei processi.

• Conoscenza dei requisiti GMP, sistemi di qualità e pratiche di documentazione di produzione.

• Familiarità con le attrezzature USP/DSP e progettazione di apparecchiature di processo all'interno di ambienti di produzione di biotecnologie.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in più funzioni e stakeholder.

• Una mentalità strutturata e orientata alla soluzione con la passione per il miglioramento continuo, l'apprendimento e la guida dell'eccellenza operativa.

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. descriptionByLocale.en:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join Lonza's growing Biologics organization in Visp and play a key role in ensuring the highest standards of equipment cleaning and contamination control for innovative bioconjugate manufacturing processes. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the production of life-changing therapies while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

This is a fully site-based role. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

What you will do

• Lead and coordinate GMP investigations related to cleaning.

• Own end-to-end cleaning deviation management, from investigation and root cause analysis to impact assessment, documentation, and timely closure, while driving CAPAs and continuous improvements to enhance process robustness and operational performance.

• Review manufacturing data, electronic batch records, process parameters, equipment logs, and analytical results to support deviation investigations and product impact assessments.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, MSAT, Engineering, Validation, and QC to resolve complex operational and GMP issues.

• Support regulatory inspections, customer audits, and internal audits by presenting investigation outcomes, CAPA strategies, and quality system effectiveness.

• Provide coaching and guidance to manufacturing personnel on deviation reporting, investigation practices, GMP documentation, and quality culture.

• Contribute to process monitoring, risk management activities, and operational excellence projects to improve compliance, productivity, and process reliability.

What we are looking for

• Degree in Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Biochemical Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD).

• Experience in biopharmaceutical, biotechnology, or GMP-regulated manufacturing environments, particularly in upstream or downstream processing.

• Understanding of equipment cleaning, cleaning validation, contamination control, or related process engineering activities.

• Knowledge of GMP requirements, quality systems, and manufacturing documentation practices.

• Familiarity with USP/DSP equipment and process equipment design within biotechnology production environments.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple functions and stakeholders.

• A structured, solution-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous improvement, learning, and driving operational excellence.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Standort: Visp, Schweiz

Relocation Support verfügbar

Treten Sie der wachsenden Biologics-Organisation von Lonza in Visp bei und spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gewährleistung der höchsten Standards für die Reinigung und Kontaminationskontrolle von Geräten für innovative biokonjugierte Herstellungsprozesse. Dies ist eine aufregende Gelegenheit, zur Produktion lebensverändernder Therapien beizutragen und gleichzeitig die operative Exzellenz und kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu fördern.

Dies ist eine vollständig site-basierte Rolle. Die persönliche Zusammenarbeit unterstützt eine enge Echtzeit-Zusammenarbeit und die technische Präzision, die erforderlich ist, um Arzneimittel nach den höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards herzustellen.
Was du bekommen wirst

• Eine agile Karriere und dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz.

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung erkennen.

• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Rolle und Standort.

Was du tun wirst

• Führen und verbessern Sie kontinuierlich Reinigungsstrategien und -konzepte für Prozessgeräte innerhalb des zugewiesenen Fertigungsbereichs.

• Durchführung von Risikobewertungen zur Reinigung neuer und bestehender Produkte und Durchführung geeigneter Kontrollen zur Gewährleistung der Produktqualität und Patientensicherheit.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fertigung, Qualität, Engineering, Validierung und anderen funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern, während Sie den Bereich bei Kundenaudits und -besuchen vertreten.

• Förderung von Innovations- und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprojekten sowie Schulung und Coaching von Betreibern zu reinigungsrelevanten Verfahren, einschließlich Abstrichen und Sichtprüfungen.

Was wir suchen

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. Bei Lonza legen wir Wert auf Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter zu schaffen. Bereit, die Zukunft der Biowissenschaften zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Ingénieur en bioprocédés, expert en nettoyage

Lieu: Viège, Suisse

Appui à la réinstallation disponible

L'emplacement réel de ce travail est à Viège, Suisse. Une aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats admissibles et à leur famille, au besoin.
Joignez-vous à l'organisation croissante de produits biologiques de Lonza à Viège et jouez un rôle clé pour assurer les normes les plus élevées de nettoyage de l'équipement et de contrôle de la contamination pour les procédés de fabrication bioconjugués innovants. C'est une occasion passionnante de contribuer à la production de thérapies qui changent la vie tout en favorisant l'excellence opérationnelle et l'amélioration continue.

C'est un rôle entièrement basé sur le site. Travailler ensemble en personne soutient une collaboration étroite en temps réel et la précision technique nécessaire pour fabriquer des médicaments selon les normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées.
Ce que vous aurez

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé.

• Divers avantages dépendent du rôle et de l'emplacement.

Ce que vous ferez

• Le plomb et l'amélioration continue des stratégies et des concepts de nettoyage pour l'équipement de procédé dans la zone de fabrication assignée.

• Effectuer des évaluations des risques de nettoyage pour les produits nouveaux et existants, en mettant en place des contrôles appropriés pour assurer la qualité des produits et la sécurité des patients.

• Appuyer les opérations de fabrication des BPF par une surveillance spécialisée des processus de nettoyage du matériel, des activités d'enquête et de la résolution des problèmes.

• Préparer, examiner et tenir à jour la documentation sur la production, les registres électroniques des lots, les écarts, les contrôles du changement et les APC liés aux activités de nettoyage.

• Veiller à ce que les procédés de nettoyage demeurent qualifiés, validés et conformes tout au long de leur cycle de vie, conformément aux exigences des BPF et aux procédures du site.

• Collaborez étroitement avec les intervenants de la Fabrication, de la Qualité, de l'Ingénierie, de la Validation et d'autres intervenants interfonctionnels tout en représentant la région lors des vérifications et des visites des clients.

• Diriger des projets d'innovation et d'amélioration continue et fournir une formation et un encadrement aux opérateurs sur les procédures de nettoyage, y compris les activités de swabbing et d'inspection visuelle.

Ce que nous cherchons

• Diplôme en biotechnologie, biochimie, génie biochimique, sciences de la vie ou une discipline scientifique connexe (Bachelor, maîtrise ou doctorat).

• Expérience des milieux de fabrication biopharmaceutiques, biotechnologiques ou réglementés par les BPF, en particulier en amont ou en aval.

• Connaissance du nettoyage de l'équipement, de la validation du nettoyage, du contrôle de la contamination ou des activités connexes d'ingénierie des procédés.

• Connaissance des exigences des BPF, des systèmes de qualité et des pratiques de documentation de fabrication.

• Connaissance de l'équipement USP/DSP et de la conception de l'équipement de procédé dans les environnements de production de biotechnologie.

• De solides compétences en communication et en collaboration, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement entre plusieurs fonctions et intervenants.

• Un état d'esprit structuré, orienté vers la solution et passionné par l'amélioration continue, l'apprentissage et la conduite de l'excellence opérationnelle.

À propos de Lonza
À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.
L'innovation prospère lorsque les gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous nous réjouissons de vous accueillir à bord.
Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

Location:  Visp (Switzerland)

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

This position is based in the quaint and beautiful town of Visp! Ibex Solutions (www.ibex.lonza.com) is a modular complex for the development and production of biological products. It gives companies access to a complete solution, gaining speed and achieving a simplified value chain. The Ibex complex is our contribution to the medicine of tomorrow! Would you like to be a part of this? Start your career at Lonza and apply as a Project Leader Quality Control today!
Communicate with manufacturing, QA, and external customers. Represent QC in cross-functional teams and align strategies with other departments.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• Along with competitive salaries, you’ll find a wide range of lifestyle, family and leisure benefits available. Depending on your location, these benefits could include family allowances, childcare support, discounts for local businesses and attractions, travel allowances and subsidized meals.

Key responsibilities:

• Establishing and maintaining customer relationships

• Preparing and supporting production campaigns

• Processing change requests and deviations under GMP

• Supporting customer audits and inspections by authorities

• Calculating and monitoring QC costs in the project

• Independent coordination, prioritization and scheduling of tasks

Key requirements:

• PhD or equivalent experience in the Life Sciences (Biology, Biochemistry or Pharmaceutical Sciences)

• Work experience in the pharmaceutical/biotechnological GMP environment and in Quality Control is a strong Plus

• Your assertive, clear and direct communication style allows you to work closely with different collaborators in a professional manner. You enjoy working with many people in various business areas and bring solid organizational and project management skills to handle demanding projects.

• Proficient use of common software applications (MS Office) is required. Knowledge of individual pharmaceutical/laboratory software (e.g. Documentum, LIMS, Trackwise) is an advantage

• Proficiency in English essential, basic German skills needed (B1 level), and motivation to improve rapidly (free German language courses offered)

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.
People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Oggi Lonza è un leader globale nelle scienze della vita che opera in tre continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non esiste una formula magica su come lo facciamo. Questa posizione ha sede nella pittoresca e bellissima città di Visp! Ibex Solutions (www.ibex.lonza.com) è un complesso modulare per lo sviluppo e la produzione di prodotti biologici. Offre alle aziende l'accesso a una soluzione completa, guadagnando velocità e ottenendo una catena del valore semplificata. Il complesso Ibex è il nostro contributo alla medicina di domani! Ti piacerebbe far parte di questo? Inizia la tua carriera in Lonza e candidati oggi stesso come Project Leader Quality Control!
Comunicare con la produzione, il controllo qualità e i clienti esterni. Rappresentare il controllo qualità in team interfunzionali e allineare le strategie con altri dipartimenti.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura lavorativa dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi retributivi che riconoscono le performance elevate

• Oltre a stipendi competitivi, troverai un'ampia gamma di vantaggi in termini di stile di vita, famiglia e tempo libero. A seconda della tua posizione, questi vantaggi potrebbero includere assegni familiari, sostegno all'infanzia, sconti per attività commerciali e attrazioni locali, indennità di viaggio e pasti sovvenzionati.

Responsabilità principali:

• Stabilire e mantenere relazioni con i clienti

• Preparazione e supporto delle campagne di produzione

• Elaborazione delle richieste di modifica e delle deviazioni secondo GMP

• Supportare gli audit dei clienti e le ispezioni da parte delle autorità

• Calcolo e monitoraggio dei costi di controllo qualità nel progetto

• Coordinamento, definizione delle priorità e pianificazione indipendenti dei compiti

Requisiti chiave:

• Dottorato di ricerca o esperienza equivalente nelle scienze della vita (biologia, biochimica o scienze farmaceutiche)

• L'esperienza lavorativa nell'ambiente GMP farmaceutico/biotecnologico e nel controllo qualità costituisce un forte vantaggio

• Il tuo stile di comunicazione assertivo, chiaro e diretto ti consente di lavorare a stretto contatto con diversi collaboratori in modo professionale. Ti piace lavorare con molte persone in varie aree di business e porti solide capacità organizzative e di gestione dei progetti per gestire progetti impegnativi.

• È richiesto l'uso competente delle comuni applicazioni software (MS Office). La conoscenza dei singoli software farmaceutici/di laboratorio (ad esempio Documentum, LIMS, Trackwise) costituisce un vantaggio

• Conoscenza dell'inglese essenziale, competenze di base del tedesco necessarie (livello B1) e motivazione a migliorare rapidamente (corsi di lingua tedesca gratuiti offerti)

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Il modo in cui raggiungiamo i risultati aziendali è importante tanto quanto i risultati stessi. In Lonza rispettiamo e proteggiamo le nostre persone e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo che otteniamo non è affatto un successo se non viene raggiunto eticamente.
Le persone vengono a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività nel risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che deriva dal miglioramento della vita in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che deriva dal fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è un leader globale nella produzione farmaceutica e biotecnologica. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti di produzione a Visp (Vallese), Basilea e Stein (Argovia), in Svizzera.

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

We are looking for a Manufacturing Science and Technology Expert – Drug Product (m/f/d) - 80% -100%. This role is important for ensuring successful technology transfers, maintaining GMP compliance, and driving continuous improvement. If you're a proactive problem-solver with a strong background in manufacturing science and technology, we want to hear from you. The position is based in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation is available for a successful candidate and their family, if needed.

Key responsibilities:

• Responsible for implementing the manufacturing process in the plant, as received from DP process development or customer.

• Securing success during technology transfer by applying formal processes and tools to handle the transfer of information, process related risks and change control.

• Participate in GMP risk analysis for the manufacturing processes.

• Communication of manufacturing updates to the customer

• Leading and/or participating in cross-functional teams as a MSAT guide tasked with technology transfers (process implementation and transfer) and timely process implementation at manufacturing scale. This includes the whole lifecycle of assigned projects from planning over coordination, implementation, control and project completion aligned with project management goals.

• Leading/participate in change controls and deviation investigations.

• Prepare and perform Qualification and Validation ‎activities in compliance with cGMP regulations and ‎specification requirements. ‎‎

• Contributing to the development and implementation of standardized MSAT procedures and processes.

• Responsible for continuous improvement of process performance and product quality.

• Proactively anticipates, evaluates, and resolves scientifical and technical challenges within area of expertise.

• Acting as a mentor for scientific and production staff in different fields of expertise

• Acts a link between Drug Product Services (DPS Basel), mainly formulation, process development and manufacturing, QC and Visp.

• Looks after process monitoring and process control strategy as well as sophisticated data analysis.

Key requirements:

• Degree in Pharmaceutical Technology, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Process Engineering or equivalent scientific degree.

• More than 3 years of proven track record in the area of sterile manufacturing on the shopfloor and/or MSAT, QA/QC

• Proficiency in English.

• Proven process understanding in sterile manufacturing (Pharma, Regulatory aspects, freeze-drying).

• Very good interpersonal skills with all kinds of interfaces within customers and the project organization.

• Strong team orientation and collaboration across groups within a matrix organization.

• Structured, focused and well-organized working demeanor.

• Open-minded for new insights and suggestions.

• Agile, highly motivated and dynamic drive.

• Driven to resolve issues.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in tre continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte.

Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto di tecnologia e scienza di produzione – Prodotto Droga (m/f/d) - 80% -100%. Questo ruolo è importante per garantire i trasferimenti tecnologici di successo, mantenere la conformità GMP e migliorare continuamente. Se sei un problem-solver proattivo con un forte background nella scienza e nella tecnologia di produzione, vogliamo sentire da voi. La posizione si trova a Visp, in Svizzera. Il trasferimento è disponibile per un candidato di successo e la loro famiglia, se necessario.

Responsabilità chiave:

• Responsabile per l'attuazione del processo di produzione nell'impianto, come ricevuto dallo sviluppo del processo DP o dal cliente.

• Garantire il successo durante il trasferimento tecnologico applicando processi formali e strumenti per gestire il trasferimento di informazioni, i rischi connessi al processo e il controllo dei cambiamenti.

• Partecipa all'analisi dei rischi GMP per i processi produttivi.

• Comunicazione degli aggiornamenti di produzione al cliente

• Guidare e/o partecipare a team interfunzionali come guida MSAT incaricata di trasferimenti tecnologici (implementazione del processo e trasferimento) e l'implementazione tempestiva dei processi in scala di produzione. Questo include l'intero ciclo di vita dei progetti assegnati dalla pianificazione sul coordinamento, l'implementazione, il controllo e il completamento del progetto allineati con gli obiettivi di gestione del progetto.

• Leader/partecipazione nei controlli di cambiamento e nelle indagini di deviazione.

• Preparare e svolgere attività di qualificazione e validazione in conformità alle normative e alle specifiche cGMP.

• Contribuire allo sviluppo e all'implementazione di procedure e processi standardizzati MSAT.

• Responsabile per il miglioramento continuo delle prestazioni di processo e della qualità del prodotto.

• Proattivamente anticipa, valuta e risolve le sfide scientifiche e tecniche nell'ambito delle competenze.

• Agire come mentore per il personale scientifico e produttivo in diversi campi di competenza

• Agisce un collegamento tra Drug Product Services (DPS Basel), principalmente formulazione, sviluppo di processo e produzione, QC e Visp.

• A seconda della strategia di monitoraggio e controllo dei processi e dell'analisi dei dati sofisticata.

Requisiti chiave:

• Laurea in tecnologia farmaceutica, biotecnologia, chimica, ingegneria dei processi o grado scientifico equivalente.

• Più di 3 anni di comprovata esperienza nel settore della produzione sterile sul piano commerciale e/o MSAT, QA/QC

• Competenza in inglese.

• Proventa la comprensione del processo nella produzione sterile (Pharma, aspetti normativi, congelamento-essiccazione).

• Molto buone competenze interpersonali con tutti i tipi di interfacce all'interno dei clienti e l'organizzazione del progetto.

• Forte orientamento del team e collaborazione tra gruppi all'interno di un'organizzazione matrice.

• Demeanore di lavoro strutturato, focalizzato e ben organizzato.

• Aperto per nuove idee e suggerimenti.

• Azionamento aggressivo, altamente motivato e dinamico.

• Guidato per risolvere i problemi.

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l'occupazione senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, età, stato come individuo qualificato con disabilità, status veterano protetto, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

jobs.title: Head of QA Bioatrium
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

We are looking for a Head of Quality for BioAtrium, based in Visp, Switzerland.

BioAtrium’s Head of Quality is responsible for all quality-related aspects of the activities undertaken at the site, in accordance with all applicable laws and regulations including quality agreements entered into with Sanofi and Lonza.

Key Responsibilities:

The Head of Quality has the authority to decide on all Quality-relevant decisions and holds the following permanent responsibilities and accountabilities:

Quality strategy and Leadership at BioAtrium AG:
The Head of Quality defines quality vision and quality strategy.

• The quality vision and quality strategy will be based on the overall vison and strategy of BioAtrium.

• The quality vision will foster compliance, risk and science thinking to direct the quality organization towards a modern organization having eventually the patient’s wellbeing in top of their mind.

• On periodic basis, milestone plans with defined quality initiatives to ensure to follow the quality strategy will be defined and subsequently executed.

• Acts as a change agent, driving high Quality Standards and a culture of continuous improvement.

• Develops talents through coaching and fostering continuous learning.

Quality Management System of BioAtrium:
Head of Quality maintains a compliant quality management system at BioAtrium:

• Monitoring of key performance indicators to assess the efficiency of the quality system, of the quality culture, and of appropriate staffing.

• Assures qualified status of facility, equipment, processes and cleaning, test methods, IT infrastructure and application during the lifecycle of products, of related systems and of the facility.

• Follows up on current GMP trends and ensures that plans are in place to maintain BioAtrium in a state of compliance.

• Oversight of all outsourced services as well as management of any incoming complaints.

Inspection and regulatory agencies:
The Head of Quality maintains an active and successful collaboration with Swissmedic to ensure the Manufacturing License for BioAtrium according to the Medicinal Products Licensing Ordinance (SR 812.212.1) including successful inspections of the BioAtrium facility.

This includes also the collaboration with all foreign health authorities as well as any customer inspections to ensure the site is inspection-ready at any time. Ensure a smooth inspection organization including the set-up of back and front office, timely and adequate response to inspection observations and focused follow-up on all CAPA plans.

Key Requirements, Qualifications, Skills & Behavior:

• Master Degree in Life Sciences or related education.

• Several years’ of experience in leading GMP biopharmaceutical quality operations.

• Many years’ of experience leading multi-disciplinary teams in pharma, vaccines or biopharmaceuticals.

• Demonstrated leadership of site management teams.

• Start-up experience of manufacturing facilities or businesses.

• Expert in Quality understanding of Drug Substance (ICH Q7) and understanding current trends.

• Expert in GMP manufacturing of biopharmaceutical Drug Substances.

• Knowledge of development and technology transfer of therapeutic protein processes.

• Trained in Operational Excellence in a GMP environment.

• Quality and GMP compliance mindset.

• Customer facing skills.

• Representing the Joint venture to customers, regulatory inspectors and stakeholders.

• English and German language is essential.

• French language is an advantage.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:

La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda la propria carriera. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte.

Siamo alla ricerca di un Capo di Qualità per BioAtrium, con sede a Visp, in Svizzera.

BioAtrium’s Head of Quality è responsabile di tutti gli aspetti legati alla qualità delle attività intraprese nel sito, in conformità a tutte le leggi e regolamenti applicabili, compresi gli accordi di qualità stipulati con Sanofi e Lonza.

Responsabilità chiave:

Il Capo della Qualità ha l'autorità di decidere su tutte le decisioni relative alla qualità e detiene le seguenti responsabilità e responsabilità permanenti:

Strategia di qualità e Leadership presso BioAtrium AG:
Il Capo della Qualità definisce la visione di qualità e la strategia di qualità.

• La visione di qualità e la strategia di qualità si baseranno sulla visiera generale e sulla strategia di BioAtrium.

• La visione di qualità favorirà la conformità, il rischio e la scienza pensando di dirigere l’organizzazione di qualità verso un’organizzazione moderna avendo alla fine il benessere del paziente in cima alla loro mente.

• Su base periodica, verranno definiti e successivamente eseguiti i piani di pietra miliare con iniziative di qualità definite.

• Agisce come agente di cambiamento, guidando standard di alta qualità e una cultura di miglioramento continuo.

• Sviluppa talenti attraverso la formazione e la promozione dell'apprendimento continuo.

Sistema di gestione della qualità di BioAtrium:
Head of Quality mantiene un sistema di gestione della qualità conforme a BioAtrium:

• Monitoraggio dei principali indicatori di performance per valutare l'efficienza del sistema di qualità, della cultura della qualità e del personale adeguato.

• Assicura lo stato qualificato di impianti, attrezzature, processi e pulizia, metodi di prova, infrastrutture IT e applicazione durante il ciclo di vita dei prodotti, dei sistemi correlati e della struttura.

• Segui le attuali tendenze GMP e assicura che i piani siano in atto per mantenere BioAtrium in uno stato di conformità.

• La supervisione di tutti i servizi esterni e la gestione di eventuali reclami in arrivo.

Ispezione e agenzie di regolamentazione:
Il Responsabile della Qualità mantiene una collaborazione attiva e di successo con Swissmedic per garantire la Licenza di Produzione per il BioAtrium secondo l'Ordinanza di Licenziamento dei Prodotti Medicinali (SR 812.212.1) con controlli di successo della struttura BioAtrium.

Questo include anche la collaborazione con tutte le autorità sanitarie estere e tutte le ispezioni dei clienti per garantire che il sito sia pronto per l'ispezione in qualsiasi momento. Assicurare un'organizzazione di ispezione senza intoppi, tra cui l'installazione di back and front office, tempestiva e adeguata risposta alle osservazioni di ispezione e il follow-up focalizzato su tutti i piani CAPA.

Requisiti chiave, qualifiche, competenze & comportamento:

• Laurea Magistrale in Scienze della Vita o formazione correlata.

• Diversi anni di esperienza nelle principali operazioni di qualità biofarmaceutica GMP.

• Molti anni di esperienza leader team multidisciplinari in farmacia, vaccini o biofarmaci.

• Dimostrata leadership dei team di gestione del sito.

• Esperienza di avvio di impianti di produzione o imprese.

• Esperto nella comprensione della qualità della sostanza farmaceutica (ICH Q7) e la comprensione delle tendenze attuali.

• Esperto nella produzione GMP di sostanze stupefacenti biofarmaceutiche.

• Conoscenza dello sviluppo e del trasferimento tecnologico dei processi terapeutici delle proteine.

• Allenato in Eccellenza Operativa in un ambiente GMP.

• Mente di conformità di qualità e GMP.

• Competenze del cliente.

• Rappresentare l'impresa comune ai clienti, agli ispettori normativi e alle parti interessate.

• La lingua inglese e tedesca è essenziale.

• La lingua francese è un vantaggio.

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Heute ist Lonza ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biowissenschaften, der auf fünf Kontinenten tätig ist. Während wir in der Wissenschaft arbeiten, gibt es keine magische Formel, wie wir es tun. Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Menschen, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen.

Wir suchen einen Head of Quality für BioAtrium mit Sitz in Visp, Schweiz.

Der Qualitätsleiter von BioAtrium ist für alle qualitätsbezogenen Aspekte der Aktivitäten am Standort verantwortlich, in Übereinstimmung mit allen geltenden Gesetzen und Vorschriften, einschließlich der mit Sanofi und Lonza geschlossenen Qualitätsvereinbarungen.

Hauptzuständigkeiten:

Der Qualitätsleiter ist befugt, über alle qualitätsrelevanten Entscheidungen zu entscheiden und hat die folgenden ständigen Verantwortlichkeiten und Verantwortlichkeiten:

Qualitätsstrategie und Führung bei BioAtrium AG:
Der Leiter Qualität definiert Qualitätsvision und Qualitätsstrategie.

• Die Qualitätsvision und Qualitätsstrategie wird auf der Gesamtsicht und -strategie von BioAtrium basieren.

• Die Qualitätsvision wird Compliance, Risiko und wissenschaftliches Denken fördern, um die Qualitätsorganisation auf eine moderne Organisation zu lenken, die schließlich das Wohlbefinden des Patienten im Auge hat.

• In regelmäßigen Abständen werden Meilensteinpläne mit definierten Qualitätsinitiativen festgelegt, um sicherzustellen, dass die Qualitätsstrategie eingehalten wird, und anschließend ausgeführt.

• Agiert als Change Agent, treibt hohe Qualitätsstandards und eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung voran.

• Entwickelt Talente durch Coaching und kontinuierliches Lernen.

Qualitätsmanagementsystem von BioAtrium:
Qualitätsleiter unterhält ein konformes Qualitätsmanagementsystem bei BioAtrium:

• Überwachung der wesentlichen Leistungsindikatoren zur Bewertung der Effizienz des Qualitätssystems, der Qualitätskultur und der angemessenen Personalausstattung.

• Gewährleistet einen qualifizierten Status der Einrichtung, Ausrüstung, Prozesse und Reinigung, Testmethoden, IT-Infrastruktur und -Anwendung während des Lebenszyklus von Produkten, verwandten Systemen und der Einrichtung.

• Verfolgt aktuelle GMP-Trends und stellt sicher, dass Pläne vorhanden sind, um BioAtrium in einem Zustand der Compliance zu halten.

• Aufsicht über alle ausgelagerten Dienstleistungen sowie Verwaltung von eingehenden Beschwerden.

Inspektions- und Regulierungsbehörden:
Der Qualitätsleiter pflegt eine aktive und erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit mit Swissmedic, um die Herstellungslizenz für BioAtrium nach der Arzneimittel-Genehmigungsverordnung (SR 812.212.1) einschließlich erfolgreicher Inspektionen der BioAtrium-Anlage sicherzustellen.

Dazu gehört auch die Zusammenarbeit mit allen ausländischen Gesundheitsbehörden sowie etwaige Kundeninspektionen, um sicherzustellen, dass der Standort jederzeit inspektionsbereit ist. Gewährleistung einer reibungslosen Inspektionsorganisation, einschließlich der Einrichtung eines Back- und Front-Office, einer rechtzeitigen und angemessenen Reaktion auf Inspektionsbeobachtungen und einer gezielten Weiterverfolgung aller CAPA-Pläne.

Wichtige Anforderungen, Qualifikationen, Fähigkeiten und Verhalten:

• Master-Abschluss in Life Sciences oder verwandte Bildung.

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in führenden biopharmazeutischen Qualitätsbetrieben von GMP.

• Langjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung multidisziplinärer Teams in den Bereichen Pharma, Impfstoffe oder Biopharmazeutika.

• Demonstrierte Führung von Site Management Teams.

• Start-up-Erfahrung von Produktionsanlagen oder Unternehmen.

• Experte für Qualitätsverständnis der Arzneimittelsubstanz (ICH Q7) und Verständnis der aktuellen Trends.

• Experte für GMP-Herstellung von biopharmazeutischen Wirkstoffen.

• Wissen über Entwicklung und Technologietransfer von therapeutischen Proteinprozessen.

• Ausgebildet in Operational Excellence in einer GMP-Umgebung.

• Qualitäts- und GMP-Compliance-Mentalität.

• Kundenorientierte Fähigkeiten.

• Vertretung des Joint Ventures gegenüber Kunden, Regulierungsinspektoren und Interessengruppen.

• Englisch und Deutsch sind unerlässlich.

• Die französische Sprache ist von Vorteil.

Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird.

Die Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um sich der Herausforderung und Kreativität zu stellen, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem sinnvollen Unterschied kommt.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland.

As part of this growth, we’re offering an internship opportunity to support our Process Experts and Senior Process Experts in large-scale mammalian upstream and downstream manufacturing.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

Duration: 12 months.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

What you'll do:

• Assisting in technology transfer activities by helping prepare process documentation, tracking data, and coordinating cross-functional input.

• Supporting data collection and analysis for manufacturing batches, deviations, and process performance trends.

• Helping to prepare presentations, reports, and process descriptions for internal stakeholders and customer interactions.

• Participating in process risk assessments, change controls, and process improvement initiatives.

• Collaborating with Manufacturing, MSAT, QA, and Process Development teams on daily operations and troubleshooting activities.

• Maintaining GMP documentation practices and ensuring data integrity in support of regulatory compliance.

• Attending and contributing to team meetings, taking notes, and following up on action items.

What we are looking for:

• Ongoing or completed Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Life Sciences or a related field.

• Strong curiosity about biopharma manufacturing and process science (USP or DSP).

• Basic understanding of bioprocessing and GMP is an advantage.

• Strong communication skills in English; German is a plus.

• Organized, detail-oriented, and a good teammate.

• Comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Innerhalb der Microbial Large Scale Produktionsanlage werden sowohl erste Engineering Kampagnen als auch kontinuierlich laufende kommerzielle Prozesse durchgeführt.

Diese Position ist eine vollständig standortgebundene Rolle.
