Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in cinque continenti.
Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte.

A Lonza, stiamo cercando un capo di HR M&A per guidare l'agenda HR attraverso il nostro portafoglio globale di fusioni, acquisizioni, divestiture, joint venture, ristrutturazioni e altre transazioni strategiche aziendali. Questo ruolo di leadership altamente visibile possederà l'agenda end-to-end delle persone, dall'esplorazione del primo stadio e la dovuta diligenza attraverso l'esecuzione delle transazioni, l'integrazione o la separazione, e la stabilizzazione post-close.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con Corporate M&A, Finance, Legal, IT, business leadership, e l'organizzazione HR più ampia, formerà la strategia delle persone per le transazioni complesse, condurre team di affari HR multifunzionali e garantire l'esecuzione di successo contro la strategia di affare generale. Potrai fungere da consulente di fiducia per la leadership senior, portando profonda esperienza HR M&A per identificare e mitigare i rischi delle persone, accelerare il processo decisionale e consentire la creazione di valore di successo.

Responsabilità chiave:

• Possedere al portafoglio M&A HR globale, impostare la strategia, le priorità, la governance, le risorse e la responsabilità attraverso più transazioni concorrenti e programmi aziendali strategici

• Guidare e sviluppare il team HR M&A, garantendo un'esecuzione efficace tra acquisizioni, divestiture, joint venture, ristrutturazioni e altre transazioni complesse

• Agire come l'affare HR senior piombo per le transazioni chiave, dall'esplorazione del primo stadio e la dovuta diligenza attraverso la chiusura, l'integrazione o la separazione, e la stabilizzazione post-close

• Fornire competenze strategiche per le risorse umane sulla strategia degli accordi, rischi per le persone, implicazioni della forza lavoro, progettazione organizzativa, esperienza dei dipendenti e opportunità di creazione di valore

• Guidare e coordinare flussi di lavoro HR interfunzionali che includono Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, Servizi HR, Digital HR, sistemi HR, payroll, benefici, talento e comunicazioni dei dipendenti

• Partner con gli stakeholder senior attraverso Corporate M&A, Strategy, Finance, Legal, IT, leadership aziendale e HR per guidare l'allineamento, risolvere problemi complessi e consentire decisioni tempestive

• Superare le attività di integrazione e separazione delle risorse umane, comprese le transizioni della forza lavoro, la continuità aziendale, i servizi HR, i sistemi, l'esperienza dei dipendenti e la consegna contro gli obiettivi delle transazioni

• Condurre o supervisionare i negoziati relativi alle risorse umane, Transition Service Agreements (TSAs), modellazione dei costi, consulenti esterni e documentazione relativa alle transazioni

• Rischi, dipendenze, bilanci, risorse, tempestività ed escalation del proprio portafoglio, garantendo nel contempo il rispetto del diritto del lavoro, della regolamentazione, del consiglio di lavoro, del sindacato e dei requisiti di consultazione

• Fornire raccomandazioni chiare e report a livello esecutivo ai comitati di leadership e sterzo senior, assicurando la consegna HR supporta l'esecuzione di transazioni di successo, le prestazioni e la realizzazione del valore

Qualificazioni richieste:

• 15+ anni di esperienza HR progressiva, con una notevole profondità in HR M&A, idealmente acquisita attraverso ambienti di consulenza, project-driven e/o una funzione M&A interna a un'organizzazione multinazionale

• Esperienza comprovata che conduce flussi di lavoro HR attraverso acquisizioni complesse, divestiture, integrazioni, separazioni, ristrutturazioni o altre transazioni strategiche aziendali

• Ampia competenza in HR M&A, Total Rewards, HR Operations, sistemi HR, transizioni della forza lavoro e consegna di programmi multifunzionali complessi

• Forte comprensione del ciclo di vita M&A completo, tra cui due diligence, pianificazione delle transazioni, integrazione/separazione, TSA, gestione dei rischi legati alle persone e stabilizzazione post-close

• Capacità dimostrata di condurre più operazioni complesse simultaneamente e gestire team di progetto internazionali, interfunzionali e consulenti esterni

• Eccezionale business e acume finanziario, con la capacità di tradurre la strategia di transazione in priorità pragmatiche HR, piani di esecuzione e opportunità di creazione di valore

• Forte presenza esecutiva, comunicazione, negoziazione e capacità di influenzare, con la capacità di costruire relazioni di fiducia con leadership senior e stakeholder esterni

• Eccellente capacità di analisi, problem solving, project management e esecuzione, con la capacità di tradurre informazioni complesse in raccomandazioni chiare e materiali di livello executive

• Prove capacità di operare efficacemente in ambienti di matrice veloci, altamente confidenziali, complessi, dimostrando giudizio sonoro, resilienza, adattabilità e un alto grado di indipendenza

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo — la soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l'occupazione senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, età, stato come individuo qualificato con disabilità, status veterano protetto, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents.
While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

At Lonza, we are looking for a Head of HR M&A to lead the HR agenda across our global portfolio of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, restructurings, and other strategic corporate transactions. This highly visible leadership role will own the end-to-end people agenda, from early-stage exploration and due diligence through transaction execution, integration or separation, and post-close stabilization.

Working closely with Corporate M&A, Finance, Legal, IT, business leadership, and the broader HR organization, you will shape the people strategy for complex transactions, lead cross-functional HR deal teams, and ensure successful execution against the overall deal strategy. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, bringing deep HR M&A expertise to identify and mitigate people risks, accelerate decision-making, and enable successful value creation.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the global HR M&A portfolio, setting strategy, priorities, governance, resources, and accountability across multiple concurrent transactions and strategic corporate programs

• Lead and develop the HR M&A team, ensuring effective execution across acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, restructurings, and other complex transactions

• Act as the senior HR deal lead for key transactions, from early-stage exploration and due diligence through close, integration or separation, and post-close stabilization

• Provide strategic HR expertise on deal strategy, people risks, workforce implications, organizational design, employee experience, and value creation opportunities

• Lead and coordinate cross-functional HR workstreams spanning Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, HR Services, Digital HR, HR systems, payroll, benefits, talent, and employee communications

• Partner with senior stakeholders across Corporate M&A, Strategy, Finance, Legal, IT, business leadership, and HR to drive alignment, resolve complex issues, and enable timely decisions

• Oversee HR integration and separation activities, including workforce transitions, business continuity, HR services, systems, employee experience, and delivery against transaction objectives

• Lead or oversee HR-related negotiations, Transition Service Agreements (TSAs), cost modelling, external advisors, and relevant transaction documentation

• Own portfolio-level risks, dependencies, budgets, resources, timelines, and escalations while ensuring compliance with employment law, regulatory, works council, union, and consultation requirements

• Provide clear recommendations and executive-level reporting to senior leadership and steering committees, ensuring HR delivery supports successful transaction execution, performance, and value realization

Required Qualifications:

• 15+ years of progressive HR experience, with significant depth in HR M&A, ideally gained through consulting, project-driven environments, and/or an in-house M&A function within a multinational organization

• Proven experience leading HR workstreams across complex acquisitions, divestitures, integrations, separations, restructurings, or other strategic corporate transactions

• Broad expertise across HR M&A, Total Rewards, HR Operations, HR systems, workforce transitions, and complex cross-functional programme delivery

• Strong understanding of the full M&A lifecycle, including due diligence, transaction planning, integration/separation, TSAs, people-related risk management, and post-close stabilization

• Demonstrated ability to lead multiple complex transactions simultaneously and manage international, cross-functional project teams and external advisors

• Exceptional business and financial acumen, with the ability to translate transaction strategy into pragmatic HR priorities, execution plans, and value creation opportunities

• Strong executive presence, communication, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with senior leadership and external stakeholders

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, project management, and execution capabilities, with the ability to translate complex information into clear recommendations and executive-level materials

• Proven ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, highly confidential, complex matrix environments, demonstrating sound judgment, resilience, adaptability, and a high degree of independence

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world — the satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Heute ist Lonza ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biowissenschaften, der auf fünf Kontinenten tätig ist.
Während wir in der Wissenschaft arbeiten, gibt es keine magische Formel, wie wir es tun. Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Menschen, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen.

Bei Lonza suchen wir einen Head of HR M&A, der die HR-Agenda in unserem globalen Portfolio von Fusionen, Übernahmen, Veräußerungen, Joint Ventures, Restrukturierungen und anderen strategischen Unternehmenstransaktionen anführt. Diese sehr sichtbare Führungsrolle wird die End-to-End-Personenagenda besitzen, von der Exploration in der Frühphase und der Due Diligence über die Ausführung von Transaktionen, Integration oder Trennung bis hin zur Stabilisierung nach Abschluss.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Corporate M & A, Finance, Legal, IT, Business Leadership und der breiteren HR-Organisation werden Sie die Personalstrategie für komplexe Transaktionen gestalten, funktionsübergreifende HR-Deal-Teams leiten und eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung im Rahmen der gesamten Deal-Strategie sicherstellen. Sie werden als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für Führungskräfte fungieren und umfassende HR M & A-Expertise mitbringen, um Risiken für Menschen zu identifizieren und zu mindern, die Entscheidungsfindung zu beschleunigen und eine erfolgreiche Wertschöpfung zu ermöglichen.

Wichtigste Aufgaben:

• Besitzen Sie das globale HR M&A-Portfolio und legen Sie Strategie, Prioritäten, Governance, Ressourcen und Rechenschaftspflicht für mehrere gleichzeitige Transaktionen und strategische Unternehmensprogramme fest

• Führen und entwickeln Sie das HR M&A-Team und gewährleisten Sie eine effektive Ausführung bei Akquisitionen, Veräußerungen, Joint Ventures, Restrukturierungen und anderen komplexen Transaktionen

• Handeln Sie als Senior HR Deal Lead für wichtige Transaktionen, von der frühen Explorations- und Due Diligence-Phase über Close, Integration oder Trennung bis hin zur Stabilisierung nach Abschluss

• Bieten Sie strategische HR-Expertise zu Deal-Strategie, Menschenrisiken, Auswirkungen auf die Belegschaft, Organisationsdesign, Mitarbeitererfahrung und Wertschöpfungsmöglichkeiten

• Führen und koordinieren Sie funktionsübergreifende HR-Workstreams, die Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, HR Services, Digital HR, HR-Systeme, Gehaltsabrechnung, Vorteile, Talente und Mitarbeiterkommunikation umfassen

• Partnerschaft mit hochrangigen Stakeholdern aus den Bereichen Corporate M&A, Strategie, Finanzen, Recht, IT, Unternehmensführung und HR, um die Ausrichtung voranzutreiben, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und zeitnahe Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen

• Beaufsichtigen Sie die HR-Integrations- und -Trennungsaktivitäten, einschließlich Workforce-Übergänge, Business Continuity, HR-Services, Systeme, Mitarbeitererfahrung und Lieferung nach Transaktionszielen

• Führen oder überwachen Sie HR-bezogene Verhandlungen, Transition Service Agreements (TSAs), Kostenmodellierung, externe Berater und relevante Transaktionsdokumentation

• Eigene Risiken, Abhängigkeiten, Budgets, Ressourcen, Zeitpläne und Eskalationen auf Portfolioebene bei gleichzeitiger Einhaltung der arbeitsrechtlichen, Regulierungs-, Betriebsrats-, Gewerkschafts- und Konsultationsanforderungen

• Bereitstellung klarer Empfehlungen und Berichterstattung auf Führungsebene an leitende Führungskräfte und Lenkungsausschüsse, um sicherzustellen, dass die HR-Bereitstellung eine erfolgreiche Transaktionsausführung, -leistung und -wertrealisierung unterstützt

Benötigte Qualifikationen:

• 15+ Jahre fortschrittliche HR-Erfahrung mit erheblicher Tiefe in HR M & A, idealerweise gewonnen durch Beratung, projektorientierte Umgebungen und / oder eine interne M & A-Funktion innerhalb einer multinationalen Organisation

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit führenden HR-Workstreams bei komplexen Akquisitionen, Veräußerungen, Integrationen, Trennungen, Umstrukturierungen oder anderen strategischen Unternehmenstransaktionen

• Breites Fachwissen über HR M&A, Total Rewards, HR Operations, HR-Systeme, Workforce-Übergänge und komplexe funktionsübergreifende Programmerbringung

• Starkes Verständnis des gesamten M & A-Lebenszyklus, einschließlich Due Diligence, Transaktionsplanung, Integration / Trennung, TSAs, personenbezogenes Risikomanagement und Post-Close-Stabilisierung

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, mehrere komplexe Transaktionen gleichzeitig zu führen und internationale, funktionsübergreifende Projektteams und externe Berater zu verwalten

• Außergewöhnlicher Geschäfts- und Finanzsinn mit der Fähigkeit, Transaktionsstrategien in pragmatische HR-Prioritäten, Ausführungspläne und Wertschöpfungsmöglichkeiten zu übersetzen

• Starke Führungspräsenz, Kommunikation, Verhandlung und Einflussmöglichkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Führungskräften und externen Stakeholdern aufzubauen

• Ausgezeichnete Analyse-, Problemlösungs-, Projektmanagement- und Ausführungsfunktionen mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Informationen in klare Empfehlungen und Materialien auf Führungsebene zu übersetzen

• Bewährte Fähigkeit, effektiv in schnelllebigen, hoch vertraulichen, komplexen Matrixumgebungen zu arbeiten und ein solides Urteilsvermögen, Widerstandsfähigkeit, Anpassungsfähigkeit und ein hohes Maß an Unabhängigkeit zu demonstrieren

Die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns ist das nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird.

Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um die Herausforderung und Kreativität zu meistern, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht - die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem sinnvollen Unterschied einhergeht.

Lonza ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Alle qualifizierten Bewerber erhalten eine Gegenleistung für eine Beschäftigung ohne Rücksicht auf Rasse, Religion, Hautfarbe, nationale Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, Alter, Status als qualifizierte Person mit Behinderung, geschützter Veteranenstatus oder andere gesetzlich geschützte Merkmale.

Lonza ist weltweit führend in der Pharma- und Biotech-Fertigung. Das Unternehmen betreibt große Produktionsstätten in Visp (Valais), Basel, und Stein (Aargau), Schweiz.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie sur cinq continents.
Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des gens talentueux, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

À Lonza, nous sommes à la recherche d'un responsable des M et A des RH pour diriger le programme des RH dans notre portefeuille mondial de fusions, d'acquisitions, de cessions, de coentreprises, de restructurations et d'autres transactions stratégiques de l'entreprise. Ce rôle de chef de file très visible sera le propriétaire de l'ordre du jour des gens de bout en bout, depuis l'exploration en début de carrière et la diligence raisonnable jusqu'à l'exécution des transactions, l'intégration ou la séparation, et la stabilisation après la fermeture.

En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les directions générales, les finances, les services juridiques, les TI, le leadership opérationnel et l'ensemble de l'organisation des RH, vous façonnerez la stratégie en matière de ressources humaines pour les transactions complexes, dirigerez les équipes interfonctionnelles des RH et assurerez une exécution réussie par rapport à la stratégie globale. Vous agirez à titre de conseiller de confiance auprès des cadres supérieurs, en apportant une expertise approfondie en matière de M et A des RH afin de cerner et d'atténuer les risques pour les personnes, d'accélérer la prise de décisions et de permettre la création de valeur.

Principales responsabilités :

• Posséder le portefeuille mondial des M et A des RH, établir la stratégie, les priorités, la gouvernance, les ressources et la reddition de comptes pour de multiples opérations concurrentes et programmes stratégiques ministériels

• Diriger et développer l'équipe de gestion des ressources humaines, en assurant une exécution efficace des acquisitions, des cessions, des coentreprises, des restructurations et d'autres transactions complexes

• Agir à titre de chef de file en matière de RH pour les opérations clés, depuis l'exploration au début et la diligence raisonnable jusqu'à la fermeture, l'intégration ou la séparation, et la stabilisation après la fermeture

• Fournir une expertise stratégique en RH sur la stratégie de transaction, les risques pour les personnes, les répercussions sur l'effectif, la conception organisationnelle, l'expérience des employés et les possibilités de création de valeur

• Diriger et coordonner les volets de travail interfonctionnels des RH couvrant le total des récompenses, l'acquisition de talents, les services RH, les RH numériques, les systèmes RH, la paie, les avantages sociaux, les talents et les communications avec les employés

• Établir des partenariats avec des intervenants de haut niveau dans les domaines des fusions-acquisitions, de la stratégie, des finances, du droit, de la TI, du leadership opérationnel et des ressources humaines afin de favoriser l'harmonisation, de résoudre les problèmes complexes et de prendre des décisions en temps opportun

• Surveiller les activités d'intégration et de cessation de service des RH, y compris les transitions de la main-d'oeuvre, la continuité des activités, les services de RH, les systèmes, l'expérience des employés et la prestation des services par rapport aux objectifs de transaction

• Diriger ou superviser les négociations sur les RH, les ententes sur les services de transition, la modélisation des coûts, les conseillers externes et la documentation pertinente sur les transactions

• Risques, dépendances, budgets, ressources, échéanciers et escalades au niveau du portefeuille, tout en assurant le respect du droit du travail, de la réglementation, du comité d'entreprise, du syndicat et des exigences en matière de consultation

• Fournir des recommandations claires et des rapports à l'échelon de la direction aux cadres supérieurs et aux comités directeurs, en veillant à ce que la prestation des RH contribue à la bonne exécution des opérations, au rendement et à la réalisation des valeurs.

Qualifications requises :

• 15 ans et plus d'expérience en RH progressive, avec une profondeur considérable en M et A en RH, idéalement acquise grâce à la consultation, à des environnements axés sur le projet et/ou à une fonction interne de M et A au sein d'une organisation multinationale

• Expérience éprouvée des principaux secteurs de travail des RH dans les acquisitions complexes, les cessions, les intégrations, les séparations, les restructurations ou d'autres transactions stratégiques d'entreprise

• Grande compétence dans les domaines des ressources humaines, des subventions totales, des opérations des ressources humaines, des systèmes de ressources humaines, de la transition des effectifs et de l'exécution complexe de programmes interfonctionnels

• Une bonne compréhension du cycle de vie complet des fusions-acquisitions, y compris la diligence raisonnable, la planification des opérations, l'intégration et la séparation, les AST, la gestion des risques liés aux personnes et la stabilisation après la fermeture

• Capacité démontrée de diriger simultanément plusieurs transactions complexes et de gérer des équipes de projets internationales et interfonctionnelles et des conseillers externes

• Un rendement commercial et financier exceptionnel, avec la capacité de traduire la stratégie de transaction en priorités pragmatiques en RH, plans d'exécution et possibilités de création de valeur

• Une forte présence des cadres supérieurs, la communication, la négociation et l'influence des compétences, avec la capacité d'établir des relations de confiance avec les cadres supérieurs et les intervenants externes

• Excellente capacité d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes, de gestion de projets et d'exécution, avec la capacité de traduire l'information complexe en recommandations claires et en documents de la direction

• Capacité éprouvée d'opérer efficacement dans des environnements matriciels complexes et rapides, hautement confidentiels, démontrant un jugement sain, une résilience, une adaptabilité et un degré élevé d'indépendance

Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès sinon un succès éthique.

Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde — la satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative.

Lonza est un employeur à chances égales. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront considérés pour un emploi sans égard à la race, à la religion, à la couleur, à l'origine nationale, au sexe, à l'orientation sexuelle, à l'identité de genre, à l'âge, au statut d'individu qualifié handicapé, au statut d'ancien combattant protégé ou à toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

Du unterstützt das Central Standard Management (CSM) Team in QC Visp bei Laboraktivitäten zur Bereitstellung analytischer Standards und Referenzen, pflegst und optimierst das Referenzstandard-Inventar im neuen System und wirkst bei der Qualifizierung sowie Dokumentation von Referenzstandards mit.

Diese Stelle erfordert eine durchgehende Präsenz vor Ort. Die persönliche Zusammenarbeit ermöglicht eine enge, zeitnahe Zusammenarbeit und die technische Präzision, die für die Herstellung von Arzneimitteln nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards erforderlich ist.

Was auf dich wartet:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Tower, Switzerland.

The Global Category Manager Logistics & Warehousing is responsible for developing and executing global sourcing strategies for logistics, transportation, and warehousing services. The role drives value through strategic sourcing, supplier management, cost optimization, and risk mitigation while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to improve service quality, resilience, innovation, and sustainable business performance.

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. We offer flexibility to work remotely for no more than 20% of your time. Requests are considered on a case‑by‑case basis, in line with business needs.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Basel: https://media.ffycdn.net/eu/lonza-group-ag/d/5c78e3b906804b0cb6710009ab5507de?updated

What you will do:

• Develop and implement global category and sourcing strategies for logistics, transportation, and warehousing services across regions and business units.

• Lead strategic sourcing projects, competitive tenders, supplier negotiations, and contract management to deliver sustainable value and cost optimization.

• Build and manage a robust savings pipeline, ensuring accurate forecasting, tracking, and realization of procurement benefits.

• Act as the global procurement subject matter expert for logistics and warehousing, providing market intelligence and strategic guidance.

• Drive supplier selection, onboarding, performance management, and governance to improve service quality, resilience, innovation, and compliance.

• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to align category strategies with business needs, operational priorities, sustainability goals, and risk mitigation plans.

• Identify and implement continuous improvement, digitalization, and process harmonization initiatives to enhance efficiency and transparency.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Significant experience in category management, strategic sourcing, and supplier relationship management within logistics, transportation, and warehousing.

• Strong negotiation, tendering, commercial contracting, and total cost of ownership analysis capabilities.

• Solid understanding of logistics markets, freight modes, warehousing operations, Incoterms, service level agreements, and supplier performance management.

• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and manage complex global projects within a matrix organization.

• Strong analytical skills with experience in spend analysis, business case development, savings delivery, forecasting, and risk management.

• Experience with procurement and sourcing systems such as SAP, Ariba, iCertis, or similar tools, combined with excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Shape the future of digital manufacturing by translating complex production requirements into smart MES solutions that power shop floor operations and drive efficiency. This unique role combines process expertise, programming skills, and cross-functional collaboration, offering exciting opportunities to optimize interfaces across MES, SAP, LIMS, and automation systems.
Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!
This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits
Our local benefits: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

What you will do:

• Configure and continuously optimize MES recipes by translating manufacturing specifications into digital production workflows and batch records used on the shop floor.

• Collaborate with Manufacturing, Process Owners, Automation, and IT/OT teams to ensure seamless integration between MES and connected systems such as SAP, LIMS, and automation platforms.

• Develop, test, and maintain MES functionalities using TypeScript, ensuring reliable process execution, data integrity, and compliance with quality standards.

• Identify opportunities to improve processes, data flows, and system interfaces, driving greater efficiency and automation across manufacturing operations.

• Provide MES subject matter expertise by supporting production activities, troubleshooting system-related issues, and contributing to the ongoing evolution of MES capabilities.

What we are looking for:

• Proven experience working with MES systems in a configuration, development, or programming capacity, rather than solely as an end user.

• Solid understanding of GMP-regulated manufacturing environments, with the ability to translate production requirements into compliant digital solutions.

• Hands-on programming experience in any modern programming language and a strong interest in developing and optimizing manufacturing applications.

• Fluent English communication skills are essential to collaborate effectively across global, cross-functional teams.

• A proactive and analytical mindset with the ability to identify process improvement opportunities across systems and interfaces; TypeScript, Fill & Finish experience, IT-related education, and German language skills (or willingness to learn) are considered strong advantages.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

What you will do:

• Lead the site's sterility assurance strategy, ensuring compliance with EU GMP Annex 1 and other global regulatory requirements while safeguarding product quality and patient safety.

• Act as a trusted sterility assurance SME, supporting facility design, qualification, validation, technology transfers, new product introductions, and the implementation of innovative technologies.

• Represent Quality Assurance during inspections, audits, and regulatory interactions, ensuring inspection readiness, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and shaping the future sterility assurance framework of a rapidly growing site.

• Strong knowledge of Contamination Control Strategy (CCS), including the ability to develop, challenge, and continuously improve contamination control programs that support product quality and patient safety.

• Extensive experience in aseptic processing, including media fills (APS), contamination risk management, and sterile manufacturing operations.

• Highly proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with a passion for identifying root causes, partnering closely with production teams, and implementing sustainable corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Play a pivotal role in safeguarding products for patients by driving sterility assurance, contamination control, and quality excellence across a rapidly expanding site. Working closely with global networks and cross-functional teams, you will influence strategic decisions, strengthen compliance with evolving regulations, and help build the future of sterile manufacturing. Check out Your Career in Drug Product Services at Lonza!

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. We offer flexibility to work remotely for no more than 20% of your time. Requests are considered on a case‑by‑case basis, in line with business needs.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits
Our local benefits: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

What you will do:

• Lead the site's sterility assurance strategy, ensuring compliance with EU GMP Annex 1 and other global regulatory requirements while safeguarding product quality and patient safety.

• Drive and continuously enhance the Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) by providing expert oversight of contamination control, environmental monitoring, cleaning, disinfection, and aseptic manufacturing activities.

• Act as a trusted sterility assurance SME, supporting facility design, qualification, validation, technology transfers, new product introductions, and the implementation of innovative technologies.

• Champion a culture of quality and continuous improvement by leading risk assessments, trend analysis, training programs, and initiatives that strengthen sterility assurance performance across the site.

• Represent Quality Assurance during inspections, audits, and regulatory interactions, ensuring inspection readiness, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and shaping the future sterility assurance framework of a rapidly growing site.

What we are looking for:

• Proven expertise in sterility assurance, with a deep understanding of EU GMP Annex 1 and hands-on experience implementing and maintaining Annex 1 requirements in a sterile manufacturing environment is a must.

• Strong knowledge of Contamination Control Strategy (CCS), including the ability to develop, challenge, and continuously improve contamination control programs that support product quality and patient safety.

• Extensive experience in aseptic processing, including media fills (APS), contamination risk management, and sterile manufacturing operations.

• Highly proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with a passion for identifying root causes, partnering closely with production teams, and implementing sustainable corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

• Excellent communication and influencing skills, with fluency in English and the confidence to represent the organization during audits and inspections; German language skills and audit experience are considered strong advantages.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Der tatsächliche Standort dieses Jobs befindet sich in Stein, AG, Schweiz. Umzugshilfe ist für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien zur Verfügung, wenn nötig.

Spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Sicherung von Produkten für Patienten, indem Sie Sterilitätssicherung, Kontaminationskontrolle und Qualitätsexzellenz an einem schnell wachsenden Standort vorantreiben. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Netzwerken und funktionsübergreifenden Teams beeinflussen Sie strategische Entscheidungen, stärken die Einhaltung sich entwickelnder Vorschriften und tragen zur Zukunft der sterilen Fertigung bei. Schauen Sie sich Ihre Karriere in Drug Product Services bei Lonza!

Diese Rolle basiert in erster Linie auf der Website. Die persönliche Zusammenarbeit unterstützt eine enge Echtzeit-Zusammenarbeit und die technische Präzision, die erforderlich ist, um Arzneimittel nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards herzustellen. Wir bieten Flexibilität, um nicht mehr als 20% Ihrer Zeit aus der Ferne zu arbeiten. Anträge werden von Fall zu Fall entsprechend den geschäftlichen Bedürfnissen geprüft.

Was Sie bekommen werden:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz.

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung erkennen.

Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt können Sie zahlreiche Lifestyle-, Familien- und Freizeitvorteile erwarten.
Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Vorteile finden Sie hier: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits
Unsere lokalen Vorteile: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

Was Sie tun werden:

• Führen Sie die Sterilitätssicherungsstrategie des Standorts, um die Einhaltung des EU-GMP-Anhangs 1 und anderer globaler regulatorischer Anforderungen zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig die Produktqualität und Patientensicherheit zu gewährleisten.

• Antrieb und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Contamination Control Strategy (CCS), indem sie eine fachkundige Aufsicht über Kontaminationskontrolle, Umweltüberwachung, Reinigung, Desinfektion und aseptische Herstellungsaktivitäten bietet.

• Handeln Sie als vertrauenswürdiges KMU zur Sterilitätssicherung und unterstützen Sie die Einrichtungsgestaltung, Qualifizierung, Validierung, Technologietransfers, Einführung neuer Produkte und die Implementierung innovativer Technologien.

• Verfechten Sie eine Kultur der Qualität und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung durch führende Risikobewertungen, Trendanalysen, Trainingsprogramme und Initiativen, die die Leistung der Sterilitätssicherung auf der gesamten Website stärken.

• Repräsentieren Sie die Qualitätssicherung bei Inspektionen, Audits und regulatorischen Interaktionen, stellen Sie die Inspektionsbereitschaft sicher, fördern Sie die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit und gestalten Sie den zukünftigen Rahmen für die Sterilitätssicherung eines schnell wachsenden Standorts.

Was wir suchen:

• Bewährte Expertise in der Sterilitätssicherung, mit einem tiefen Verständnis des EU-GMP-Anhangs 1 und praktischer Erfahrung bei der Umsetzung und Aufrechterhaltung der Anhang-1-Anforderungen in einer sterilen Fertigungsumgebung ist ein Muss.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse der Contamination Control Strategy (CCS), einschließlich der Fähigkeit, Kontaminationskontrollprogramme zu entwickeln, herauszufordern und kontinuierlich zu verbessern, die die Produktqualität und Patientensicherheit unterstützen.

• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der aseptischen Verarbeitung, einschließlich Medienfüllungen (APS), Kontaminationsrisikomanagement und sterilen Herstellungsprozessen.

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. Unsere Kernwerte Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Alle Ideen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der Sie teilnehmen sollen.
Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen mit allen Hintergründen ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven auf den Tisch bringen. Bei Lonza legen wir Wert auf Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter zu schaffen. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzuwandeln, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.
Bereit, die Zukunft der Biowissenschaften zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben.

L'emplacement réel de ce travail est à Stein, AG, Suisse. Une aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats admissibles et à leur famille, au besoin.

Jouer un rôle central dans la protection des produits pour les patients en conduisant l'assurance de stérilité, le contrôle de la contamination et l'excellence de la qualité sur un site en expansion rapide. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les réseaux mondiaux et les équipes interfonctionnelles, vous influencerez les décisions stratégiques, renforcerez le respect des règlements en évolution et contribuerez à construire l'avenir de la fabrication stérile. Découvrez votre carrière dans les services de médicaments à Lonza!

Ce rôle est principalement basé sur le site. Travailler ensemble en personne soutient une collaboration étroite et en temps réel et la précision technique nécessaire pour fabriquer des médicaments répondant aux normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées. Nous offrons une flexibilité pour travailler à distance pour pas plus de 20% de votre temps. Les demandes sont examinées au cas par cas, en fonction des besoins opérationnels.

Ce que vous obtiendrez :

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé.

En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreuses prestations de vie de famille et de loisirs.
La liste complète de nos avantages globaux peut être consultée ici: https://www.lonza.com/careers/bénéfices
Nos prestations locales: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

Ce que vous ferez :

• Diriger la stratégie d'assurance de la stérilité du site, en assurant le respect de l'annexe 1 des BPF de l'UE et d'autres exigences réglementaires mondiales tout en préservant la qualité du produit et la sécurité des patients.

• Conduire et améliorer continuellement la Stratégie de lutte contre la contamination (SCC) en assurant une surveillance experte des activités de lutte contre la contamination, de surveillance environnementale, de nettoyage, de désinfection et de fabrication aseptique.

• Agir en tant que PME d'assurance de la stérilité de confiance, soutenir la conception des installations, la qualification, la validation, les transferts de technologie, les introductions de nouveaux produits et la mise en oeuvre de technologies innovantes.

• Promouvoir une culture de qualité et d'amélioration continue en menant des évaluations des risques, des analyses des tendances, des programmes de formation et des initiatives qui renforcent le rendement en matière d'assurance de la stérilité dans l'ensemble du site.

• Représenter l'assurance de la qualité pendant les inspections, les vérifications et les interactions réglementaires, assurer la préparation à l'inspection, favoriser la collaboration interfonctionnelle et façonner le futur cadre d'assurance de la stérilité d'un site en croissance rapide.

Ce que nous cherchons :

• Une expertise éprouvée en matière d'assurance de la stérilité, avec une compréhension approfondie de l'annexe 1 des BPF de l'UE et une expérience pratique de la mise en œuvre et du maintien des exigences de l'annexe 1 dans un environnement de fabrication stérile, est indispensable.

• Connaissance approfondie de la Stratégie de lutte contre la contamination (SCC), y compris la capacité de développer, de défier et d'améliorer continuellement les programmes de lutte contre la contamination qui appuient la qualité du produit et la sécurité des patients.

• Expérience approfondie du traitement aseptique, y compris le remplissage des milieux (APS), la gestion des risques de contamination et les opérations de fabrication stérile.

• Un état d'esprit très proactif et orienté vers la solution, passionné par l'identification des causes profondes, le partenariat étroit avec les équipes de production et la mise en œuvre de mesures correctives durables pour prévenir les récidives.

• Excellente communication et influence des compétences, avec maîtrise de l'anglais et la confiance pour représenter l'organisation pendant les audits et les inspections; les compétences en langue allemande et l'expérience de la vérification sont considérées comme des avantages importants.

À propos de Lonza
À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites répartis sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.
L'innovation prospère lorsque des gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous avons hâte de vous accueillir à bord.
Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location

What you’ll do:

• Conduct organizational assessments to identify training needs and gaps, collaborating with department managers.

• Develop training curricula, including course outlines, instructional materials, and assessment tools.

• Facilitate training sessions using a variety of instructional techniques, such as classroom training, virtual training, on-the-job coaching, and e-learning.

• Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of training programs, applying relevant evaluation tools like surveys and assessments.

• Maintain comprehensive records of training activities, materials, and participant progress.

• Ensure all training activities and materials meet compliance standards and regulations.

• Manage training resources, including venues, equipment, and materials, ensuring efficient utilization.

• Leverage Learning Management Systems (LMS) to schedule, track, and report on training activities.

• Keep abreast of the latest trends and technologies in training and development to ensure programs remain current.

• Regularly connect with management and other key collaborators on training progress, challenges, and outcomes

What we’re looking for:

• GMP Knowledge (ideally in an GMP-regulated pharmaceutical industry) required.

• Working experience in a manufacturing environment

• Some experience in training

• Strong organizational and project management skills.

• Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS) e.g. Cornerstone on Demand.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• Fluency in German, English intermediate.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in cinque continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

• Una varietà di vantaggi dipende dal ruolo e dalla posizione

Cosa farai:

• Condurre valutazioni organizzative per identificare le esigenze e le lacune della formazione, collaborando con i responsabili del dipartimento.

• Sviluppare programmi di formazione, compresi i contorni dei corsi, i materiali didattici e gli strumenti di valutazione.

• Facilitare le sessioni di formazione utilizzando una varietà di tecniche didattiche, come la formazione in classe, la formazione virtuale, l'addestramento on-the-job e l'e-learning.

• Monitorare e valutare l'efficacia dei programmi di formazione, applicando strumenti di valutazione rilevanti come sondaggi e valutazioni.

• Mantenere registri completi di attività di formazione, materiali e progressi dei partecipanti.

• Assicurarsi che tutte le attività di formazione e materiali soddisfino gli standard e le normative di conformità.

• Gestire le risorse di formazione, inclusi luoghi, attrezzature e materiali, garantendo un utilizzo efficiente.

• Sistemi di gestione dell'apprendimento delle lezioni (LMS) per pianificare, tracciare e segnalare le attività di formazione.

• Tenere al passo delle ultime tendenze e tecnologie nella formazione e nello sviluppo per garantire che i programmi rimangano attuali.

• Regolarmente connettiti con la gestione e altri collaboratori chiave sul progresso della formazione, le sfide e i risultati

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• GMP Knowledge (idealmente in un'industria farmaceutica regolamentata GMP) richiesto.

• Esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente di produzione

• Una certa esperienza nella formazione

• Forte capacità organizzative e di gestione del progetto.

• Familiarità con i sistemi di gestione dell'apprendimento (LMS) ad esempio Cornerstone su richiesta.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta.

• La competenza in Microsoft Office Suite.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di una squadra.

• Fluency in tedesco, inglese intermedio.

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l'occupazione senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, età, stato come individuo qualificato con disabilità, status veterano protetto, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge.

descriptionByLocale.en:
For our growing biotechnology site in Visp, we are looking for an employee of Biotechnologist Logistics in the 4-shift operation (m/f/d). In this role, you ensure the reliable and GMP-compliant material supply to our production areas and thus make a significant contribution to the successful operation of our biopharmaceutical production processes.

Due to the continuous growth of Lonza and the increasing production capacity, this position offers the opportunity to take responsibility in a dynamic and innovative environment and actively contribute to the further development of our logistics processes.

What we offer you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. The full list of our global services can also be found at: Benefits - Visp

Your tasks:

• Ensure material supply: Timely provision of the required materials in the right quantity and quality for production.

• Manage production warehouses: labeling, loading, post-disposition and ensuring order, cleanliness and material availability.

• Maintain inventory: Ensure correct, up-to-date and traceable inventory management during production campaigns.

• Handling logistics processes: Operational implementation of incoming goods, relocations, material movements and final product shipments.

• Apply SAP EWM: Timely, correct and SOP-compliant execution of all relevant logistics and inventory bookings in SAP EWM.

• Ensure quality and safety: Consistent compliance with all SOPs, work, safety and process specifications as well as the requirements of EHS, xGMP, GDP and ISO 9001.

• Support continuous improvement: actively detect and report deviations and participate in CIP measures and optimization of logistical processes.

Your requirement profile:

• Completed vocational training, preferably in logistics, pharmaceuticals, chemistry, biotechnology or a comparable field

• Experience in a regulated production or logistics environment, ideally in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology sector

• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing; English skills are desirable

• Good user knowledge in SAP EWM; very good IT knowledge in Microsoft 365, SAP and other ERP and warehouse management systems

• Readiness to work in 4-shift operation

• SUVA-approved forklift pass of advantage or willingness to purchase it

• Suitability for cleanroom work and high quality, safety and GMP awareness

• Independent, structured and reliable way of working combined with strong teamwork and flexibility

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

• Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.

• Ein engagiertes Team, das Zusammenarbeit, Offenheit und gegenseitige Unterstützung lebt.

• Aktive Mitarbeit bei der Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von Laborprozessen, Methoden und Arbeitsabläufen.

• Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Teammitglieder sowie beim Wissensaustausch innerhalb des Teams.

Are you looking to work in a challenging GMP-regulated environment and make a meaningful contribution to product quality through physical and physico-chemical testing? As part of our QC Physical Analytics team, you will take ownership of analytical testing, laboratory equipment, and the continuous improvement of our processes.

What you will get:

• A diverse and rewarding role in a modern laboratory environment.

• Meaningful work with a direct impact on product quality and patient safety.

• Access to modern technologies and analytical techniques.

• Opportunities for professional and personal development.

• A collaborative team culture built on openness, respect, and mutual support.

What you will do:

• Perform, evaluate, and document physico-chemical analyses in compliance with cGMP requirements, regulatory expectations, and internal procedures.

• Ensure the timely and GMP-compliant execution of assigned testing activities.

• Take responsibility for designated laboratory equipment, including calibration, qualification, and associated documentation.

• Support troubleshooting activities, deviation investigations, and the implementation of corrective actions.

• Actively contribute to the development and optimization of laboratory processes, analytical methods, and workflows.

• Support the onboarding and training of new team members and promote knowledge sharing within the team.

• Participate in the on-call duty rota as scheduled.

What we are looking for:

• Completed apprenticeship or degree in Chemistry, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a comparable scientific discipline.

• Initial or several years of experience in Quality Control, ideally within a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical, biotech, or chemical manufacturing environment.

• Experience with physical and physico-chemical analytical techniques, such as:

• pH measurements

• UV spectroscopy for protein concentration determination

• Osmolality and conductivity measurements

• Strong quality mindset and understanding of GMP and compliance requirements.

• Structured, independent, and solution-oriented way of working.

• Enjoy working collaboratively and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

• Good command of English and basic German skills.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Stai cercando di lavorare in un ambiente regolamentato GMP impegnativo e dare un contributo significativo alla qualità del prodotto attraverso test fisici e fisico-chimici? Nell'ambito del nostro team QC Physical Analytics, avrai la proprietà di test analitici, attrezzature di laboratorio e il continuo miglioramento dei nostri processi.

Cosa otterrai:

• Un ruolo vario e gratificante in un ambiente di laboratorio moderno.

• Lavoro significativo con un impatto diretto sulla qualità del prodotto e sulla sicurezza del paziente.

• Accesso alle moderne tecnologie e alle tecniche analitiche.

• Opportunità per lo sviluppo professionale e personale.

• Una cultura del team collaborativo costruita su apertura, rispetto e supporto reciproco.

Cosa farai:

• Eseguire, valutare e documentare analisi fisico-chimiche nel rispetto dei requisiti cGMP, aspettative normative e procedure interne.

• Assicurare l'esecuzione tempestiva e conforme a GMP delle attività di test assegnate.

• Assumere la responsabilità di attrezzature di laboratorio designate, tra cui calibrazione, qualificazione e documentazione associata.

• Supporta le attività di risoluzione dei problemi, le indagini sulla deviazione e l'attuazione di azioni correttive.

• Contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo e all'ottimizzazione dei processi di laboratorio, dei metodi analitici e dei flussi di lavoro.

• Sostenere l'imbarco e la formazione di nuovi membri del team e promuovere la condivisione delle conoscenze all'interno del team.

• Partecipare al rota di servizio di chiamata come previsto.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Apprendistato completato o laurea in Chimica, Biologia, Scienze Farmaceutiche, o una disciplina scientifica comparabile.

• Inizialmente o diversi anni di esperienza nel controllo della qualità, idealmente all'interno di un ambiente farmaceutico, biotecnologico o chimico regolamentato da GMP.

• Esperienza con tecniche analitiche fisiche e fisico-chimiche, come:

• Misurazione del pH

• spettroscopia UV per la determinazione della concentrazione delle proteine

• Misurazioni di osmolalità e conducibilità

• Forte mentalità di qualità e comprensione di GMP e requisiti di conformità.

• Strutturato, indipendente e orientato alla soluzione.

• Goditi di lavorare in collaborazione e contribuendo a iniziative di miglioramento continuo.

• Buon comando delle competenze in inglese e tedesco di base.

Informazioni su Lonza

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Möchten Sie in einem anspruchsvollen GMP-regulierten Umfeld arbeiten und durch physikalische und physikalisch-chemische Tests einen sinnvollen Beitrag zur Produktqualität leisten? Als Teil unseres QC Physical Analytics Teams übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für analytische Tests, Laborgeräte und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Prozesse.

Was Sie bekommen werden:

• Eine vielfältige und lohnende Rolle in einer modernen Laborumgebung.

• Sinnvolle Arbeit mit direktem Einfluss auf Produktqualität und Patientensicherheit.

• Zugang zu modernen Technologien und Analysetechniken.

• Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen und persönlichen Entwicklung.

• Eine kooperative Teamkultur, die auf Offenheit, Respekt und gegenseitiger Unterstützung basiert.

Was Sie tun werden:

• Durchführung, Bewertung und Dokumentation physikalisch-chemischer Analysen in Übereinstimmung mit den cGMP-Anforderungen, regulatorischen Erwartungen und internen Verfahren.

• Gewährleistung der zeitnahen und GMP-konformen Durchführung zugewiesener Testaktivitäten.

• Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für benannte Laborgeräte, einschließlich Kalibrierung, Qualifizierung und zugehörige Dokumentation.

• Unterstützung von Fehlerbehebungsaktivitäten, Abweichungsuntersuchungen und der Umsetzung von Korrekturmaßnahmen.

• Aktiv zur Entwicklung und Optimierung von Laborprozessen, Analysemethoden und Workflows beitragen.

• Unterstützen Sie das Onboarding und Training neuer Teammitglieder und fördern Sie den Wissensaustausch innerhalb des Teams.

• Nehmen Sie wie geplant an der Bereitschaftsdienstrotation teil.

Was wir suchen:

• Abgeschlossene Lehre oder Abschluss in Chemie, Biologie, Pharmazeutischen Wissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren wissenschaftlichen Disziplin.

• Erste oder mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Qualitätskontrolle, idealerweise in einer GMP-regulierten pharmazeutischen, biotechnologischen oder chemischen Fertigungsumgebung.

• Erfahrung mit physikalischen und physikalisch-chemischen Analysetechniken wie:

• pH-Wert-Messungen

• UV-Spektroskopie zur Bestimmung der Proteinkonzentration

• Osmolalität und Leitfähigkeitsmessungen

• Starkes Qualitätsdenken und Verständnis der GMP- und Compliance-Anforderungen.

• Strukturierte, unabhängige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

• Genießen Sie die Zusammenarbeit und tragen Sie zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen bei.

• Gute Englischkenntnisse und Grundkenntnisse in Deutsch.

Über Lonza

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. Mit mehr als 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere weltweit vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Kernwerte Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Alle Ideen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der Sie teilnehmen sollen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen mit allen Hintergründen ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza legen wir Wert auf Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter zu schaffen. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzuwandeln, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Biowissenschaften zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben.

The place of work of this office is in Visp, Switzerland. Eligible applicants and their families will be assisted in moving if needed.

To strengthen our QC wet chemistry, we are looking for a committed and professionally experienced personality as a Senior QC Scientist. In this role, in addition to challenging analytical activities in the laboratory, you also assume technical responsibility for defined methods and areas of expertise. They assist the laboratory manager in ensuring an efficient, GMP-compliant laboratory operation and act as their representative in the event of absence

What awaits you:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical working environment.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of advantages, depending on function and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

Their tasks:

• Independent performance of complex analytical tests and methodological activities in the QC laboratory.

• Assuming professional responsibility for defined analytical methods, devices or areas of expertise.

• Support the laboratory manager in organising and coordinating daily laboratory activities.

• Perform the deputy function of laboratory manager and assist with operational and technical issues.

• Ensure timely, high-quality and GMP-compliant delivery of analysis results.

• Support for handling deviations, OOS/OOT results, CAPAs and change controls.

• Professional support of method validations, method verifications and method transfers.

• Performing error analysis and troubleshooting in analytical or methodological challenges.

• Identification and implementation of improvements in analytical methods, processes and workflows.

• Support for audits, inspections and official enquiries in the area of responsibility.

• Promote high data integrity and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.

• Professional support and coaching of employees on methodological issues.

What we are looking for:

• Completed studies in chemistry, biochemistry, pharmacy, life sciences or a comparable scientific discipline.

• Several years of professional experience in a GMP-regulated QC laboratory.

• In-depth knowledge of analytical methods and laboratory processes.

• Experience in method validation, method transfer and analytical troubleshooting.

• Good knowledge of GMP requirements, data integrity and quality systems.

• Experience dealing with deviations, CAPAs and change control processes.

• Strong analytical and conceptual skills and a structured way of working.

• High personal responsibility, teamwork and communication strength.

• Very good knowledge of German and English in word and writing.

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Relocation support: Available for eligible candidates and their families.

Our location in Visp, Switzerland is continuously growing and we are currently looking for an Operations Manager Launch Manufacturing (m/f/d). In this position, you lead the production of innovative active ingredients in our production facilities. We in Development Services & Small-/Mid-Scale Operations support our customers from initial feasibility studies, through clinical testing to product launch and commercial manufacturing. We develop production processes for innovative active substances in our laboratories and carry them out on a technical scale in accordance with GMP in our companies. As Operations Manager Launch Manufacturing, you play a key role in providing patients with new treatment options worldwide.

What awaits you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical working environment

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits for lifestyle, family and leisure. Our complete list of local benefits can be found here:

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Their main tasks

• You are responsible for the timely, high-quality and cost-efficient production of your products. You comply with the applicable regulations and guidelines regarding safety, quality and environment

• You lead risk analysis to ensure quality and safety during production

• You identify opportunities for continuous improvement

• You coordinate and lead cross-functional teams and ensure our customers are delivered cost-effectively and on time.

• Creating effective communication, performance and teamwork You have a trusting and successful working environment in which we and our customers pursue a common goal

• You fit Be flexible with changing priorities and be able to support multiple projects at the same time

Your profile

• Completed degree (PhD or Master) in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering or a related discipline

• Professional experience in chemical and/or pharmaceutical development or production

• Knowledge of GMP and business competence desirable

• Strong analytical skills and pleasure in handling complex technical issues

• Flowing knowledge of German and English in words and writing

• High team and communication skills in dealing with different stakeholders and hierarchical levels

• Proactive, flexible and willing to learn personality with a sense of responsibility and high performance under time pressure

About Lonza
At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.
Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Visp, Switzerland
