jobs.title: Logistics Systems & SAP EWM Specialist 80-100% (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our SCM team as a Logistics Systems & SAP EWM Specialist 80-100% (m/f/d) in Visp and play a key role in connecting Logistics Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, and IT. Drive the optimization of SAP EWM/MM processes, ensure smooth end-to-end logistics operations in a GMP-regulated environment, and help shape the future of our warehouse and supply chain systems.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on: Benefits - Visp

What you’ll do:

• Owns and continuously improves end-to-end SAP MM and SAP EWM processes covering inbound operations, warehousing, internal material flows, production supply, inventory management, returns, and outbound logistics.

• Analyzes business requirements, prepares functional specifications, and supports system configurations, enhancements, interfaces, and rollouts in close collaboration with IT and implementation partners.

• Monitors and manages the integration between SAP ERP/S/4HANA, decentralized SAP EWM, LIMS, 3PL systems, as well as warehouse automation and material handling systems, coordinating issue resolution when required.

• Plans and executes testing activities, data validation, cutover, go-live, hypercare, and handover to support teams, ensuring thorough and compliant documentation of results.

• Ensures compliance with cGMP, data integrity, CSV, quality, safety, and internal governance requirements throughout process and system changes.

• Manages incidents, masterdata, and change requests, conducts root cause analyses, and implements sustainable corrective and preventive actions.

• Defines role and authorization requirements in line with Segregation of Duties (SoD) principles and supports the implementation of risk-based mitigation measures.

• Creates and maintains process documentation, SOPs, work instructions, training materials, and key user documentation, while delivering training and knowledge transfer to end users.

What we are looking for:

• Several years of experience with SAP EWM, ideally complemented by SAP MM expertise, in a manufacturing, pharmaceutical, biotech, or other regulated environment.

• Strong understanding of end-to-end warehouse and logistics processes, including inbound, storage, inventory management, production supply, and outbound distribution.

• Proven ability to translate business requirements into scalable system solutions and drive process improvements in collaboration with business and IT stakeholders.

• Experience with system implementations, enhancements, integrations, testing, validation, cutover, go-live, and hypercare activities.

• Solid knowledge of cGMP, CSV, data integrity, and quality requirements within regulated environments is highly desirable.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

• Proactive, independent, and solution-oriented professional with excellent communication skills

• Fluency in English is required and German is a strong advantage.

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.

Unisciti al nostro team SCM come Logistics Systems & SAP EWM Specialist 80-100% (m/f/d) in Visp e gioca un ruolo chiave nella connessione Logistics Operations, Supply Chain, Quality e IT. Guidare l'ottimizzazione dei processi SAP EWM/MM, garantire operazioni logistiche end-to-end fluide in un ambiente regolamentato GMP, e contribuire a modellare il futuro dei nostri sistemi di magazzino e supply chain.

Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

• Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero. La nostra lista completa di benefici locali su misura in Visp può essere trovata su: Vantaggi - Visp

Cosa farai:

• Owns e migliora continuamente i processi SAP MM e SAP EWM che coprono operazioni di inbound, warehousing, flussi di materiale interno, fornitura di produzione, gestione dell'inventario, ritorni e logistica in uscita.

• Analizza i requisiti aziendali, prepara specifiche funzionali e supporta configurazioni di sistema, miglioramenti, interfacce e rollout in stretta collaborazione con partner IT e implementazione.

• Monitora e gestisce l'integrazione tra SAP ERP/S/4HANA, sistemi SAP EWM decentralizzati, sistemi LIMS, 3PL, sistemi di automazione del magazzino e gestione dei materiali, coordinando la risoluzione dei problemi quando necessario.

• Pianifica ed esegue attività di test, convalida dei dati, cutover, go-live, ipercare e consegna ai team di supporto, garantendo una documentazione completa e conforme dei risultati.

• Garantisce la conformità a cGMP, l'integrità dei dati, CSV, la qualità, la sicurezza e i requisiti di governance interna durante i cambiamenti di processo e di sistema.

• Gestisce gli incidenti, i masterdati e le richieste di cambiamento, conduce analisi delle cause root e implementa azioni correttive e preventive sostenibili.

• Definisce i requisiti di ruolo e di autorizzazione in linea con i principi di Segregazione delle Duties (SoD) e supporta l'attuazione delle misure di mitigazione basate sui rischi.

• Crea e mantiene la documentazione di processo, le SOP, le istruzioni di lavoro, i materiali di formazione e la documentazione chiave dell'utente, offrendo allo stesso tempo formazione e trasferimento di conoscenze agli utenti finali.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Diversi anni di esperienza con SAP EWM, idealmente integrati dalla competenza di SAP MM, in un ambiente di produzione, farmaceutico, biotecnologico o altro.

• Forte comprensione dei processi di magazzino end-to-end e logistica, tra cui inbound, stoccaggio, gestione dell'inventario, fornitura di produzione e distribuzione in uscita.

• Prova capacità di tradurre i requisiti aziendali in soluzioni di sistema scalabili e migliorare i processi in collaborazione con gli stakeholder aziendali e IT.

• Esperienza con implementazioni di sistema, miglioramenti, integrazioni, test, validazione, cutover, go-live e attività di ipercare.

• La solida conoscenza di cGMP, CSV, l'integrità dei dati e i requisiti di qualità in ambienti regolamentati è altamente auspicabile.

• Forte capacità di gestione analitica, problem-solving e stakeholder, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente tra le squadre interfunzionali.

• Professionista attivo, indipendente e orientato alla soluzione con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione

• La fluidità in inglese è richiesta e il tedesco è un forte vantaggio.

Informazioni su Lonza:

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

• Surveille et gère l'intégration entre SAP ERP/S/4HANA, SAP EWM décentralisé, LIMS, systèmes 3PL, ainsi que l'automatisation des entrepôts et les systèmes de manutention des matériaux, en coordonnant la résolution des problèmes au besoin.

• Planifier et exécuter des activités de test, de validation des données, de coupe, de mise en route, d'hypersoins et de remise aux équipes de soutien, en assurant une documentation complète et conforme des résultats.

• Assurer la conformité avec le PSGc, l'intégrité des données, le CSV, la qualité, la sécurité et les exigences de gouvernance interne tout au long des changements de processus et de système.

• Créer et tenir à jour la documentation des processus, les SOP, les instructions de travail, le matériel de formation et la documentation des utilisateurs clés, tout en assurant la formation et le transfert des connaissances aux utilisateurs finaux.

Ce que nous cherchons:

• Plusieurs années d'expérience avec SAP EWM, idéalement complété par l'expertise SAP MM, dans un environnement de fabrication, pharmaceutique, biotech ou autre réglementé.

• Connaissance approfondie des processus d'entreposage et de logistique de bout en bout, y compris l'arrivée, l'entreposage, la gestion des stocks, l'approvisionnement en production et la distribution à l'étranger.

• Capacité éprouvée de traduire les exigences opérationnelles en solutions de systèmes évolutives et d'encourager l'amélioration des processus en collaboration avec les intervenants en affaires et en TI.

• Expérience de la mise en œuvre du système, des améliorations, des intégrations, des tests, de la validation, de la coupe, de la mise en route et des activités d'hypersoins.

• Il est hautement souhaitable de bien connaître les exigences en matière d'intégrité des données et de qualité dans les environnements réglementés.

• De solides compétences en analyse, en résolution de problèmes et en gestion des intervenants, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement entre les équipes interfonctionnelles.

• Professionnel proactif, indépendant et orienté vers la solution avec d'excellentes compétences en communication

• La maîtrise de l'anglais est requise et l'allemand est un avantage important.

À propos de Lonza:

À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.

L'innovation prospère lorsque les gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous nous réjouissons de vous accueillir à bord.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

What we offer you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. The full list of our global services can also be found at: Benefits - Visp

• Planning and realisation of investment projects

• Ensuring technically functional and GMP-compliant execution of projects

jobs.title: Production Planner
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.
We are looking for an Operations Planner (m/f/d) for our location in Visp. You are responsible for the comprehensive operations planning in Manufacturing Complex 2. This includes the coordination of all operational activities (long, mid and short term) within Manufacturing Complex 2, including resources and materials, as well as the coordination of large and small investment projects including qualification activities as needed.

Your tasks:

• Responsible for the operations planning (shop floor scheduling) for large scale mammalian Manufacturing Complex 2 which is a 6 x 20kL production bioreactor facility.

• Development of an integrated plan to coordinate all operational activities (short term day to day on shop floor, and recommendations to the master production schedule related to capacity) within Manufacturing Complex 2

• Coordination and planning of the tasks and requirements of the different areas such as Procurement Planning, Manufacturing Complex 2 Leadership Team and Production, Quality, Maintenance and Engineering, Global Engineering and Lonza Services.

• Develops and owns the Summary Production Schedule (SPS) which is driven by Supply Chain demand Planning and the Master Production Schedule (MPS).

• Development of detailed plans for production planning, maintenance planning, resource planning and availability of plant and equipment

• Proactive development of strategies to anticipate or counteract possible future supply bottlenecks

• Active development of measures to improve planning accuracy (process and system optimizations)

• Development, maintenance and training/compliance on the scheduling tool/system and its use in implementing operations in the facility.

• Develop the planning strategy for Manufacturing Complex 2 Operations

Your Profile:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in supply chain or biotechnology or corresponding training qualification

• Professional experience in production environment (GMP), experience on the shop floor in a biologics operation a distinct advantage.

• English business proficient and German an advantage

• Expert knowledge of SAP ERP/MRP and MES systems such as Syncade

• Proficiency in creation of an integrated schedule in planning software such as Orchestrate, Schedule Pro or Aspen planning a distinct advantage.

• Proficient knowledge of Office programs, especially MS Project

• Experience on scheduling/capacity optimization programs is also desirable.

• Several years of experience in supply planning in pharmaceuticals or biotechnology an advantage

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.
People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in tre continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è dedicata alle persone che lavorano insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte.
Stiamo cercando un Operations Planner (m/f/d) per la nostra posizione a Visp. Sei responsabile della pianificazione completa delle operazioni in Manufacturing Complex 2. Ciò include il coordinamento di tutte le attività operative (lungo, medio e breve termine) all'interno del Manufacturing Complex 2, comprese le risorse e i materiali, nonché il coordinamento di grandi e piccoli progetti di investimento, comprese le attività di qualificazione necessarie.

I vostri compiti:

• Responsabile per la pianificazione delle operazioni (shop floor scheduling) per il mammifero su larga scala Manufacturing Complex 2 che è un impianto di bioreattore di produzione 6 x 20kL.

• Sviluppo di un piano integrato per coordinare tutte le attività operative (short term day to day on shop floor, e raccomandazioni al programma di produzione principale relativo alla capacità) all'interno del Manufacturing Complex 2

• Coordinamento e pianificazione dei compiti e dei requisiti delle diverse aree come Procurement Planning, Manufacturing Complex 2 Leadership Team and Production, Quality, Maintenance and Engineering, Global Engineering and Lonza Services.

• Sviluppa e possiede il programma di produzione sommario (SPS) che è guidato dalla pianificazione della domanda della supply chain e dal programma di produzione master (MPS).

• Sviluppo di piani dettagliati per la pianificazione della produzione, la pianificazione della manutenzione, la pianificazione delle risorse e la disponibilità di impianti e attrezzature

• Sviluppo attivo di strategie per anticipare o contrastare possibili future strozzature di rifornimento

• Sviluppo attivo di misure per migliorare l'accuratezza della pianificazione (ottimizzazione del processo e del sistema)

• Sviluppo, manutenzione e formazione/conformità sullo strumento/sistema di programmazione e il suo utilizzo nelle operazioni di attuazione della struttura.

• Sviluppare la strategia di pianificazione per le operazioni di Manufacturing Complex 2

Il tuo profilo:

• Corso di laurea o master in filiera o biotecnologia o corrispondente qualifica di formazione

• Esperienza professionale in ambiente di produzione (GMP), esperienza sul piano del negozio in un funzionamento biologico un vantaggio distinto.

• Inglese professionale e tedesco un vantaggio

• Conoscenza esperta dei sistemi SAP ERP/MRP e MES come Syncade

• La competenza nella creazione di un programma integrato nel software di pianificazione come Orchestrate, Schedule Pro o Aspen progetta un vantaggio distinto.

• Conoscenza competente dei programmi di Office, in particolare MS Project

• L'esperienza sui programmi di ottimizzazione di pianificazione / capacità è anche auspicabile.

• Diversi anni di esperienza nella pianificazione dell'approvvigionamento nei farmaci o nelle biotecnologie

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.
La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.
We are looking for an Operations Planner (m/f/d) for our location in Visp. You are responsible for the comprehensive operations planning in Manufacturing Complex 2. This includes the coordination of all operational activities (long, mid and short term) within Manufacturing Complex 2, including resources and materials, as well as the coordination of large and small investment projects including qualification activities as needed.

Your tasks:

• Responsible for the operations planning (shop floor scheduling) for large scale mammalian Manufacturing Complex 2 which is a 6 x 20kL production bioreactor facility.

• Development of an integrated plan to coordinate all operational activities (short term day to day on shop floor, and recommendations to the master production schedule related to capacity) within Manufacturing Complex 2

• Coordination and planning of the tasks and requirements of the different areas such as Procurement Planning, Manufacturing Complex 2 Leadership Team and Production, Quality, Maintenance and Engineering, Global Engineering and Lonza Services.

• Develops and owns the Summary Production Schedule (SPS) which is driven by Supply Chain demand Planning and the Master Production Schedule (MPS).

• Development of detailed plans for production planning, maintenance planning, resource planning and availability of plant and equipment

• Proactive development of strategies to anticipate or counteract possible future supply bottlenecks

• Active development of measures to improve planning accuracy (process and system optimizations)

• Development, maintenance and training/compliance on the scheduling tool/system and its use in implementing operations in the facility.

• Develop the planning strategy for Manufacturing Complex 2 Operations

Your Profile:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in supply chain or biotechnology or corresponding training qualification

• Professional experience in production environment (GMP), experience on the shop floor in a biologics operation a distinct advantage.

• English business proficient and German an advantage

• Expert knowledge of SAP ERP/MRP and MES systems such as Syncade

• Proficiency in creation of an integrated schedule in planning software such as Orchestrate, Schedule Pro or Aspen planning a distinct advantage.

• Proficient knowledge of Office programs, especially MS Project

• Experience on scheduling/capacity optimization programs is also desirable.

• Several years of experience in supply planning in pharmaceuticals or biotechnology an advantage

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.
People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
descriptionByLocale.de:

Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung besteht darin, dass engagierte Menschen zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen.

Dies umfasst die Koordination aller operativen Aktivitäten (lang-, mittel- und kurzfristig) innerhalb des Fertigungskomplexes 2, einschließlich Ressourcen und Materialien, sowie die Koordination großer und kleiner Investitionsprojekte, einschließlich Qualifizierungsaktivitäten nach Bedarf.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Verantwortlich für die Betriebsplanung (Scheduling) für den groß angelegten Säugerherstellungskomplex 2, der eine 6 x 20kL Produktions-Bioreaktoranlage ist.

• Entwicklung eines integrierten Plans zur Koordinierung aller operativen Aktivitäten (kurzfristig Tag für Tag in der Werkstatt und Empfehlungen zum Master-Produktionsplan in Bezug auf die Kapazität) innerhalb des Manufacturing Complex 2

• Erstellung von detaillierten Plänen für Produktionsplanung, Wartungsplanung, Ressourcenplanung und Verfügbarkeit von Anlagen und Anlagen

• Aktive Entwicklung von Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Planungsgenauigkeit (Prozess- und Systemoptimierungen)

• Berufserfahrung im Produktionsumfeld (GMP), Erfahrung in der Werkstatt in einem Biologikbetrieb ein deutlicher Vorteil.

• Englisch Business kompetent und Deutsch ein Vorteil

• Erfahrung mit Planungs- / Kapazitätsoptimierungsprogrammen ist ebenfalls wünschenswert.

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Versorgungsplanung in Pharmazeutika oder Biotechnologie von Vorteil

Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um die Herausforderung und Kreativität zu meistern, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem signifikanten Unterschied einhergeht.

Lonza ist weltweit führend in der Pharma- und Biotech-Fertigung. Das Unternehmen betreibt große Produktionsstätten in Visp (Valais), Basel, und Stein (Aargau), Schweiz.

• Développement actif de mesures visant à améliorer l'exactitude de la planification (optimisation des processus et des systèmes)

• Mise au point, entretien et formation/conformité de l'outil/système de programmation et de son utilisation dans la mise en œuvre des opérations de l'installation.

• Élaborer la stratégie de planification des opérations du complexe de fabrication 2

Votre profil:

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en chaîne d'approvisionnement ou en biotechnologie ou formation correspondante

• Expérience professionnelle dans l'environnement de production (BPF), expérience au magasin dans une opération biologique un avantage distinct.

• Anglais compétent et allemand un avantage

• Compétence dans la création d'un calendrier intégré dans les logiciels de planification tels que Orchestrate, Schedule Pro ou Aspen planification d'un avantage distinct.

• Connaissance approfondie des programmes du Bureau, en particulier du projet MS

• L'expérience des programmes d'optimisation de l'horaire et de la capacité est également souhaitable.

• Plusieurs années d'expérience dans la planification de l'approvisionnement en produits pharmaceutiques ou en biotechnologie un avantage

Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.title: Senior QA Expert, Manufacturing 80-100%
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Be part of an exciting project-phase team driving operational readiness from a Quality perspective, ensuring robust documentation, SOP compliance, aseptic process preparedness, and effective deviation and CAPA oversight. This role offers the chance to influence how future manufacturing operations are established, making it an ideal step for professionals looking to transition from production into Quality Assurance. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. We offer flexibility to work remotely for no more than 20% of your time. Requests are considered on a case‑by‑case basis, in line with business needs.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits
Our local benefits: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

What you will do:

• Provide QA oversight for shopfloor manufacturing activities within an exciting growth project, ensuring compliance with GMP requirements and operational readiness.

• Review and approve SOPs, work instructions, and other GMP documentation to support successful start-up and sustainable manufacturing operations.

• Partner with Manufacturing teams to drive aseptic process readiness, including preparation, training support, and execution readiness for APS and future media fill activities.

• Lead and coordinate quality events by reviewing and approving deviations, CAPAs, investigations, and related quality records, ensuring timely and effective resolution.

• Act as the Quality representative during project discussions, audits, and inspections, clearly communicating the quality oversight strategy and supporting inspection readiness.

What we are looking for:

• Proven experience in the pharmaceutical industry within a GMP-regulated environment, with expertise in sterile and/or drug product manufacturing is a must

• Experience in quality oversight, management of deviations, CAPAs, and investigations.

• Fluent German and fluent English communication skills are essential, enabling effective collaboration with shopfloor operators, cross-functional teams, customers, and regulatory authorities.

• Willingness to spend significant time on the manufacturing shopfloor, including working in full aseptic gowning, and a hands-on approach to supporting operations and driving quality excellence is a must

• Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, or a related field, combined with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset, strong stakeholder management skills, and the agility to thrive in a dynamic greenfield project environment.

• Experience supporting regulatory and customer audits and inspections is an advantage.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è in Stein, AG, Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.

Fa parte di un team di progetto entusiasmante che guida la disponibilità operativa da una prospettiva di qualità, assicurando documentazione robusta, conformità SOP, preparazione di processo asettico, e deviazione efficace e supervisione CAPA. Questo ruolo offre la possibilità di influenzare la creazione di future operazioni di produzione, rendendolo un passo ideale per i professionisti che cercano di passare dalla produzione alla Quality Assurance. Scopri il tuo Career in Drug Product Services a Lonza!

Questo ruolo si basa principalmente sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza. Offriamo flessibilità per lavorare da remoto per non più del 20% del vostro tempo. Le richieste sono considerate caso per caso, in linea con le esigenze aziendali.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero.
L'elenco completo dei nostri benefici globali è disponibile qui: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits
I nostri vantaggi locali: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

Cosa farai:

• Fornire la supervisione di QA per le attività di produzione di shopfloor all'interno di un progetto di crescita emozionante, garantendo il rispetto dei requisiti GMP e la disponibilità operativa.

• Esaminare e approvare le SOP, le istruzioni di lavoro e altri documenti GMP per supportare le operazioni di start-up e produzione sostenibili di successo.

• Partner con i team di produzione per guidare la prontezza del processo asettico, tra cui preparazione, supporto formativo e disponibilità di esecuzione per APS e future attività di riempimento dei media.

• Condurre e coordinare eventi di qualità esaminando e approvando deviazioni, CAPAs, indagini e relativi record di qualità, garantendo una risoluzione tempestiva ed efficace.

• Atto come rappresentante di qualità durante le discussioni di progetto, audit e ispezioni, comunicando chiaramente la strategia di supervisione della qualità e sostenendo la disponibilità di ispezione.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Esperienza comprovata nell'industria farmaceutica all'interno di un ambiente regolamentato da GMP, con esperienza nella produzione sterile e/o di prodotti farmaceutici è un must

• Esperienza nella supervisione della qualità, gestione delle deviazioni, CAPAs e indagini.

• Sono essenziali competenze di comunicazione fluenti e tedesche e fluenti, che permettono una collaborazione efficace con gli operatori del settore, team interfunzionali, clienti e autorità di regolamentazione.

• La volontà di trascorrere un tempo significativo sul piano manifatturiero, compreso il lavoro in abito asettico completo, e un approccio pratico per sostenere le operazioni e guidare l'eccellenza della qualità è un must

• Corso di laurea, Master's, o PhD in Scienze della vita, Farmacia, Chimica, Biologia, Biotecnologia, o un campo correlato, combinato con una mentalità pragmatica, orientata alla soluzione, forti capacità di gestione degli stakeholder, e l'agilità di prosperare in un ambiente di progetto greenfield dinamico.

• L'esperienza che supporta le verifiche e le ispezioni normative e dei clienti è un vantaggio.

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.
Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Wir bieten Flexibilität, um nicht mehr als 20% Ihrer Zeit aus der Ferne zu arbeiten. Anträge werden von Fall zu Fall entsprechend den geschäftlichen Bedürfnissen geprüft.

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra massima forza. The place of work of this office is in Visp, Switzerland.

The environmental monitoring department is committed to innovation and continuous improvement. Successful innovation projects are implemented through close cooperation with various departments. This internship focuses on optimizing the efficiency of monitoring processes, streamlining processes and improving overall quality.

This body requires a continuous presence on site. Personal collaboration enables close, timely cooperation and the technical precision required for the production of medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What we offer:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical working environment.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of advantages, depending on function and location.

Their tasks:

• They gain a comprehensive understanding of current processes in engineering, cleanrooms and microbiological laboratories and drive identified improvements.

• As a team, you ensure a smooth process from sample management.

• You plan and carry out optimization processes in the environmental monitoring department.

• They monitor the correct implementation of improvements through close collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth implementation.

• They communicate and implement the improvement plans together with the most important stakeholders.

What we are looking for:

• You are currently enrolled or have recently (within the last 12 months) completed studies in life sciences, (micro)biology, pharmacy or a related subject (FH/BSc/MSc/Diploma).

• They have basic knowledge of microbiology.

• They are well versed in data analysis with e.g.: Excel, R-Script, Python or the like.

• You speak fluent German and English.

• They are communicative, self-motivated and work both independently and in a team.

• They enjoy solving efficiency issues and contributing to a collaborative, dynamic environment.

• They are proactive in capturing information quickly, taking on challenges and successes and bringing added value to a young and innovative team.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of collaboration, responsibility, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Every idea, big or small and from whichever person it comes, has the potential to improve the lives of millions of people, and this is exactly the kind of work we want you to participate in.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate the groundbreaking ideas of our customers into practical therapies, we look forward to welcoming you to our team.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now!

Join a growing and dynamic environment where you will combine hands-on laboratory work with material management, ensuring the availability, control, and efficient handling of critical supplies. This part-time opportunity is ideal for professionals seeking flexibility while contributing to microbiological testing activities such as environmental monitoring, bioburden, endotoxin, sterility, and related analyses. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• Perform routine microbiological testing in a GMP-regulated environment, including activities such as bioburden, environmental monitoring, sterility, and bacterial endotoxin testing, with the opportunity to develop expertise in specific testing areas.

• Coordinate and document microbiological analyses, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant execution of routine laboratory activities.

• Support the continuous improvement and implementation of microbiological methods, technologies, and laboratory processes while contributing to operational excellence.

• Hands-on experience in microbiological testing, particularly bioburden testing, ideally gained in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare environment.

• Strong understanding of GMP requirements and enthusiasm for performing routine laboratory analyses with a high level of accuracy, reliability, and attention to detail.

• Completed training as a Biology Laboratory Technician (BiologielaborantIn) or a BSc in Biology or related life sciences field; experience with endotoxin testing, Growth Direct, or PyroTec PRO is an advantage.

• Experience or interest in laboratory material management, including ordering, inventory control, and ensuring material availability to support smooth laboratory operations.

• Fluent English skills, with German considered a plus; a flexible and collaborative mindset, including willingness to participate in an on-call rotation, and occasionally adjust working hours to meet operational needs.

Unisciti a un ambiente crescente e dinamico in cui unirete il lavoro pratico di laboratorio con la gestione dei materiali, garantendo la disponibilità, il controllo e la gestione efficiente delle forniture critiche. Questa opportunità part-time è ideale per i professionisti che cercano flessibilità, contribuendo a attività di test microbiologici come monitoraggio ambientale, bioburden, endotossina, sterilità e analisi correlate. Scopri il tuo Career in Drug Product Services a Lonza!

Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero.

I nostri vantaggi locali: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

Cosa farai:

• Gestisci materiali di laboratorio e materiali di consumo, tra cui l'ordinazione, il monitoraggio delle scorte, il controllo dell'inventario e la continua disponibilità di forniture critiche.

• Eseguire test microbiologici di routine in un ambiente GMP-regolato, tra cui attività come bioburden, monitoraggio ambientale, sterilizzazione e test di endotossina batterica, con l'opportunità di sviluppare competenze in aree di test specifiche.

• Coordinate e documentate analisi microbiologiche, assicurando l'esecuzione accurata, tempestiva e conforme delle attività di laboratorio di routine.

• Sostenere il continuo miglioramento e l'implementazione di metodi, tecnologie e processi di laboratorio microbiologici, contribuendo al contempo all'eccellenza operativa.

• Assicurare la disponibilità di laboratorio attraverso la manutenzione delle attrezzature, il rispetto dei requisiti cGMP e di sicurezza, e la partecipazione ai compiti on-call per supportare le esigenze aziendali.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Esperienza pratica nel test microbiologico, in particolare nel test bioburden, idealmente acquisita in un ambiente farmaceutico, biotecnologico o sanitario regolamentato da GMP.

• Forte comprensione dei requisiti GMP e dell'entusiasmo per l'esecuzione di analisi di laboratorio di routine con un alto livello di precisione, affidabilità e attenzione ai dettagli.

• Completato la formazione come un Biology Laboratory Technician (BiologielaborantIn) o una laurea in Biologia o nel campo delle scienze della vita correlate; l'esperienza con test di endotossina, Growth Direct, o PyroTec PRO è un vantaggio.

• Esperienza o interesse nella gestione dei materiali di laboratorio, tra cui l'ordinazione, il controllo dell'inventario e la garanzia della disponibilità dei materiali per supportare operazioni di laboratorio fluide.

• Capacità fluenti dell'inglese, con il tedesco considerato un plus; una mentalità flessibile e collaborativa, tra cui la volontà di partecipare a una rotazione on-call, e occasionalmente regolare le ore di lavoro per soddisfare le esigenze operative.

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. Diese Teilzeitmöglichkeit ist ideal für Fachleute, die Flexibilität suchen und gleichzeitig zu mikrobiologischen Testaktivitäten wie Umweltüberwachung, Biobelastung, Endotoxin, Sterilität und damit verbundenen Analysen beitragen. Schauen Sie sich Ihre Karriere in Drug Product Services bei Lonza!

Dies ist eine vollständig ortsbezogene Rolle. Die persönliche Zusammenarbeit unterstützt eine enge Echtzeit-Zusammenarbeit und die technische Präzision, die erforderlich ist, um Arzneimittel nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards herzustellen.

Was Sie bekommen werden:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz.

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung erkennen.

• Verwalten Sie Labormaterialien und Verbrauchsmaterialien, einschließlich Bestellung, Bestandsüberwachung, Bestandskontrolle und Gewährleistung der kontinuierlichen Verfügbarkeit kritischer Lieferungen.

• Führen Sie routinemäßige mikrobiologische Tests in einer GMP-regulierten Umgebung durch, einschließlich Aktivitäten wie Biobelastung, Umweltüberwachung, Sterilität und bakterielle Endotoxintests, mit der Möglichkeit, Fachwissen in bestimmten Testbereichen zu entwickeln.

• Koordinieren und dokumentieren Sie mikrobiologische Analysen, um eine genaue, rechtzeitige und konforme Durchführung der routinemäßigen Laboraktivitäten zu gewährleisten.

• Unterstützung der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Umsetzung mikrobiologischer Methoden, Technologien und Laborprozesse und gleichzeitiger Beitrag zur operativen Exzellenz.

• Gewährleistung der Laborbereitschaft durch Wartung der Geräte, Einhaltung der cGMP- und Sicherheitsanforderungen und Teilnahme an Bereitschaftsdiensten zur Unterstützung der Geschäftsanforderungen.

Was wir suchen:

• Hands-on-Erfahrung in mikrobiologischen Tests, insbesondere Bioburden-Tests, idealerweise in einem GMP-regulierten Pharma-, Biotech- oder Gesundheitsumfeld.

• Starkes Verständnis der GMP-Anforderungen und Begeisterung für die Durchführung von routinemäßigen Laboranalysen mit einem hohen Maß an Genauigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Liebe zum Detail.

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Biologie-Labortechniker (BiologielaborantIn) oder BSc in Biologie oder verwandten Biowissenschaften; Erfahrung mit Endotoxin-Tests, Growth Direct oder PyroTec PRO ist von Vorteil.

• Erfahrung oder Interesse an Labormaterialmanagement, einschließlich Bestellung, Bestandskontrolle und Sicherstellung der Materialverfügbarkeit, um einen reibungslosen Laborbetrieb zu unterstützen.

• Fließende Englischkenntnisse, wobei Deutsch als Plus gilt; eine flexible und kollaborative Denkweise, einschließlich der Bereitschaft, an einer Bereitschaftsrotation teilzunehmen und gelegentlich die Arbeitszeiten an die betrieblichen Bedürfnisse anzupassen.

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. Bereit, die Zukunft der Biowissenschaften zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben.

Joignez-vous à un environnement dynamique et en pleine croissance où vous combinerez travail de laboratoire pratique et gestion des matériaux, assurant la disponibilité, le contrôle et la manipulation efficace des approvisionnements critiques. Cette occasion à temps partiel est idéale pour les professionnels qui recherchent la flexibilité tout en contribuant à des activités d'analyse microbiologique telles que la surveillance environnementale, la biocharge, l'endotoxine, la stérilité et les analyses connexes. C'est un rôle entièrement basé sur le site. Travailler ensemble en personne soutient une collaboration étroite en temps réel et la précision technique nécessaire pour fabriquer des médicaments répondant aux normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées.

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.

• Coordonner et documenter les analyses microbiologiques, en assurant l'exécution exacte, en temps opportun et conforme des activités de laboratoire courantes.

• Appuyer l'amélioration continue et la mise en oeuvre des méthodes microbiologiques, des technologies et des processus de laboratoire tout en contribuant à l'excellence opérationnelle.

• Assurer la préparation des laboratoires par l'entretien de l'équipement, la conformité aux BPFC et aux exigences en matière de sécurité, et la participation à des tâches de garde pour répondre aux besoins des entreprises.

Ce que nous cherchons:

• Expérience pratique des tests microbiologiques, en particulier des tests de biocharge, idéalement acquise dans un environnement pharmaceutique, biotechnologique ou de santé réglementé par les BPF.

• Bonne compréhension des exigences des BPF et enthousiasme pour effectuer des analyses de laboratoire de routine avec un haut niveau de précision, de fiabilité et d'attention aux détails.

• La formation terminée en tant que technicien de laboratoire en biologie (laborateur en biologie) ou B.Sc. en biologie ou dans le domaine connexe des sciences de la vie; l'expérience des tests d'endotoxine, de croissance directe ou de PyroTec PRO est un avantage.

• Expérience ou intérêt dans la gestion des matériaux de laboratoire, y compris la commande, le contrôle des stocks et la garantie de la disponibilité des matériaux pour faciliter les opérations de laboratoire.

• Les compétences en anglais, avec l'allemand considéré comme un plus; une mentalité flexible et collaborative, y compris la volonté de participer à une rotation sur appel, et parfois ajuster les heures de travail pour répondre aux besoins opérationnels.

jobs.title: Bioprocess Engineer DSP
jobs.description:
Posted Job Advert

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

As the global manufacturing partner for many different customers, we are increasing manufacturing capacity. As other businesses face growing economic uncertainty, we are fortunate to have opportunities for expansion. Through this new collaboration, our work will have a significant, direct and long-term impact on the management of this global pandemic.
In order to support our continued growth Lonza is seeking Bioprocess Engineers with a relevant background in Life Sciences and a passion for Biotechnology to join our talent community in Visp, Switzerland. Become part of this great opportunity and join our team by applying for the position as Bioprocess Engineer within our Mammalian Business Division either in Upstream Processing or Downstream Processing.

Key responsibilities:

• Ensure that operational activities for clinical and/or commercial manufacturing are performed on-time and within given safety and quality standards

• Act as the functional lead for preparation, manufacturing execution, cleaning and changeover in the assigned area

• Lead of one or more defined USP areas (e.g. seed train, main cultivation or harvest) for the production of therapeutic proteins with either mammalian or microbial expressions systems (Bioprocess Engineer USP)

• In charge of one or more defined DSP areas (e.g. gain, polishing or filling) for the purification of therapeutic proteins from either mammalian (Bioprocess Engineer DSP)

Key requirements:

• Master’s Degree or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry or related Life Science subject, or Bachelor’s holder with experience in pharma production

• Knowledge in either USP (such as bioreactors) or DSP units (such as chromatography)

• Couple of years working experience in biomanufacturing required

• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology

• Excellent communication skills in English, good German skills of advantage

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving sophisticated problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join a collaborative, proactive and diverse team where you will drive process excellence across compounding operations, support operators with technical expertise, lead deviations,  investigations, and execute validation and qualification activities while ensuring continuous inspection readiness. As part of an exciting greenfield growth project, you will take ownership, make a visible impact, and contribute to the successful delivery of safe, high-quality products. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits
Our local benefits: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

What you will do:

• Lead and continuously improve aseptic compounding processes, leveraging GMP manufacturing experience to ensure safe, compliant, and efficient operations.

• Provide hands-on technical support to operators, troubleshoot process issues, and drive deviations, investigations, and corrective actions to maintain product quality and compliance.

• Execute and support validation and qualification activities, including the preparation, review, and maintenance of all relevant GMP documentation.

• Maintain equipment and processes in an inspection-ready state, support internal and external audits, and contribute expertise in sterile manufacturing environments.

• Collaborate within a proactive, reliable, and accountable team, bringing a BSc/MSc in a scientific discipline, fluent English and conversational German (B1); experience with GMP washers, sterilization processes, thawing, and compounding is an advantage.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a Life Sciences discipline (e.g., Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Biology, Chemistry) with hands-on experience in aseptic/sterile manufacturing environments.

• Proven experience in GMP-regulated manufacturing, with a strong understanding of quality, compliance, and documentation requirements is a must. Experience in qualification and validation activities are a strong advantage.

• Fluent English and conversational German (B1 level or above), enabling effective communication across teams and functions.

• A proactive, reliable team player who enjoys collaborating with others, takes ownership of responsibilities, and thrives in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and multiple parallel activities.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity with a high degree of flexibility; experience in thawing and compounding operations and knowledge of GMP washers and autoclaves are considered strong advantages.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

Cosa farai:

• Guidare e migliorare continuamente i processi di compounding asettico, sfruttando l'esperienza di produzione GMP per garantire operazioni sicure, conformi ed efficienti.

• Fornire supporto tecnico pratico agli operatori, problemi di processo di risoluzione dei problemi e deviazioni di unità, indagini e azioni correttive per mantenere la qualità del prodotto e la conformità.

• Eseguire e sostenere le attività di validazione e qualificazione, tra cui la preparazione, la revisione e la manutenzione di tutta la documentazione GMP rilevante.

• Mantenere le attrezzature e i processi in uno stato pronto all'ispezione, sostenere gli audit interni ed esterni, e contribuire a competenze in ambienti di produzione sterili.

• Collaborare all'interno di un team proattivo, affidabile e responsabile, portando un BSc/MSc in una disciplina scientifica, fluente inglese e conversazione tedesco (B1); esperienza con lavatrici GMP, processi di sterilizzazione, scongelamento e compounding è un vantaggio.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Corso di laurea o Master in una disciplina di Scienze della Vita (ad esempio, Biotecnologia, Farmacia, Biologia, Chimica) con esperienza pratica in ambienti di produzione asettico/sterile.

• Un'esperienza comprovata nella produzione regolamentata da GMP, con una forte comprensione dei requisiti di qualità, conformità e documentazione. L'esperienza nelle attività di qualificazione e validazione è un forte vantaggio.

• Tedesco fluente e conversazione (livello B1 o superiore), che consente una comunicazione efficace tra team e funzioni.

• Un giocatore di squadra proattivo e affidabile che si diverte a collaborare con altri, prende la proprietà delle responsabilità, e prospera in un ambiente frenetico con il cambiamento delle priorità e molteplici attività parallele.

• Confortevole ambiguità di navigazione con un alto grado di flessibilità; l'esperienza nelle operazioni di scongelamento e compounding e la conoscenza di lavatrici GMP e autoclavi sono considerati forti vantaggi.

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.
Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

• Coordinamento e revisione delle notifiche sulla domanda di energia e delle questioni relative alla rete di teleriscaldamento

• Corso di laurea o master in ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria del processo/chimica o ingegneria elettrica (attenzione su energia elettrica) o istruzione equivalente

• Conoscenza sonora del tedesco e buona conoscenza dell'inglese

Become part of our energy management team in Visp!

Do you not only want to manage energy, but actively contribute to making its use more efficient, sustainable and future-proof? In this versatile position, you play a central role in the energy management of our plant and shape the entire energy value chain – from procurement and generation to efficient use and recovery. You combine technical know-how with data analysis, project work and innovative solutions and make a concrete contribution to increasing energy efficiency and reducing CO2 emissions.

This is what we offer you:

• An agile career and dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits for lifestyle, family and leisure. All global services can be found here: Benefits - Visp

Your tasks:

• Coordination and optimization of the energy value chain (procurement, generation, distribution, conversion, application, recovery) with the aim of a long-term secured, sufficient, inexpensive and reliable energy supply as well as support of projects in energy management

• Analysis and monitoring of the various energies and emissions in the plant

• Cooperation and coordination in interdisciplinary teams

• Use of funding programmes to exploit potential savings

• Development of energy efficiency measures (savings potential, waste heat utilization, CO2 reductions)

• Process optimizations regarding energy data management

• Cooperation in energy procurement and its management of the plant

• Coordination and review of energy demand notifications as well as issues relating to the district heating network

Your profile:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, process/chemical engineering or electrical engineering (focus on electrical energy) or equivalent education

• Sound knowledge of German and good knowledge of English

• Ideally, practical experience in industry or in an engineering office in the energy, chemical or process engineering sector

• Independent, reliable and flexible personality

• Proactive team player with pleasure in interdisciplinary cooperation

• Project or practical experience in the energy sector

• Experience with IT tools such as MS-Office, SAP, Pipenet

• Interest in data processing and AI application in the energy sector

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s exactly what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland.

We are looking for a motivated and curious Bachelor’s or Master’s graduate who is interested in building a career in Quality Control with focus on Compliance within a GMP- and ISO- regulated environment. This position offers a unique opportunity to work directly on the laboratory floor, partnering with different QCII laboratories to drive compliance, continuous improvement, and data integrity initiatives.
The successful candidate will gain hands-on experience in Quality Control operations while contributing to projects that directly support GMP compliance, audit readiness, process improvement, and laboratory excellence.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

What you'll do:

• Support QCII laboratories in maintaining compliance with GMP, ISO, and Quality requirements.

• Assist with CAPA implementation, investigation management, and timely closure of quality events.

• Partner with laboratory teams to identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities.

• Drive and support  Data Integrity, Good Documentation Practices (GDocP), and data management initiatives.

• Support 6S activities and help improve laboratory organization and operational excellence.

• Prepare and maintain documentation for audits, inspections, SOPs, and compliance programs.

• Contribute to training activities, GEMBA walks, and the promotion of a strong quality implementation across QC II.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Quality Management, Engineering, or a related field.

• Strong interest in Quality Control, Compliance, and regulated environments.

• Basic understanding of GMP regulations is an advantage.

• Excellent organizational and communication skills.

• Proactive mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.

• Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and laboratory personnel.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Good written and verbal communication skills in English German is mandatory

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

• Preparare e mantenere la documentazione per audit, ispezioni, SOP e programmi di conformità.

• Contribuire alle attività di formazione, alle passeggiate GEMBA e alla promozione di una forte implementazione di qualità in tutto il QC II.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Laurea o Master in Scienze della vita, Chimica, Farmacia, Biotecnologia, Gestione della qualità, Ingegneria, o un campo correlato.

• Forte interesse per il controllo della qualità, la conformità e gli ambienti regolamentati.

• La comprensione di base delle normative GMP è un vantaggio.

• Eccellente capacità organizzative e di comunicazione.

• Mindset proattivo con una passione per il miglioramento continuo.

• Capacità di lavorare efficacemente con team interfunzionali e personale di laboratorio.

• Forte attenzione al dettaglio e all'impegno per la qualità.

• Buone capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali in inglese tedesco è obbligatorio

I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated individuals working together, brainstorming ideas that support businesses in making a positive impact on society. In return, we empower our employees to take ownership of their careers. Their innovative ideas, whether big or small, truly make a difference in the world. And that’s the type of work we aspire to contribute to.

Are you ready to take on the role of Data Reviewer (all genders) in our analytical Quality Control laboratory, located in the breathtaking Visp? Join our groundbreaking laboratory that boasts brand-new technology and instruments, and collaborate with a vibrant and international team. Your primary responsibilities will revolve around conducting routine analysis of biopharmaceuticals using HPLC and capillary electrophoresis techniques. In this role, you will also be responsible for reviewing data generated during routine Quality Control (QC) analysis in the QC Laboratory. Your expertise will ensure that all laboratory work aligns with GMP and SOPs, enabling the timely release of monoclonal antibody batches.

What you will get:

• An agile scientific career in a dynamic, GMP‑regulated environment.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace that values collaboration and accountability.

• Compensation programs that recognize performance and technical expertise.

• Opportunities to deepen your expertise and take ownership of impactful projects.

• Exposure to cross‑functional collaboration and regulatory interactions.

• A supportive culture that encourages continuous improvement and learning.

• Competitive local benefits.

Benefits in Visp

What you will do:

• You review HPLC data and other laboratory-related raw data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance.

• You perform tasks within the gLIMS laboratory execution system, including creating consumable types and managing instruments and consumables.

• You ensure all activities comply with GMP requirements and internal procedures.

• You investigate ambiguous results with curiosity and attention to detail.

• You adapt effectively to changing priorities in a dynamic Quality Control environment.

What we are looking for:

• You have completed training as a laboratory technician or hold a bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biochemistry, or a related scientific field.

• Experience in a GMP-regulated Quality Control environment is highly preferred.

• Hands-on experience with HPLC and/or capillary electrophoresis (CE) is preferred.

• You bring a highly detail-oriented, flexible, and investigative mindset.

• You communicate fluently in English; German skills are a plus.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Become part of our workshop team in Visp and make sure with your commitment that our infrastructure, green areas and operating areas are always in the best condition. In this varied function, you take on a wide range of maintenance, maintenance and transport tasks and make an important contribution to a safe, efficient and well-maintained working environment. Together as a team, you ensure that our location functions smoothly and meets the highest quality standards.

This position requires a full local presence. Personal collaboration enables close coordination in real time and ensures the technical precision required for the production of medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What we offer you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. The full list of our global services can also be found at: Benefits - Visp

Your tasks:

• You take over the maintenance and maintenance of green areas, streets, squares as well as premises and storage areas.

• You perform internal and external bringing and fetching services.

• You ensure the proper disposal of waste and ensure order and cleanliness.

• You carry out minor repair and maintenance work independently.

• You are responsible for the maintenance and maintenance of the equipment and machine park.

• You order various materials and consumer goods after consultation with the competent authorities.

• You support in further tasks according to the instructions of the head of the workshop or his deputy.

Your requirement profile:

• You have a completed vocational apprenticeship EFZ or EBA as a landscaper or in a comparable profession.

• You bring good knowledge in a technical, crafts or building-related professional environment.

• You have experience in safe handling of operating equipment, machines and tools.

• You have a valid category B driving licence.

• A construction machine identification card is advantageous.

• You have good knowledge of the operational processes as well as solid user knowledge in MS-Office.

• You communicate stylishly in German; English skills are a plus.

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.

If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
