jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

As Project Lead Quality Control, you will serve as the primary QC interface for customers, evaluating laboratory capacity, coordinating analytical method transfers, and ensuring the successful implementation of release and stability testing for late-phase and commercial Drug Products.
Working closely with Program Managers and cross-functional teams, you will drive QC project execution, manage timelines and customer interactions, provide scientific guidance on analytical testing strategies, and ensure regulatory and GMP-compliant delivery of project milestones. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. We offer flexibility to work remotely for no more than 20% of your time. Requests are considered on a case‑by‑case basis, in line with business needs.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Lead and coordinate QC related project activities for release and stability testing of late-phase (PPQ) and commercial drug products, with a focus on large molecules and Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADCs).

• Serve as the primary QC representative and project champion, driving project execution through effective coordination of timelines, deliverables, customer engagements, and stakeholder communication in close partnership with Program Managers.

• Assess laboratory capacity and manage analytical method transfers, ensuring timely implementation of testing to meet customer and project requirements.

• Implement analytical testing strategies, including method suitability assessments, performance evaluation, control strategies, and specification setting.

• Author for quality records and cGMP documents e.g. procedures (SOPs) or source documents, reports, deviations, change requests etc.

• Act as QC subject matter expert during audits, inspections, and customer meetings while ensuring GMP-compliant documentation and regulatory readiness.

What we are looking for:

• Work experience in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical Quality Control environment with a sound understanding of analytical testing of biologics (large molecules) is a must.

• You enjoy working with many different people: strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to coordinate activities, provide constructive challenge, and interact effectively with customers and internal teams.

• Experience in project coordination, analytical method validation and/or method transfer is a strong advantage.

• Fluency in English is a must, fluency in German is a plus.

• Degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related life sciences discipline.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è in Stein, AG, Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.

In qualità di Project Lead Quality Control, servirai come interfaccia QC primaria per i clienti, valutando la capacità di laboratorio, coordinando i trasferimenti di metodi analitici, e garantendo la riuscita implementazione dei test di rilascio e stabilità per i prodotti farmaceutici di ultima fase e commerciali.
Lavorando a stretto contatto con i Program Manager e i team interfunzionali, guiderai l'esecuzione del progetto QC, gestirai le linee temporali e le interazioni dei clienti, fornirai una guida scientifica sulle strategie di test analitici e garantirai la consegna normativa e conforme a GMP delle pietre miliari del progetto. Scopri il tuo Career in Drug Product Services a Lonza!

Questo ruolo si basa principalmente sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di medicinali ai massimi standard di qualità e sicurezza. Offriamo flessibilità per lavorare da remoto per non più del 20% del vostro tempo. Le richieste sono considerate caso per caso, in linea con le esigenze aziendali.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero.
L'elenco completo dei nostri benefici globali è disponibile qui: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

Cosa farai:

• Guidare e coordinare le attività di progetto relative al QC per il rilascio e il test di stabilità dei prodotti farmaceutici di ultima fase (PPQ) e di droga commerciale, con un focus sulle molecole di grandi dimensioni e Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADCs).

• Servire come principale rappresentante del QC e campione del progetto, guidare l'esecuzione del progetto attraverso un coordinamento efficace delle linee temporali, dei prodotti, degli impegni dei clienti e della comunicazione degli stakeholder in stretta collaborazione con i Program Manager.

• Valutare la capacità di laboratorio e gestire i trasferimenti di metodi analitici, assicurando l'implementazione tempestiva dei test per soddisfare i requisiti del cliente e del progetto.

• Attuazione strategie di test analitici, tra cui valutazioni di idoneità del metodo, valutazione delle prestazioni, strategie di controllo e impostazione delle specifiche.

• Autore per documenti di qualità e documenti cGMP, ad esempio procedure (SOP) o documenti sorgente, rapporti, deviazioni, richieste di cambiamento ecc.

• Atto come esperto di materia QC durante i controlli, le ispezioni e le riunioni dei clienti, assicurando al contempo la documentazione conforme a GMP e la prontezza normativa.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• L'esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente di controllo della qualità farmaceutica regolamentato da GMP con una solida comprensione dei test analitici delle biologiche (grandi molecole) è un must.

• Ti piace lavorare con molte persone diverse: forte collaborazione e competenze di gestione degli stakeholder, con la fiducia di coordinare le attività, fornire una sfida costruttiva, e interagire efficacemente con i clienti e i team interni.

• L'esperienza nel coordinamento del progetto, la validazione dei metodi analitici e/o il trasferimento dei metodi è un vantaggio forte.

• La fluenza in inglese è un must, la fluenza in tedesco è un plus.

• Laurea in Chimica, Biochimica, Biologia, Scienze Farmaceutiche, o una disciplina relativa delle scienze della vita.

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, il nostro popolo è la nostra più grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.
Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applica ora.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

What you’ll do:

• Primary point of contact between QC customer and CSM for authoring, revising and reviewing of GMP reference standard qualification protocols and reports, primarily for biotechnological reference materials.

• Timely completion of qualification protocols and reports enabling LIMS/LES-related activities (MLP specifications, test schedules) and support thereof

• Providing technical mentoring and coaching to colleagues within and outside the team in a matrix environment.

• Support quality documentation and change management process for reference standards, including review, revision, and timely completion of Trackwise records.

• Leading innovation projects within the area of responsibility and identifying opportunities for cost and efficiency optimization.

• Providing SME input for project-specific topics during audits and inspections.

• Compliance with quality, data integrity, and safety requirements.

• Collaboration with QC project leads, QA Analytics,  as well as external clients.

What we’re looking for:

• Master’s degree or equivalent experience in a Life Sciences discipline (Biology, Chemistry or related field).

• Proven experience in a cGMP environment – experience in quality control or analytical development preferred.

• Exceptional technical writing skills.

• Advanced scientific experience in analytical chemistry/biology.

• Extensive knowledge with QC relevant software (e.g. LIMS/LES, DMS, Trackwise, Statistica).

• Team player.

• Change readiness.

• Proficiency in English required – proficiency in German preferred.

• Excellent project and time management skills.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Dabei gewährleistest Du die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sowie die nachhaltige Weiterentwicklung von Team und Organisation.

Diese Position erfordert eine vollständige Präsenz vor Ort. Die persönliche Zusammenarbeit ermöglicht eine enge Abstimmung in Echtzeit und gewährleistet die technische Präzision, die für die Herstellung von Arzneimitteln nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards erforderlich ist.

Was wir Dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

Deine Aufgaben:

• Fachliche und organisatorische Führung eines CQV-Teams.

• Verantwortung für die Planung, Koordination und Überwachung von Qualifizierungsaktivitäten (DQ, IQ, OQ, PQ) für komplexe Anlagen, Geräte und Systeme in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering, Produktion, QA und weiteren Stakeholdern.

• Steuerung externer Dienstleister und Lieferanten sowie Übernahme der Eskalationsverantwortung bei fachlichen, organisatorischen und Compliance-relevanten Themen.

• Förderung der fachlichen Weiterentwicklung des Teams durch Coaching, Wissensmanagement, strukturierte Einarbeitung und Aufbau einer leistungsorientierten Teamkultur.

• Unterstützung von Audits und Inspektionen sowie Sicherstellung der langfristigen Verfügbarkeit kritischer CQV-Kompetenzen im Einklang mit Standort- und Business-Strategien.

Deine Qualifikationen:

• Abgeschlossenes Studium (HF, FH, ETH) in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Biotechnologie, Pharmazie oder einer vergleichbaren technischen bzw. naturwissenschaftlichen Fachrichtung.

• Fundierte Erfahrung in der fachlichen und organisatorischen Führung von Teams sowie in der Steuerung komplexer CQV-Projekte und multidisziplinärer Stakeholder.

• Ausgeprägte Führungs-, Kommunikations- und Organisationskompetenz sowie hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Durchsetzungsvermögen.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Erstellung und Durchführung von Qualifizierungsdokumentationen (DQ, IQ, OQ, PQ), Risikoanalysen sowie regulatorischen Anforderungen (GMP/GxP).

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Team Lead CQV - Specialized Modalities 80-100% (m/f/d) in Visp You will be responsible for the professional and organizational management of a CQV team and ensure the successful planning, coordination and implementation of qualification activities for plants, systems and processes. You ensure compliance with regulatory requirements as well as the sustainable further development of the team and organization.

This position requires a full local presence. Personal collaboration enables close coordination in real time and ensures the technical precision required for the production of medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What we offer you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. The full list of our global services can also be found at: Benefits - Visp

Your tasks:

• Professional and organizational leadership of a CQV team.

• Responsibility for the planning, coordination and monitoring of qualification activities (DQ, IQ, OQ, PQ) for complex plants, devices and systems in close cooperation with engineering, production, QA and other stakeholders.

• Management of external service providers and suppliers as well as assuming escalation responsibility for technical, organizational and compliance-relevant topics.

• Promoting the professional development of the team through coaching, knowledge management, structured familiarisation and building a performance-oriented team culture.

• Support audits and inspections and ensure the long-term availability of critical CQV competencies in line with location and business strategies.

Your qualifications:

• Completed studies (HF, FH, ETH) in engineering, biotechnology, pharmacy or a comparable technical or scientific discipline.

• In-depth experience in the professional and organizational management of teams as well as in the management of complex CQV projects and multidisciplinary stakeholders.

• Strong leadership, communication and organizational competence as well as a high sense of responsibility and assertiveness.

• Several years of experience in commissioning, qualification and validation (CQV) of plants, systems and processes within a regulated environment.

• In-depth knowledge in the preparation and implementation of qualification documentation (DQ, IQ, OQ, PQ), risk analyses and regulatory requirements (GMP/GxP).

• Very good knowledge of German and English in word and writing.

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

jobs.description:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Neben all den Analysetätigkeiten ausgeführt durch Laborant-/innen in den verschiedenen Laboren, erledigen Sie Routineaufgaben, wie aber auch spontan auftretende Anfragen. In Ihrer Funktion stehen Sie in regelmässigem Austausch mit verschiedenen Schnittstellen, unter anderem mit den Laboren, der Logistik sowie der Qualitätssicherung.

Was wir ihnen bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz.

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen.

• Neben wettbewerbsfähigen Gehältern finden Sie eine breite Palette an Lifestyle-, Familien- und Freizeitvorteilen. Je nach Standort können diese Vorteile Familienzulagen, Unterstützung bei der Kinderbetreuung, Rabatte für lokale Unternehmen und Attraktionen, Reisekostenzuschüsse und subventionierte Mahlzeiten umfassen.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Verteilung von analytischen Proben in die verschiedenen Labore der QC.

• Organisation und Verteilung des Referenzstandardmaterials aus dem zentralen Lager.

• Mitarbeit bei logistischen Arbeiten im Labor (Abfallmanagement, Laborglasreinigung, Verteilung und Organisation von eingehendem Verbrauchsmaterial und Chemikalien).

• Kalibration, Wartung und Reinigung von Laborgeräten.

• Abarbeitung von spontanen Anfragen aus dem Labor.

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:

• Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung.

• Sie sind selbstständig, verantwortungsbewusst und besitzen eine gute Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit sowie Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit.

• Sie sind bereit, sich in ein Team zu integrieren, sind engagiert, motiviert und besitzen eine gute Eigeninitiative.

• EDV Kenntnisse (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams usw.) werden vorausgesetzt.

• Sichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden ihr Profil ab. Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil.

Lonza’s Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. descriptionByLocale.it:
Lonza è oggi leader mondiale nelle scienze della vita, operante in tre continenti. Lavoriamo nella scienza, ma non c'è formula magica per come ci avviciniamo al lavoro. La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante è dipendenti di talento che collaborano e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti guidano la loro carriera in modo indipendente. Perché le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano il mondo. E questo e' il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo fare.

Al sito Visp, un dipendente di supporto di laboratorio è ricercato. Come membro del QC Labor Support Team, si occupa di una vasta gamma di compiti per garantire un funzionamento di laboratorio regolare, nel rispetto delle linee guida di qualità e sicurezza applicabili. Oltre a tutte le attività analitiche svolte dai tecnici di laboratorio nei vari laboratori, si svolgono compiti di routine e richieste spontaneamente in corso. Nel vostro ruolo, siete in scambio regolare con varie interfacce, tra cui laboratori, logistica e garanzia di qualità.

Cosa offriamo loro:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

• Oltre agli stipendi competitivi, troverete una vasta gamma di lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero. A seconda della posizione, queste prestazioni possono includere assegni familiari, assistenza all'infanzia, sconti per le imprese locali e le attrazioni, indennità di viaggio e pasti sovvenzionati.

I loro compiti:

• Distribuzione di campioni analitici nei vari laboratori del QC.

• Organizzazione e distribuzione di materiale standard di riferimento dal magazzino centrale.

• Cooperazione nel lavoro logistico in laboratorio (gestione del fusto, pulizia del vetro di laboratorio, distribuzione e organizzazione di consumabili in entrata e prodotti chimici).

• Calibrazione, manutenzione e pulizia di attrezzature da laboratorio.

• Elaborazione di richieste spontanee dal laboratorio.

Il vostro profilo di requisito:

• Hanno completato la formazione professionale.

• Sono lavoratori autonomi, responsabili e hanno buone capacità di comunicazione e di lavoro di squadra, nonché godere di cooperazione interdisciplinare.

• Sono pronti ad integrarsi in un team, sono impegnati, motivati e hanno una buona iniziativa.

• La conoscenza del computer (Word, Excel, Outlook, team, ecc.) è richiesta.

• La conoscenza sicura del tedesco in parola e la scrittura completano il loro profilo. Le competenze in inglese sono vantaggiose.

I prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone ogni giorno. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande onore, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante per noi come i nostri successi stessi. A Lonza, il rispetto è una priorità e proteggiamo sia i nostri dipendenti che il nostro ambiente. Il successo per noi significa progresso moralmente accettabile.

Lonza è unito da persone che assumono sfide e usano la loro creatività per sviluppare nuove idee per problemi complessi. Insieme diamo un contributo che può migliorare la vita di molte persone in tutto il mondo. Questo offre loro la certezza e la soddisfazione di fare davvero la differenza con il proprio lavoro.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Lonza is today a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

At the Visp site, a laboratory support employee is sought. As a member of the QC Labor Support Team, you take on a wide range of tasks in order to ensure smooth laboratory operation, in compliance with the applicable quality and safety guidelines. In addition to all the analytical activities carried out by laboratory technicians in the various laboratories, you perform routine tasks as well as spontaneously occurring requests. In your role, you are in regular exchange with various interfaces, including laboratories, logistics and quality assurance.

What we offer them:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• In addition to competitive salaries, you will find a wide range of lifestyle, family and leisure benefits. Depending on location, these benefits may include family allowances, childcare assistance, discounts for local businesses and attractions, travel allowances, and subsidized meals.

Their tasks:

• Distribution of analytical samples into the various laboratories of the QC.

• Organisation and distribution of reference standard material from the central warehouse.

• Cooperation in logistical work in the laboratory (waste management, laboratory glass cleaning, distribution and organisation of incoming consumables and chemicals).

• Calibration, maintenance and cleaning of laboratory equipment.

• Processing of spontaneous requests from the laboratory.

Your requirement profile:

• They have completed vocational training.

• They are self-employed, responsible and have good communication and teamwork skills as well as enjoy interdisciplinary cooperation.

• They are ready to integrate into a team, are committed, motivated and have a good initiative.

• Computer knowledge (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, etc.) is required.

• Safe knowledge of German in word and writing round off their profile. English skills are beneficial.

Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people every day. For us, this is not only a great honour, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important to us as our successes themselves. At Lonza, respect is a priority and we protect both our employees and our environment. Success for us means morally acceptable progress.

Lonza is joined by people who take on challenges and use their creativity to develop new ideas for complex problems. Together we make a contribution that can improve the lives of many people around the world. This offers them the certainty and satisfaction of really making a difference with their own work.

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.

• Traitement des demandes spontanées du laboratoire.

Les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes chaque jour. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand honneur, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. À Lonza, le respect est une priorité et nous protégeons nos employés et notre environnement. Le succès pour nous signifie des progrès moralement acceptables.

Lonza est rejoint par des personnes qui prennent des défis et utilisent leur créativité pour développer de nouvelles idées pour des problèmes complexes. Ensemble, nous apportons une contribution qui peut améliorer la vie de nombreuses personnes dans le monde. Cela leur offre la certitude et la satisfaction de faire vraiment une différence avec leur propre travail.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

We are looking for Head of Direct Procurement, Integrated Biologics, Advanced Synthesis and Specialized Modalities.

The Head of Direct Procurement leads the global Direct Procurement for Integrated Biologics, Advanced Synthesis and Specialized Modalities. The role is accountable for optimizing approximately CHF 1.3 billion in annual Direct Spend, ensuring supply reliability for critical raw materials, reducing total cost of ownership, strengthening supplier performance and driving efficient, compliant ways of working across Platforms.

Scope: The role manages global raw material category teams and leads approximately 30 procurement professionals globally. It partners closely with Platform and business leadership, Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance and other key stakeholders to align procurement strategies with business priorities, regulatory expectations and operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategy and business alignment

• Define and execute the global Direct Procurement strategy Direct Pin alignment with Group strategy, Platform priorities and business objectives, securing buy-in from senior stakeholders.

• Serve as an active member of the Procurement leadership team and contribute to the development of the broader Procurement function.

• Clarify business requirements, drive proactive stakeholder communication and support decision-making to ensure procurement strategies are fully aligned and executable.

• People leadership: Directly manage and develop a global team of approximately 30 procurement professionals, building high-performing teams and ensuring delivery against functional and business objectives.

Transformation and ways of working

• Drive change management , strengthen global category management, supplier performance, supply reliability and efficient ways of working across Direct Procurement.

• Act as the primary Procurement interface for senior business leaders and Platforms.

• Influence business stakeholders and Platforms to ensure early and effective Procurement involvement in decisions related to direct materials, raw material categories and supply continuity.

• Build cohesive, high-performing teams with clear priorities, strong accountability and a continuous improvement mindset.

• Engage, coach and develop team members to strengthen capability, succession and long-term talent development.

• Develop and implement retention actions where required to maintain continuity and critical procurement expertise.

Performance and value delivery:

• Set and deliver annual targets for savings, quality, delivery performance, supply resilience and execution efficiency.

Category and supplier management:

• Develop and execute category strategies for relevant raw material and Direct Procurement categories.

• Develop and maintain deep market, supplier and risk intelligence across relevant sourcing markets.

• Lead supplier selection, negotiation, contracting and supplier management strategies to secure competitive, reliable and compliant supply.

• Lead supplier relationship management and supplier development activities to ensure reliable, high-quality supply and long-term supplier performance.

Governance, compliance and process excellence:

• Implement Procurement best practices across Platforms, including procurement processes, policies and governance standards.

• Ensure compliance with global Procurement policies, including supplier selection, onboarding, payment terms, data management and related governance requirements.

• Ensure effective implementation and adoption of Procurement tools and systems across Platforms, monitoring compliance and process adherence.

• Identify continuous improvement opportunities and collaborate with the global P2P owner to integrate improvements into global procurement processes.

Key requirements:

• Extensive and progressive senior Procurement leadership experience, including leading global teams across different hierarchical levels in an international environment.

• Strong Global Procurement experience, preferably with exposure to direct materials, raw material categories, life sciences, pharmaceutical, CDMO or regulated manufacturing environments.

• Demonstrated experience leading transformation and change management within global Global Procurement functions.

• Outstanding negotiation and supplier management skills, with experience engaging global and regional suppliers to improve cost, quality, delivery performance and supply resilience.

• Strong leadership, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to motivate teams, drive results and operate effectively in matrix-based, cross-functional environments.

• Able to adapt to shifting priorities, demands and timelines through strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

• Ability to prioritize effectively and execute in a fast-paced, complex global environment.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in cinque continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte.

Siamo alla ricerca di Head of Direct Procurement, Integrated Biologics, Advanced Sintesi e Modalities Specialized.

Il Capo del Procurement Diretto conduce il Procurement Diretto Globale per Biologici Integrati, Sintesi Avanzata e Modalities Specializzati. Il ruolo è responsabile per l'ottimizzazione di circa 1,3 miliardi di franchi nella spesa diretta annuale, assicurando l'affidabilità della fornitura per le materie prime critiche, riducendo il costo totale di proprietà, rafforzando le prestazioni dei fornitori e guidando modi efficienti e conformi di lavorare su Piattaforme.

Scope: Il ruolo gestisce team di categoria materie prime globali e conduce circa 30 professionisti di approvvigionamento a livello globale. Collabora a stretto contatto con Piattaforma e leadership aziendale, Qualità, Produzione, Supply Chain, Finanza e altri stakeholder chiave per allineare le strategie di approvvigionamento con priorità aziendali, aspettative normative e requisiti operativi.

Responsabilità chiave:

Strategia e allineamento aziendale

• Definire ed eseguire la strategia globale di acquisto diretto allineamento Pin diretto con strategia di gruppo, priorità della piattaforma e obiettivi aziendali, garantire buy-in da parte di stakeholder senior.

• Servire come membro attivo del team di leadership Procurement e contribuire allo sviluppo della più ampia funzione Procurement.

• Verificare i requisiti aziendali, guidare la comunicazione proattiva degli stakeholder e sostenere il processo decisionale per garantire che le strategie di approvvigionamento siano completamente allineate ed eseguibili.

• leadership delle persone: Direttamente gestire e sviluppare un team globale di circa 30 professionisti degli appalti, la costruzione di team altamente performanti e garantire la consegna contro obiettivi funzionali e aziendali.

Trasformazione e modalità di lavoro

• Gestione del cambiamento di unità, rafforzare la gestione della categoria globale, le prestazioni dei fornitori, l'affidabilità della fornitura e i modi efficienti di lavorare attraverso Direct Procurement.

• Agire come l'interfaccia principale di approvvigionamento per i leader aziendali senior e piattaforme.

• Influenza gli stakeholder aziendali e le Piattaforme per garantire il coinvolgimento precoce ed efficace degli appalti in decisioni relative a materie dirette, categorie di materie prime e continuità di fornitura.

• Costruire squadre coessive e performanti con priorità chiare, una forte responsabilità e una mentalità di miglioramento continuo.

• Engage, coach e sviluppare membri del team per rafforzare la capacità, la successione e lo sviluppo del talento a lungo termine.

• Sviluppare e implementare azioni di ritenzione laddove necessario per mantenere la continuità e le competenze di approvvigionamento critico.

Prestazioni e consegna del valore:

• Impostare e fornire obiettivi annuali per il risparmio, la qualità, le prestazioni di consegna, la resilienza di fornitura e l'efficienza di esecuzione.

Categoria e gestione dei fornitori:

• Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie di categoria per materie prime rilevanti e categorie di appalti diretti.

• Sviluppare e mantenere il mercato profondo, il fornitore e l'intelligenza di rischio attraverso i mercati di approvvigionamento rilevanti.

• Scelta, negoziazione, contratti e strategie di gestione dei fornitori leader per garantire la fornitura competitiva, affidabile e conforme.

• Gestione dei rapporti dei fornitori di piombo e attività di sviluppo dei fornitori per garantire prestazioni affidabili, di alta qualità e di fornitori a lungo termine.

Governance, conformità e eccellenza di processo:

• Implement Procurement best practice in piattaforme, compresi i processi di approvvigionamento, le politiche e gli standard di governance.

• Assicurare il rispetto delle politiche globali di approvvigionamento, compresa la selezione dei fornitori, l'imbarco, i termini di pagamento, la gestione dei dati e i relativi requisiti di governance.

• Assicurare un'efficace implementazione e adozione di strumenti e sistemi di approvvigionamento su Piattaforme, monitorare la conformità e l'aderenza dei processi.

• Identificare opportunità di miglioramento continuo e collaborare con il proprietario P2P globale per integrare i miglioramenti nei processi di approvvigionamento globale.

Requisiti chiave:

• Estensiva e progressiva esperienza di leadership di appalti, tra cui leader team globali in diversi livelli gerarchici in un ambiente internazionale.

• Forte esperienza di approvvigionamento globale, preferibilmente con esposizione a materie dirette, categorie di materie prime, scienze della vita, farmaceutico, CDMO o ambienti di produzione regolamentati.

• Esperienza dimostrata leader trasformazione e gestione dei cambiamenti all'interno delle funzioni Global Procurement.

• Straordinarie competenze di negoziazione e gestione dei fornitori, con esperienza coinvolgendo fornitori globali e regionali per migliorare il costo, la qualità, le prestazioni di consegna e la resilienza di fornitura.

• Forte leadership, comunicazione e capacità di influenzare, con la capacità di motivare i team, guidare i risultati e operare efficacemente in ambienti matrice-based, interfunzionali.

• In grado di adattarsi alle priorità di spostamento, alle esigenze e alle tempistiche attraverso forti capacità analitiche e di problem solving.

• Capacità di priorizzare efficacemente ed eseguire in un ambiente globale veloce e complesso.

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen.

Wir suchen Head of Direct Procurement, Integrated Biologics, Advanced Synthesis und Specialized Modalities.

Der Head of Direct Procurement leitet die weltweite Direktbeschaffung für Integrierte Biologika, Advanced Synthesis und Specialized Modalities. Die Rolle ist verantwortlich für die Optimierung von rund CHF 1,3 Milliarden an jährlichen Direktausgaben, die Gewährleistung der Versorgungszuverlässigkeit kritischer Rohstoffe, die Senkung der Gesamtbetriebskosten, die Stärkung der Lieferantenleistung und die Förderung effizienter, konformer Arbeitsweisen über Plattformen hinweg.

Scope: Die Rolle verwaltet globale Rohmaterial-Kategorie-Teams und führt rund 30 Beschaffungsexperten weltweit. Es arbeitet eng mit Plattform- und Unternehmensführung, Qualität, Fertigung, Supply Chain, Finanzen und anderen wichtigen Stakeholdern zusammen, um Beschaffungsstrategien an Geschäftsprioritäten, regulatorischen Erwartungen und operativen Anforderungen auszurichten.

Wichtigste Aufgaben:

Strategie und Business Alignment

• Definieren und implementieren Sie die globale Direct Procurement-Strategie Direct Pin mit der Konzernstrategie, den Plattformprioritäten und den Geschäftszielen und sichern Sie das Buy-in von leitenden Stakeholdern.

• Als aktives Mitglied des Procurement-Führungsteams dienen und zur Entwicklung der breiteren Procurement-Funktion beitragen.

• Klären Sie die Geschäftsanforderungen, fördern Sie die proaktive Stakeholder-Kommunikation und unterstützen Sie die Entscheidungsfindung, um sicherzustellen, dass die Beschaffungsstrategien vollständig aufeinander abgestimmt und ausführbar sind.

• Personalführung: Direktes Management und Entwicklung eines globalen Teams von rund 30 Beschaffungsexperten, Aufbau von leistungsstarken Teams und Sicherstellung der Lieferung für funktionale und geschäftliche Ziele.

Transformation und Arbeitsweise

• Drängen Sie das Change Management, stärken Sie das globale Category Management, die Lieferantenleistung, die Lieferzuverlässigkeit und die effizienten Arbeitsweisen in der Direktbeschaffung.

• Handeln Sie als primäre Beschaffungsschnittstelle für Führungskräfte und Plattformen.

• Beeinflussen Sie geschäftliche Stakeholder und Plattformen, um eine frühzeitige und effektive Beteiligung der Beschaffung an Entscheidungen in Bezug auf direkte Materialien, Rohstoffkategorien und Lieferkontinuität zu gewährleisten.

• Bauen Sie zusammenhängende, leistungsstarke Teams mit klaren Prioritäten, starker Rechenschaftspflicht und einer kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmentalität auf.

• Engagieren, coachen und entwickeln Sie Teammitglieder, um Fähigkeiten, Nachfolge und langfristige Talententwicklung zu stärken.

• Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Aufbewahrungsmaßnahmen, wenn dies erforderlich ist, um Kontinuität und kritisches Beschaffungswissen zu gewährleisten.

Performance und Value Delivery:

• Festlegung und Umsetzung der Jahresziele für Einsparungen, Qualität, Lieferleistung, Versorgungsresilienz und Ausführungseffizienz.

Kategorie und Lieferantenmanagement:

• Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Kategorienstrategien für relevante Rohstoff- und Direktbeschaffungskategorien.

• Entwicklung und Pflege umfassender Markt-, Lieferanten- und Risikoinformationen in relevanten Beschaffungsmärkten.

• Führen Sie Lieferantenauswahl-, Verhandlungs-, Vertrags- und Lieferantenmanagementstrategien, um eine wettbewerbsfähige, zuverlässige und konforme Versorgung zu gewährleisten.

• Führen Sie das Lieferantenbeziehungsmanagement und die Lieferantenentwicklung, um eine zuverlässige, qualitativ hochwertige Versorgung und langfristige Lieferantenleistung zu gewährleisten.

Governance, Compliance und Process Excellence:

• Implementieren Sie Best Practices für die Beschaffung auf allen Plattformen, einschließlich Beschaffungsprozessen, Richtlinien und Governance-Standards.

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung globaler Beschaffungsrichtlinien, einschließlich Lieferantenauswahl, Onboarding, Zahlungsbedingungen, Datenmanagement und damit zusammenhängender Governance-Anforderungen.

• Gewährleistung der effektiven Implementierung und Einführung von Beschaffungstools und -systemen auf allen Plattformen, Überwachung der Compliance und der Prozesstreue.

• Identifizieren Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten und arbeiten Sie mit dem globalen P2P-Eigentümer zusammen, um Verbesserungen in globale Beschaffungsprozesse zu integrieren.

Hauptanforderungen:

• Umfangreiche und fortschrittliche Führungserfahrung in der Beschaffung, einschließlich führender globaler Teams auf verschiedenen hierarchischen Ebenen in einem internationalen Umfeld.

• Starke globale Beschaffungserfahrung, vorzugsweise mit direkten Materialien, Rohstoffkategorien, Biowissenschaften, Pharmazie, CDMO oder regulierten Fertigungsumgebungen.

• Vorgeführte Erfahrung in der Leitung von Transformations- und Change Management innerhalb globaler Global Procurement-Funktionen.

• Hervorragende Verhandlungs- und Lieferantenmanagementfähigkeiten mit Erfahrung in der Einbindung globaler und regionaler Lieferanten zur Verbesserung von Kosten, Qualität, Lieferleistung und Lieferresistenz.

• Starke Führungs-, Kommunikations- und Einflussfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Teams zu motivieren, Ergebnisse zu erzielen und effektiv in matrixbasierten, funktionsübergreifenden Umgebungen zu arbeiten.

• Fähigkeit, sich an wechselnde Prioritäten, Anforderungen und Zeitpläne durch starke analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten anzupassen.

• Fähigkeit, effektiv zu priorisieren und in einer schnelllebigen, komplexen globalen Umgebung auszuführen.

Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird.

Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um die Herausforderung und Kreativität zu meistern, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem sinnvollen Unterschied einhergeht.

Le rôle est d'optimiser environ 1,3 milliard de CHF en dépense directe annuelle, d'assurer la fiabilité de l'approvisionnement pour les matières premières critiques, de réduire le coût total de la propriété, de renforcer les performances des fournisseurs et de conduire des méthodes de travail efficaces et conformes à travers les plateformes.

Portée : Le rôle gère les équipes de la catégorie des matières premières à l'échelle mondiale et dirige environ 30 professionnels des achats à l'échelle mondiale. Il collabore étroitement avec les responsables des plateformes et des entreprises, de la qualité, de la fabrication, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, des finances et d'autres intervenants clés afin d'harmoniser les stratégies d'approvisionnement avec les priorités opérationnelles, les attentes réglementaires et les exigences opérationnelles.

Principales responsabilités :

Stratégie et alignement des activités

• Définir et exécuter la stratégie globale d'approvisionnement direct alignement direct Pin avec la stratégie du Groupe, les priorités de la Plateforme et les objectifs opérationnels, en assurant l'adhésion des parties prenantes de haut niveau.

• Servir de membre actif de l'équipe de direction des achats et contribuer au développement de la fonction d'approvisionnement.

• Préciser les exigences opérationnelles, favoriser la communication proactive des intervenants et appuyer la prise de décisions pour s'assurer que les stratégies d'approvisionnement sont entièrement alignées et exécutables.

• Leadership humain : Dirigez et développez directement une équipe mondiale d'une trentaine de professionnels de l'approvisionnement, construisez des équipes performantes et veillez à la réalisation des objectifs fonctionnels et opérationnels.

Transformation et méthodes de travail

• Encourager la gestion du changement, renforcer la gestion de catégorie mondiale, la performance des fournisseurs, la fiabilité de l'offre et des façons efficaces de travailler dans le cadre de l'approvisionnement direct.

• Agir comme principale interface d'approvisionnement pour les chefs d'entreprise et les plateformes.

• Influencer les parties prenantes et les plates-formes pour assurer une participation rapide et efficace des approvisionnements aux décisions relatives aux matières directes, aux catégories de matières premières et à la continuité de l'approvisionnement.

• Mettre sur pied des équipes cohésives et performantes avec des priorités claires, une reddition de comptes solide et un état d'esprit d'amélioration continue.

• Engager, entraîner et former des membres de l'équipe pour renforcer les capacités, la relève et le développement des talents à long terme.

• Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des mesures de conservation au besoin pour maintenir la continuité et l'expertise essentielle en matière d'approvisionnement.

Rendement et valeur ajoutée :

• Définir et atteindre des objectifs annuels en matière d'économies, de qualité, de performance de livraison, de résilience de l'offre et d'efficacité d'exécution.

Catégorie et gestion des fournisseurs:

• Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies de catégorie pour les matières premières pertinentes et les catégories d'approvisionnement direct.

• Élaborer et maintenir des renseignements détaillés sur les marchés, les fournisseurs et les risques sur les marchés d'approvisionnement pertinents.

• Les stratégies de sélection, de négociation, de passation de marchés et de gestion des fournisseurs pour assurer un approvisionnement concurrentiel, fiable et conforme.

• Diriger les activités de gestion des relations avec les fournisseurs et de développement des fournisseurs afin d'assurer un approvisionnement fiable et de haute qualité et des performances à long terme des fournisseurs.

Gouvernance, conformité et excellence des processus :

• Mettre en œuvre les meilleures pratiques en matière d'approvisionnement dans toutes les plateformes, y compris les processus d'approvisionnement, les politiques et les normes de gouvernance.

• Veiller au respect des politiques mondiales en matière d'approvisionnement, y compris la sélection des fournisseurs, l'embarquement, les modalités de paiement, la gestion des données et les exigences de gouvernance connexes.

• Assurer la mise en œuvre et l'adoption efficaces d'outils et de systèmes d'approvisionnement dans l'ensemble des plates-formes, le contrôle du respect et du respect des procédures.

• Recenser les possibilités d'amélioration continue et collaborer avec le propriétaire mondial du P2P pour intégrer les améliorations aux processus d'achat mondiaux.

Principales exigences:

• Expérience approfondie et progressive de la direction des achats, y compris la direction d'équipes mondiales à différents niveaux hiérarchiques dans un environnement international.

• Forte expérience de l'approvisionnement mondial, de préférence avec l'exposition aux matériaux directs, catégories de matières premières, sciences de la vie, produits pharmaceutiques, CDMO ou environnements de fabrication réglementés.

• Expérience démontrée en matière de transformation et de gestion du changement dans le cadre des fonctions d'approvisionnement mondial.

• Compétences exceptionnelles en matière de négociation et de gestion des fournisseurs, avec l'expérience des fournisseurs mondiaux et régionaux pour améliorer les coûts, la qualité, les performances de livraison et la résilience de l'offre.

• Un leadership solide, la communication et l'influence des compétences, avec la capacité de motiver les équipes, de produire des résultats et de fonctionner efficacement dans des environnements matriciaux et interfonctionnels.

• Capacité de s'adapter à l'évolution des priorités, des exigences et des délais grâce à de solides capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.

• Capacité de prioriser efficacement et d'exécuter dans un environnement mondial complexe et rapide.

Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès sinon un succès éthique.

Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist Physico-Chemical Quality Control 80-100%
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Stücki, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

For our successful and growing Drug Product focused branch located in Basel and Stein, Switzerland, we have exciting opportunities. Become part of a group that enables its customers to meet some of the greatest challenges in patient treatment and join us by applying for the Senior Laboratory Scientist Phys-Chemical QC position.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:

• Independently complete routine physico-chemical testing such as U/HPLC (SEC, IEX, RP, surfactant), CE-SDS, icIEF, protein content, and compendial methods (pH, color, clarity, subvisible particles, etc.) for biologics/large molecules, related entities and small molecules in QC under cGMP following applicable SOPs and Good Documentation Practices (GDocP) in a right-first-time and timely manner.

• Executes/reviews/approves basic operational tasks in the lab (e.g. mobile phase preparations, calibration of pH meter, balance)

• Assists in investigation/troubleshooting lab equipment issues by proactively driving the investigation and proposing mitigation measures

• Ensures lab clean/maintenance (inventory/consumables management process, 6S) to cGMP standards for audit readiness and supports onsite customer/regulatory audits

• Oversees maintenance/requalification of lab equipment (Group A, B and C) as Instrument Responsible Person (IRP) and supports draft/update of instrument SOPs

• Participates and initiates as member in laboratory operational optimization and process improvement initiatives

• Trainer to conduct and review compendial/non-purity methods and purity/identity/content methods in the laboratory

• Onboarding of new Scientist/Senior Scientist

What we are looking for:

• Training on the job as a lab technician (EFZ, HF, CTA, BTA, PTA or BSc./MSc.)

• Minimum 5 years of working experience in a research/ technical role in the pharmaceutical, biotech or chemical industry, in analytical testing

• Proven working experience in a cGMP regulated environment in phys-chem analytics strongly desired with experience in accurately reporting, interpretation and documentation of scientific results following ALCOA++ GDocP principles

• Experience with laboratory specific software (e.g. Empower, Electronic Laboratory Journal, LIMS-system) is advantageous

• Good communication and ability to work independently in a team, proactive and dedicated attitude

• Good knowledge of written and spoken English. Any other languages are a plus

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Basilea Stücki, Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.

Per il nostro ramo di successo e crescente Drug Product, situato a Basilea e Stein, in Svizzera, abbiamo interessanti opportunità. Entra a far parte di un gruppo che consente ai propri clienti di affrontare alcune delle più grandi sfide nel trattamento dei pazienti e unirsi a noi applicando per la posizione di Senior Laboratory Scientist Phys-Chemical QC.

Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

Cosa farai:

• Test fisico-chimici di routine in modo indipendente, come U/HPLC (SEC, IEX, RP, surfactant), CE-SDS, icIEF, contenuto proteico e metodi compendiali (pH, colore, chiarezza, particelle subvisibili, ecc.) per biologics/grandi molecole, entità correlate e piccole molecole in QC sotto cGMP seguendo le pratiche di destra e buona documentazione applicabili.

• Esegui/reviews/approva le attività operative di base in laboratorio (ad esempio, preparazioni di fase mobile, calibrazione del pHmetro, equilibrio)

• Assiste nell'indagine/risoluzione dei problemi delle apparecchiature di laboratorio guidando proattivamente l'indagine e proponendo misure di mitigazione

• Garantisce la pulizia/manutenzione del laboratorio (processo di gestione dell'inventario/consumabili, 6S) agli standard cGMP per la prontezza dell'audit e supporta gli audit del cliente/regolatorio in loco

• Supera la manutenzione/riqualifica delle apparecchiature di laboratorio (Gruppo A, B e C) come persona responsabile dello strumento (IRP) e supporta la stesura/aggiornamento dello strumento SOPs

• Partecipa e inizia come membro delle iniziative di ottimizzazione operativa e miglioramento dei processi di laboratorio

• Allenatore per condurre e rivedere metodi di compendio/non purezza e metodi di purezza/identità/contenuto in laboratorio

• Imbarcazione del nuovo scienziato/senitore

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Formazione sul lavoro come tecnico di laboratorio (EFZ, HF, CTA, BTA, PTA o BSc./MSc.)

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza lavorativa in un ruolo tecnico/ricerca nell'industria farmaceutica, biotecnologia o chimica, nel test analitico

• Provata esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente regolamentato cGMP in analisi di fis-chem fortemente desiderato con esperienza nel reporting accurato, interpretazione e documentazione dei risultati scientifici dopo ALCOA++ Principi del GDOP

• L'esperienza con software specifico di laboratorio (ad esempio Empower, Electronic Laboratory Journal, LIMS-system) è vantaggiosa

• Buona comunicazione e capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente in un team, atteggiamento proattivo e dedicato

• Buona conoscenza dell'inglese scritto e parlato. Altre lingue sono un plus

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Der tatsächliche Standort dieses Jobs ist in Basel Stücki, Schweiz. Umzugshilfe ist für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien zur Verfügung, wenn nötig.

Für unsere erfolgreiche und wachsende Niederlassung in Basel und Stein, Schweiz, haben wir spannende Möglichkeiten. Werden Sie Teil einer Gruppe, die es ihren Kunden ermöglicht, einige der größten Herausforderungen in der Patientenbehandlung zu meistern, und bewerben Sie sich bei uns für die Position als Senior Laboratory Scientist Phys-Chemical QC.

Dies ist eine vollständig ortsbezogene Rolle. Die persönliche Zusammenarbeit unterstützt eine enge Echtzeit-Zusammenarbeit und die technische Präzision, die erforderlich ist, um Arzneimittel nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards herzustellen.

Was Sie bekommen werden:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung erkennen

Was Sie tun werden:

• Unabhängige Durchführung routinemäßiger physikalisch-chemischer Tests wie U/HPLC (SEC, IEX, RP, Surfactant), CE-SDS, icIEF, Proteingehalt und Kompendialmethoden (pH, Farbe, Klarheit, unterscheidbare Partikel usw.) für Biologika/große Moleküle, verwandte Einheiten und kleine Moleküle in QC unter cGMP nach geltenden SOPs und Good Documentation Practices (GDocP) zum ersten Mal und rechtzeitig.

• Führt/überprüft/erlässt grundlegende operative Aufgaben im Labor (z. B. mobile Phasenvorbereitungen, Kalibrierung des pH-Meters, Waage)

• Hilft bei der Untersuchung / Fehlerbehebung von Laborgeräten, indem es die Untersuchung proaktiv vorantreibt und Minderungsmaßnahmen vorschlägt

• Gewährleistet die Reinigung/Wartung von Labors (Inventar-/Verbrauchsmaterialverwaltungsprozess, 6S) gemäß den cGMP-Standards für die Auditbereitschaft und unterstützt Kunden-/Regulierungsaudits vor Ort

• Beaufsichtigt die Wartung / Qualifizierung von Laborgeräten (Gruppe A, B und C) als Instrumentenverantwortliche Person (IRP) und unterstützt den Entwurf / die Aktualisierung von Instrumenten-SOPs

• Beteiligt sich und initiiert als Mitglied an Initiativen zur Betriebsoptimierung und Prozessverbesserung im Labor

• Trainer zur Durchführung und Überprüfung von kompendialen / nicht-reinen Methoden und Reinheit / Identität / Inhalt Methoden im Labor

• Onboarding neuer Wissenschaftler/Senior Scientist

Was wir suchen:

• Ausbildung als Labortechniker (EFZ, HF, CTA, BTA, PTA oder BSc./MSc.)

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer Forschungs- / technischen Rolle in der Pharma-, Biotech- oder Chemieindustrie, in der analytischen Prüfung

• Nachgewiesene Arbeitserfahrung in einer cGMP-regulierten Umgebung in der Phys-Chem-Analyse mit Erfahrung in der genauen Berichterstattung, Interpretation und Dokumentation wissenschaftlicher Ergebnisse nach ALCOA++ GDocP-Grundsätze

• Erfahrung mit laborspezifischer Software (z.B. Empower, Electronic Laboratory Journal, LIMS-System) ist vorteilhaft

• Gute Kommunikation und Fähigkeit, selbstständig im Team zu arbeiten, proaktive und engagierte Einstellung

• Gute Kenntnisse des geschriebenen und gesprochenen Englisch. Alle anderen Sprachen sind ein Plus

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. Bereit, die Zukunft der Biowissenschaften zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'emplacement réel de ce travail est à Bâle Stücki, Suisse. Une aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats admissibles et à leur famille, au besoin.

Pour notre filiale de produits pharmaceutiques en pleine croissance à Bâle et Stein, en Suisse, nous avons des opportunités intéressantes. Devenez membre d'un groupe qui permet à ses clients de relever certains des plus grands défis dans le traitement des patients et rejoignez-nous en postulant au poste de chercheur principal en laboratoire Physique chimique QC.

C'est un rôle entièrement basé sur le site. Travailler ensemble en personne soutient une collaboration étroite en temps réel et la précision technique nécessaire pour fabriquer des médicaments répondant aux normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées.

Ce que vous obtiendrez :

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé

Ce que vous ferez :

• Essais physico-chimiques de routine indépendants, tels que U/HPLC (SEC, IEX, RP, agent tensioactif), CE-SDS, icIEF, teneur en protéines et méthodes compendiales (pH, couleur, clarté, particules subvisibles, etc.) pour les produits biologiques/grandes molécules, les entités apparentées et les petites molécules du QC dans le cadre du GMPc suivant les SOP applicables et les bonnes pratiques de documentation (GDocP) de manière juste et opportune.

• Exécute/examine/approuve les tâches opérationnelles de base dans le laboratoire (p. ex. préparation de phase mobile, étalonnage du pHmètre, balance)

• Aider à résoudre les problèmes d'équipement de laboratoire en menant l'enquête de façon proactive et en proposant des mesures d'atténuation

• Veiller à ce que les laboratoires soient propres/entretiens (processus de gestion des stocks/consommables, 6S) aux normes du BPFC pour la préparation à la vérification et appuyer les vérifications sur place auprès des clients/réglementaires

• Supervise l'entretien et la requalification du matériel de laboratoire (groupes A, B et C) en tant que personne responsable des instruments (PIR) et appuie l'ébauche ou la mise à jour des PON des instruments

• Participer à des initiatives d'optimisation opérationnelle et d'amélioration des processus en laboratoire et en prendre l'initiative

• Former à la conduite et à l'examen des méthodes de compensation/non-purité et des méthodes de pureté/identité/contenu en laboratoire

• À bord du nouveau scientifique/chercheur principal

Ce que nous cherchons:

• Formation en tant que technicien de laboratoire (EFZ, HF, CTA, BTA, PTA ou BSc./MSc.)

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de recherche/technique dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, biotechnologique ou chimique, dans les essais analytiques

• Expérience de travail éprouvée dans un environnement réglementé par cGMP dans l'analyse phys-chem fortement souhaitée avec l'expérience dans le rapport précis, l'interprétation et la documentation des résultats scientifiques suivant ALCOA++ Principes du GDocP

• L'expérience d'un logiciel spécifique au laboratoire (p. ex. Empower, Electronic Laboratory Journal, LIMS-system) est avantageuse

• Bonne communication et aptitude à travailler de façon indépendante en équipe, attitude proactive et dévouée

• Bonne connaissance de l'anglais écrit et parlé. Toutes les autres langues sont un plus

À propos de Lonza
À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.

L'innovation prospère lorsque les gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Based in Basel, this role sits at the heart of Lonza’s Microbial manufacturing network, driving end‑to‑end supply planning to ensure reliable, efficient, and compliant delivery of products that support life‑changing medicines.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career path and a dynamic, collaborative work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace where diversity of thought is valued

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance and impact

• A competitive salary, plus a comprehensive range of lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits

• The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Own and execute the monthly Supply Planning cycle for Microbial operations, ensuring alignment with integrated planning, S&OP, and budget processes

• Create, maintain, and continuously improve the Supply Plan, including the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and medium‑term capacity outlooks

• Anticipate supply risks and constraints, developing proactive mitigation strategies in collaboration with Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, and Finance

• Lead supply plan accuracy improvements through KPI definition, tracking, root‑cause analysis, and corrective actions

• Partner with Inventory Management to define and maintain inventory targets, manage new and phase‑out materials, and reduce excess and obsolete inventory

• Ensure supply plans are consistently maintained and utilized in SAP IBP and SAP ECC, driving material, labor, and asset capacity plans

• Provide functional leadership and oversight of MRP and Scheduling activities, ensuring robust planning parameters and master data governance

What we are looking for:

• Proven experience in Supply Planning / Production Planning, preferably in pharmaceuticals, biotech, or complex manufacturing environments

• Strong understanding of S&OP, MPS, MRP, inventory management, and capacity planning concepts

• Hands‑on experience with SAP IBP and SAP ECC (or comparable advanced planning systems)

• Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into clear decisions and actionable plans

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build consensus across global and cross‑functional teams

• Experience leading planning processes or guiding planners/schedulers, with a continuous‑improvement mindset

• Degree or equivalent experience in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, or a related field (transferable skills and equivalent experience are welcome)

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

jobs.title: QC Project Leader 80-100% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

We are looking for a Manufacturing Science and Technology Expert – Drug Product (m/f/d) - 80% -100%. This role is important for ensuring successful technology transfers, maintaining GMP compliance, and driving continuous improvement. If you're a proactive problem-solver with a strong background in manufacturing science and technology, we want to hear from you. The position is based in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation is available for a successful candidate and their family, if needed.

Job Responsibilities:

• Manage and lead QC projects from initiation to completion, defining project scope, timelines, resources, deliverables, and reporting project progress while escalating issues when necessary.

• Perform, oversee, and coordinate chemical and physical testing of raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products using analytical techniques such as HPLC, GC, UV/Vis, KF, and FTIR, ensuring data integrity, testing compliance, and timely support of project and release activities.

• Develop, validate, and transfer chromatographic analytical methods in accordance with ICH guidelines, regulatory requirements, and applicable quality standards.

• Troubleshoot analytical instrumentation and methods, implementing corrective and preventive actions as required.

• Ensure compliance with GMP/cGMP requirements, regulatory expectations, and internal quality standards across all QC activities.

• Initiate, manage, and close change controls, deviations, OOS/OOT/OOE investigations, and laboratory investigations, including root cause analysis, impact assessment, CAPA implementation, and thorough documentation to ensure timely resolution.

• Document and review analytical results, project activities, and investigation outcomes in accordance with GMP requirements.

• Prepare, author, review, and approve technical documents, including method validation and method transfer protocols and reports, SOPs, quality instructions, and other QC-related cGMP documentation.

• Act as the primary QC point of contact for assigned customer projects, ensuring effective communication and stakeholder alignment.

• Serve as the interface between QC personnel and external contract laboratories, coordinating testing activities and resolving technical issues as required.

• Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including R&D, Production, Quality Assurance, and external partners, to ensure successful project execution and regulatory compliance.

• Provide technical expertise, coaching, and guidance to junior chemists and other team members.

• Participate in internal and external audits, address audit observations, and support the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives.

Job Qualifications:

• PhD in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific field; alternatively, a Master's or Bachelor's degree with significant relevant industry experience.

• Strong theoretical and practical expertise in analytical chemistry, including hands-on experience with chromatographic techniques such as HPLC and GC.

• Experience in analytical method development, validation, and transfer is highly desirable.

• Knowledge of GMP requirements and regulatory standards; familiarity with ISO 9001 is considered an advantage.

• Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with strong attention to detail and a scientific, data-driven approach.

• Strong organizational, planning, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

• Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and build positive working relationships.

• Team-oriented mindset with a commitment to fostering a positive, collaborative, and professional work environment.

• Fluent in both German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
