titleByLocale.fr: Chef de groupe Développement de liens entre les médicaments

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Based in Visp, the Group Leader Drug Linker Development will lead the assigned group of PD/MSAT/DSP Chemists working on pipeline development and portfolio optimization of Drug Linker and Toxin products: He/she will also play a significant role in the set up of the Drug Linker Development unit Organization for the Drug Linker Asset under construction.
You will ensure close alignment between your team and the supported production facilities, while collaborating with the ADS Portfolio Optimization and Pipeline Development organizations. In this role, you will be responsible for the roadmap and strategy for continuous improvement, technical capabilities, and capacity of the assigned Development & MSAT scientist team.

This is a highly visible role for a scientist who wants to combine deep technical expertise with people leadership, customer-facing scientific impact, and strategic contribution to a growing Drug Linker Development and Manufacturing organization in the ADC market.
This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Support the Drug Linker Development Organization Head in the ramp up phase of the Accelerate Asset Development unit by defining and supporting the implementation of all critical business processes for drug linker projects

• Manage the hiring process of the Accelerate Chemists for the Drug Linker Accelerate Asset together with the DL Development leadership team.

• Lead the assigned Drug Linker Process Development team of Chemists in line with agreed objectives and commitments and monitor and control their performance.

• Support the responsible Drug Linker Development Organization Head, in alignment with the Drug Linker Development Teams, in managing and allocating required chemists and lab resources resources.

• Guide Development and/or MSAT chemists to enable the efficient and robust transfer of Drug Linker Processes into the supported GMP manufacturing facilities.

• Drive the development and implementation of innovative technologies to increase capability, capacity, and efficiency within Drug Linker Toxin operations and support Lab investment programs for the introduction of relevant technology and tools.

• Act as a technical and scientific expert for Drug Linker Toxin projects internally and externally, responsibility includes creation of external scientific content to enhance reputation and visibility.

• Facilitate close collaboration between the Drug Linker Development team and critical interfaces and related product areas like Bioconjugates and Small Molecules Operations.

• Lead all HR-related aspects for the assigned team and actively contribute to the scientific development of scientists in their areas of expertise.

• Ensure compliance with GMP and safety regulations throughout all activities.

• Support the Head of Drug Linker Organization in assigned initiatives and strategic duties.

What we are looking for:

• PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline; PhD in Organic Chemistry preferred.

• Approximately 5-10 years of experience in pharmaceutical process development, API development, clinical supply, or manufacturing sciences.

• Proven experience leading complex projects in a matrix organization within clinical supply, development, or manufacturing operations.

• Strong knowledge of chemical process development, scale-up, technology transfer, and GMP manufacturing requirements.

• Good knowledge of Drug Linker technology and understanding of safe work execution in containment assets.

• People management experience or strong motivation to develop into an expanded leadership role, including coaching and talent development.

• Demonstrated experience managing project budgets and delivering against performance targets.

• Fluent English language skills; German proficiency is a strong asset.

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Based in Visp, the Group Leader Drug Linker Development will lead the assigned group of PD/MSAT/DSP Chemists working on pipeline development and portfolio optimization of Drug Linker and Toxin products: He/she will also play a significant role in the set up of the Drug Linker Development unit Organization for the Drug Linker Asset under construction.
You will ensure close alignment between your team and the supported production facilities, while collaborating with the ADS Portfolio Optimization and Pipeline Development organizations. In this role, you will be responsible for the roadmap and strategy for continuous improvement, technical capabilities, and capacity of the assigned Development & MSAT scientist team.

This is a highly visible role for a scientist who wants to combine deep technical expertise with people leadership, customer-facing scientific impact, and strategic contribution to a growing Drug Linker Development and Manufacturing organization in the ADC market.
This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Support the Drug Linker Development Organization Head in the ramp up phase of the Accelerate Asset Development unit by defining and supporting the implementation of all critical business processes for drug linker projects

• Manage the hiring process of the Accelerate Chemists for the Drug Linker Accelerate Asset together with the DL Development leadership team.

• Lead the assigned Drug Linker Process Development team of Chemists in line with agreed objectives and commitments and monitor and control their performance.

• Support the responsible Drug Linker Development Organization Head, in alignment with the Drug Linker Development Teams, in managing and allocating required chemists and lab resources resources.

• Guide Development and/or MSAT chemists to enable the efficient and robust transfer of Drug Linker Processes into the supported GMP manufacturing facilities.

• Drive the development and implementation of innovative technologies to increase capability, capacity, and efficiency within Drug Linker Toxin operations and support Lab investment programs for the introduction of relevant technology and tools.

• Act as a technical and scientific expert for Drug Linker Toxin projects internally and externally, responsibility includes creation of external scientific content to enhance reputation and visibility.

• Facilitate close collaboration between the Drug Linker Development team and critical interfaces and related product areas like Bioconjugates and Small Molecules Operations.

• Lead all HR-related aspects for the assigned team and actively contribute to the scientific development of scientists in their areas of expertise.

• Ensure compliance with GMP and safety regulations throughout all activities.

• Support the Head of Drug Linker Organization in assigned initiatives and strategic duties.

What we are looking for:

• PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline; PhD in Organic Chemistry preferred.

• Approximately 5-10 years of experience in pharmaceutical process development, API development, clinical supply, or manufacturing sciences.

• Proven experience leading complex projects in a matrix organization within clinical supply, development, or manufacturing operations.

• Strong knowledge of chemical process development, scale-up, technology transfer, and GMP manufacturing requirements.

• Good knowledge of Drug Linker technology and understanding of safe work execution in containment assets.

• People management experience or strong motivation to develop into an expanded leadership role, including coaching and talent development.

• Demonstrated experience managing project budgets and delivering against performance targets.

• Fluent English language skills; German proficiency is a strong asset.

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

• Structured, focused, and well-organized working attitude

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. Location. Visp, Switzerland.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

What you will do:

• Executes manufacturing activities in the area of Drug Product.

• According to cGMP guidelines, ensuring batch execution, evaluating test results, resolving issues, troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and make recommendations for resolution.

• Provides front line technical and procedural support, working with the manufacturing team.

• Securing each batch is manufactured safely, on time, in compliance with the batch instructions and quality requirements

• Responsible for establishing timely and with high quality the required production documentation (preparation, execution and review of batch records) or other relevant GMP documents for the assigned production area.

• Supports process related investigations and assists in decision making on production issues

• Supports process changes and CAPAs related to processes within required timelines

• Performs training activities of relevant areas as operator and supports others and new joiners.

• Operating, setting up and cleaning production equipment and premises for the production of liquid and freeze-dried drug forms (e.g.:compounding, parts washing, autoclaving, filter integrity testing, visual inspection)

What we are looking for:

• Several years of experience GMP environment on the shopfloor (preferably in sterile manufacturing of Drug Product)

• Fluent inEnglish (German is a plus).

• Familiarity with GMP requirements, quality procedures and SOP execution

• Strong team orientation

• Effective communication skills and interaction with a variety of interfaces within the organization

• Structured, focused, and well-organized working attitude

• High motivation and dynamic drive

• IT knowledge and knowledge in SAP and MES is a benefit

• Prepared to work in 3 shifts pattern including nights and Saturdays.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Standort. Visp, Schweiz.

Heute ist Lonza ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biowissenschaften, der auf fünf Kontinenten tätig ist. Während wir in der Wissenschaft arbeiten, gibt es keine magische Formel, wie wir es tun. Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Menschen, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen.

Was Sie tun werden:

• Führt Produktionsaktivitäten im Bereich Drug Product durch.

• Gemäß cGMP-Richtlinien, Gewährleistung der Batch-Ausführung, Bewertung von Testergebnissen, Behebung von Problemen, Fehlerbehebung von Fertigungsgeräten und Abgabe von Lösungsempfehlungen.

• Bietet technische und verfahrenstechnische Unterstützung an vorderster Front und arbeitet mit dem Fertigungsteam zusammen.

• Die Sicherung jeder Charge wird sicher und pünktlich in Übereinstimmung mit den Chargenanweisungen und Qualitätsanforderungen hergestellt.

• Verantwortlich für die rechtzeitige und qualitativ hochwertige Erstellung der erforderlichen Produktionsdokumentation (Vorbereitung, Ausführung und Überprüfung von Chargenaufzeichnungen) oder anderer relevanter GMP-Dokumente für den zugewiesenen Produktionsbereich.

• Unterstützt prozessbezogene Untersuchungen und unterstützt bei der Entscheidungsfindung in Produktionsfragen

• Unterstützt Prozessänderungen und CAPAs in Bezug auf Prozesse innerhalb der erforderlichen Zeitlinien

• Führt Schulungsaktivitäten in relevanten Bereichen als Betreiber durch und unterstützt andere und neue Teilnehmer.

• Betrieb, Einrichtung und Reinigung von Produktionsanlagen und Räumlichkeiten für die Herstellung von flüssigen und gefriergetrockneten Arzneiformen (z. B.:Compounding, Teilewaschen, Autoklavieren, Filterintegritätsprüfung, Sichtprüfung)

Was wir suchen:

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im GMP-Umfeld (vorzugsweise in der sterilen Herstellung von Arzneimitteln)

• Fließend inEnglisch (Deutsch ist ein Plus).

• Vertrautheit mit GMP-Anforderungen, Qualitätsverfahren und SOP-Ausführung

• Starke Teamorientierung

• Effektive Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Interaktion mit einer Vielzahl von Schnittstellen innerhalb der Organisation

• Strukturierte, fokussierte und gut organisierte Arbeitseinstellung

• Hohe Motivation und dynamischer Antrieb

• IT-Kenntnisse und Kenntnisse in SAP und MES sind von Vorteil

• Bereit, in 3 Schichten zu arbeiten, einschließlich Nächte und Samstage.

Jeden Tag haben die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza einen positiven Einfluss auf Millionen von Menschen. Für uns ist das nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird.

Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem sinnvollen Unterschied kommt.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Location: the actual location of this job is in Visp, Basel, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. This is a temporary position for a period of one year.

As a Manager Regulatory Affairs based at our manufacturing site in Visp, you provide end-to-end regulatory leadership for complex client programs supported by the site. You are accountable for shaping and executing robust regulatory strategies that enable efficient development, manufacturing, and commercialization.

You act as a trusted regulatory advisor to cross-functional teams and clients, ensuring proactive risk management, alignment of regulatory expectations, and seamless integration of regulatory requirements into project execution.
By orchestrating regulatory activities across functions and geographies, you ensure the high-quality, compliant, and timely delivery of regulatory milestones, strengthening the Visp site’s ability to execute complex programs and enhancing Lonza’s position as a manufacturer of choice for highly complex molecules including bioconjugation projects.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location

The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

Project Leadership & Regulatory Coordination:

• Lead end-to-end regulatory activities for assigned Visp client programs.

• Act as Regulatory Affairs Project Lead, ensuring alignment of regulatory strategy, timelines, and deliverables with overall program objectives.

• Coordinate regulatory workstreams across internal functions and global RA networks, ensuring seamless execution and transparency.

• Drive prioritization, planning, and tracking of regulatory deliverables across multiple concurrent programs.

Operational Oversight & Execution:

• Ensure efficient execution of day-to-day regulatory activities supporting client programs, including submissions, lifecycle management, and health authority interactions.

• Oversee preparation, review, and delivery of high-quality regulatory documentation (e.g., dossier content, responses to Health Authority queries, briefing packages).

• Support teams in managing competing priorities and resolving operational challenges in a timely manner.

Regulatory Strategy & Compliance:

• Support customers with CMC strategies in alignment with global requirements and customer expectations.

• Ensure all regulatory activities are compliant with applicable guidelines, registered dossiers, and Lonza procedures.

• Provide regulatory assessment of changes, deviations, and lifecycle activities, ensuring alignment with regulatory filings and strategy.

• Ensure consistent interpretation and application of regulatory requirements across projects and technologies.

• Support the Lonza Regulatory Information Bulletin.

Customer & Stakeholder Management:

• Act as primary regulatory interface for customers on assigned programs, providing expert guidance on CMC regulatory topics and strategy.

• Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with customers and key internal stakeholders (e.g., MSAT, Quality, Production, Supply Chain).

• Support customer interactions with Health Authorities, including preparation and participation in meetings and responses.

• Ensure clear, proactive communication of regulatory risks, timelines, and deliverables to all stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement & Regulatory Excellence:

• Contribute to strengthening regulatory capabilities at the Visp site, ensuring scalability and consistency across programs.

• Support inspection readiness, ensuring high standards of compliance and documentation.

• Proactively identify risks and improvement opportunities, implementing mitigation strategies to ensure reliable program delivery.

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmacy, or a related scientific discipline

• Solid experience in the pharmaceutical, chemical, or biotech industry, ideally within CDMO environments and GMP-regulated manufacturing and proven experience in functions such as Quality Control (QC), Quality Assurance (QA), Regulatory Affairs, or Program/Project Management, with strong exposure to manufacturing operations (preferably Small Molecules, Conjugates or related technologies)

• Demonstrated ability to work in cross-functional, client-driven environments, with a strong understanding of how to translate customer and regulatory requirements into operational execution. Good understanding of GMP regulations, quality systems, and manufacturing processes, with the ability to apply regulatory requirements in a pragmatic, solution-oriented manner

• Experience contributing to or supporting regulatory activities (e.g. submissions, lifecycle management, change assessments, or health authority interactions) is a strong advantage

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions (e.g. QA, QC, MSAT, Production, Supply Chain) and interact confidently with customers

• Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented working style with a strong sense of ownership and accountability in a dynamic CDMO environment and ability to balance compliance, customer expectations, and operational feasibility, ensuring efficient and reliable delivery of program objectives

• Excellent communication skills in English and German is an advantage and experience with relevant systems (e.g. TrackWise, LIMS, Documentum, Veeva) is an advantage.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

• Una varietà di vantaggi dipende dal ruolo e dalla posizione

• Controllare la preparazione, la revisione e la consegna della documentazione di alta qualità (ad esempio, il contenuto dei dossier, le risposte alle domande dell'Autorità per la Salute, i pacchetti di briefing).

• Sostenere i team nella gestione delle priorità concorrenti e risolvere le sfide operative in modo tempestivo.

• Fornire una valutazione regolamentare di cambiamenti, deviazioni e attività del ciclo di vita, assicurando l'allineamento con i dispositivi normativi e la strategia.

• Assicurare una comunicazione chiara e proattiva dei rischi normativi, dei tempi e dei risultati a tutti gli stakeholder.

• Dimostrata capacità di lavorare in ambienti interfunzionali e orientati al cliente, con una forte comprensione di come tradurre i requisiti di cliente e normativi in esecuzione operativa. Buona comprensione delle normative GMP, dei sistemi di qualità e dei processi produttivi, con la capacità di applicare i requisiti normativi in modo pragmatico e orientato alla soluzione

• L'esperienza che contribuisce o sostiene le attività di regolamentazione (ad esempio le sottomissioni, la gestione del ciclo di vita, le valutazioni dei cambiamenti o le interazioni dell'autorità sanitaria) è un forte vantaggio

• Forte capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente attraverso funzioni (ad esempio QA, QC, MSAT, Produzione, Supply Chain) e interagire con fiducia con i clienti

• Stile di lavoro strutturato, proattivo e orientato alla soluzione con un forte senso di proprietà e responsabilità in un ambiente dinamico CDMO e capacità di bilanciare la conformità, le aspettative dei clienti e la fattibilità operativa, garantendo una consegna efficiente e affidabile degli obiettivi del programma

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Standort: Der tatsächliche Standort dieses Jobs befindet sich in Visp, Basel, Schweiz. Umzugshilfe ist für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien zur Verfügung, wenn nötig. Dies ist eine vorübergehende Position für einen Zeitraum von einem Jahr.

Als Manager Regulatory Affairs mit Sitz in unserer Produktionsstätte in Visp übernehmen Sie eine umfassende regulatorische Führung für komplexe Kundenprogramme, die vom Standort unterstützt werden. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Gestaltung und Durchführung robuster Regulierungsstrategien, die eine effiziente Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vermarktung ermöglichen.

Sie fungieren als vertrauenswürdiger regulatorischer Berater für funktionsübergreifende Teams und Kunden und gewährleisten ein proaktives Risikomanagement, die Angleichung der regulatorischen Erwartungen und die nahtlose Integration regulatorischer Anforderungen in die Projektdurchführung.
Durch die Orchestrierung regulatorischer Aktivitäten über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg stellen Sie die qualitativ hochwertige, konforme und rechtzeitige Lieferung regulatorischer Meilensteine sicher, stärken die Fähigkeit des Visp-Standorts, komplexe Programme auszuführen, und stärken Lonzas Position als bevorzugter Hersteller für hochkomplexe Moleküle, einschließlich Biokonjugationsprojekten.

Was Sie bekommen werden:

• Eine agile Karriere und dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung erkennen

• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen abhängig von Rolle und Standort

Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Vorteile finden Sie auch unter https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

Was Sie tun werden:

Projektleitung und regulatorische Koordination:

• Führen Sie durchgängige regulatorische Aktivitäten für zugewiesene Visp-Clientprogramme.

• Handeln Sie als Projektleiter für Regulierungsangelegenheiten und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Regulierungsstrategie, die Zeitpläne und die Ergebnisse mit den allgemeinen Programmzielen übereinstimmen.

• Koordinieren Sie regulatorische Workstreams über interne Funktionen und globale RA-Netzwerke hinweg und gewährleisten Sie eine nahtlose Ausführung und Transparenz.

• Förderung der Priorisierung, Planung und Nachverfolgung von regulatorischen Leistungen über mehrere gleichzeitige Programme hinweg.

Operational Oversight & Execution

• Gewährleistung einer effizienten Durchführung der täglichen regulatorischen Aktivitäten zur Unterstützung von Kundenprogrammen, einschließlich Einreichungen, Lifecycle-Management und Interaktionen mit Gesundheitsbehörden.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Vorbereitung, Überprüfung und Bereitstellung hochwertiger regulatorischer Dokumentationen (z. B. Dossierinhalte, Antworten auf Anfragen der Gesundheitsbehörde, Briefingpakete).

• Unterstützung von Teams bei der Verwaltung konkurrierender Prioritäten und der zeitnahen Lösung operativer Herausforderungen.

Regulierungsstrategie & Compliance:

• Unterstützen Sie Ihre Kunden mit CMC-Strategien in Übereinstimmung mit globalen Anforderungen und Kundenerwartungen.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle regulatorischen Aktivitäten den geltenden Richtlinien, registrierten Dossiers und Lonza-Verfahren entsprechen.

• Bereitstellung einer behördlichen Bewertung von Änderungen, Abweichungen und Lebenszyklusaktivitäten, um eine Abstimmung mit behördlichen Einreichungen und Strategien sicherzustellen.

• Gewährleistung einer einheitlichen Auslegung und Anwendung der regulatorischen Anforderungen in allen Projekten und Technologien.

• Unterstützung des Lonza Regulatory Information Bulletin.

Customer & Stakeholder Management:

• Handeln Sie als primäre regulatorische Schnittstelle für Kunden zu zugewiesenen Programmen und bieten Sie fachkundige Beratung zu CMC-Regulierungsthemen und -strategien.

• Aufbau und Pflege starker, vertrauensvoller Beziehungen zu Kunden und wichtigen internen Stakeholdern (z. B. MSAT, Qualität, Produktion, Supply Chain).

• Unterstützung von Kundeninteraktionen mit Gesundheitsbehörden, einschließlich Vorbereitung und Teilnahme an Meetings und Antworten.

• Gewährleistung einer klaren, proaktiven Kommunikation der regulatorischen Risiken, Zeitpläne und Ergebnisse für alle Beteiligten.

Continuous Improvement & Regulatory Excellence:

• Beitrag zur Stärkung der regulatorischen Fähigkeiten am Standort Visp, um Skalierbarkeit und Konsistenz zwischen den Programmen zu gewährleisten.

• Unterstützen Sie die Inspektionsbereitschaft und gewährleisten Sie hohe Compliance- und Dokumentationsstandards.

• Erkennen Sie proaktiv Risiken und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten und implementieren Sie Minderungsstrategien, um eine zuverlässige Programmbereitstellung zu gewährleisten.

Was wir suchen:

• Akademischer Abschluss in Chemie, Biochemie, Pharmazie oder einer verwandten wissenschaftlichen Disziplin

• Solide Erfahrung in der Pharma-, Chemie- oder Biotech-Industrie, idealerweise in CDMO-Umgebungen und GMP-regulierter Fertigung und nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Funktionen wie Qualitätskontrolle (QC), Qualitätssicherung (QA), Regulierungsangelegenheiten oder Programm- / Projektmanagement mit starker Exposition gegenüber Fertigungsbetrieben (vorzugsweise kleine Moleküle, Konjugate oder verwandte Technologien)

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, in funktionsübergreifenden, kundenorientierten Umgebungen zu arbeiten, mit einem starken Verständnis dafür, wie Kunden- und Regulierungsanforderungen in die operative Ausführung umgesetzt werden können. Gutes Verständnis von GMP-Vorschriften, Qualitätssystemen und Herstellungsprozessen mit der Fähigkeit, regulatorische Anforderungen pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert anzuwenden

• Erfahrung, die zu regulatorischen Aktivitäten beiträgt oder sie unterstützt (z. B. Einreichungen, Lifecycle-Management, Änderungsbewertungen oder Interaktionen mit Gesundheitsbehörden), ist ein großer Vorteil

• Starke Stakeholder-Management- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv über Funktionen hinweg zusammenzuarbeiten (z. B. QA, QC, MSAT, Produktion, Supply Chain) und vertrauensvoll mit Kunden zu interagieren

• Strukturierter, proaktiver und lösungsorientierter Arbeitsstil mit einem starken Gefühl von Eigenverantwortung und Verantwortlichkeit in einer dynamischen CDMO-Umgebung und der Fähigkeit, Compliance, Kundenerwartungen und operative Machbarkeit in Einklang zu bringen, um eine effiziente und zuverlässige Umsetzung der Programmziele zu gewährleisten

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und Deutsch sind ein Vorteil und Erfahrung mit relevanten Systemen (z.B. TrackWise, LIMS, Documentum, Veeva) ist ein Vorteil.

Die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns ist das nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird.

Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um die Herausforderung und Kreativität zu meistern, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem sinnvollen Unterschied einhergeht.

Lonza ist weltweit führend in der Pharma- und Biotech-Fertigung. Das Unternehmen betreibt große Produktionsstätten in Visp (Valais), Basel, und Stein (Aargau), Schweiz.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Lieu: l'emplacement réel de ce travail est à Viège, Bâle, Suisse. Une aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats admissibles et à leur famille, au besoin. Il s'agit d'un emploi temporaire pour une période d'un an.

En tant que gestionnaire, Affaires réglementaires, à notre site de fabrication à Viège, vous exercez un leadership en matière de réglementation de bout en bout pour les programmes complexes de clients appuyés par le site. Vous êtes responsable de l'élaboration et de l'exécution de stratégies réglementaires solides qui permettent un développement, une fabrication et une commercialisation efficaces.

Vous faites office de conseiller en réglementation fiable auprès des équipes et des clients interfonctionnels, assurant une gestion proactive des risques, l'harmonisation des attentes réglementaires et l'intégration transparente des exigences réglementaires dans l'exécution des projets.
En orchestrant des activités de réglementation à travers les fonctions et les géographies, vous assurez la qualité, la conformité et l'exécution en temps opportun des étapes réglementaires, renforçant la capacité du site de Visp à exécuter des programmes complexes et améliorant la position de Lonzas en tant que fabricant de choix pour les molécules hautement complexes, y compris les projets de bioconjugaison.

Ce que vous obtiendrez :

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé

• Divers avantages dépendent du rôle et de l'emplacement

La liste complète de nos avantages globaux peut également être consultée à l'adresse https://www.lonza.com/careers/ benefits.

Ce que vous ferez :

Leadership du projet et coordination de la réglementation :

• Diriger les activités réglementaires de bout en bout pour les programmes de clients Viège assignés.

• Agir à titre de chef de projet des affaires réglementaires, en assurant l'harmonisation de la stratégie réglementaire, des échéanciers et des produits livrables avec les objectifs généraux du programme.

• Coordonner les flux de travail réglementaires entre les fonctions internes et les réseaux régionaux mondiaux, en assurant une exécution et une transparence transparentes.

• Diriger la hiérarchisation, la planification et le suivi des produits livrables réglementaires dans plusieurs programmes concurrents.

Surveillance et exécution opérationnelles :

• Assurer l'exécution efficace des activités de réglementation quotidiennes à l'appui des programmes des clients, y compris les présentations, la gestion du cycle de vie et les interactions entre les autorités sanitaires.

• Superviser la préparation, l'examen et la livraison de documents réglementaires de haute qualité (p. ex., le contenu des dossiers, les réponses aux questions des autorités sanitaires, les dossiers d'information).

• Aider les équipes à gérer les priorités concurrentes et à relever les défis opérationnels en temps opportun.

Stratégie réglementaire et conformité :

• Soutenir les clients grâce à des stratégies CMC conformes aux exigences mondiales et aux attentes des clients.

• Veiller à ce que toutes les activités réglementaires soient conformes aux lignes directrices applicables, aux dossiers enregistrés et aux procédures Lonza.

• Fournir une évaluation réglementaire des changements, des écarts et des activités liées au cycle de vie, en assurant l'harmonisation avec les dépôts réglementaires et la stratégie.

• Assurer une interprétation et une application cohérentes des exigences réglementaires pour tous les projets et technologies.

• Appuyer le Bulletin d'information réglementaire de Lonza.

Gestion des clients et des intervenants :

• Agir comme interface principale de réglementation pour les clients sur les programmes assignés, en fournissant des conseils d'experts sur les sujets et la stratégie de réglementation du CMC.

• Établir et maintenir des relations solides et fondées sur la confiance avec les clients et les principaux intervenants internes (p. ex. MSAT, qualité, production, chaîne d'approvisionnement).

• Soutenir les interactions des clients avec les autorités sanitaires, y compris la préparation et la participation aux réunions et aux réponses.

• Assurer une communication claire et proactive des risques réglementaires, des échéanciers et des produits livrables à tous les intervenants.

Amélioration continue et excellence en matière de réglementation :

• Contribuer au renforcement des capacités de réglementation sur le site de Visp, en assurant l'évolutivité et la cohérence des programmes.

• Appuyer la préparation à l'inspection, en assurant des normes élevées de conformité et de documentation.

• Déterminer de façon proactive les risques et les possibilités d'amélioration, en mettant en oeuvre des stratégies d'atténuation pour assurer la prestation fiable des programmes.

Ce que nous cherchons:

• Diplôme universitaire en chimie, biochimie, pharmacie ou une discipline scientifique connexe

• Une solide expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, chimique ou biotechnologique, idéalement dans les environnements CDMO et la fabrication réglementée par les BPF et une expérience éprouvée dans des fonctions telles que le contrôle de la qualité (QC), l'assurance de la qualité (QA), les affaires réglementaires ou la gestion de programmes/projets, avec une forte exposition aux opérations de fabrication (de préférence des petites molécules, des conjugués ou des technologies connexes)

• Capacité démontrée de travailler dans des environnements interfonctionnels axés sur le client, avec une bonne compréhension de la façon de traduire les exigences du client et de la réglementation en exécution opérationnelle. Bonne compréhension des règlements sur les BPF, des systèmes de qualité et des procédés de fabrication, avec la capacité d'appliquer les exigences réglementaires de manière pragmatique et axée sur la solution

• L'expérience qui contribue aux activités réglementaires ou les appuie (p. ex. présentations, gestion du cycle de vie, évaluations du changement ou interactions avec les autorités de la santé) est un avantage important.

• De solides compétences en gestion des intervenants et en communication, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement à l'ensemble des fonctions (p. ex. QA, QC, MSAT, Production, chaîne d'approvisionnement) et d'interagir en toute confiance avec les clients

• Un style de travail structuré, proactif et axé sur la solution, avec un fort sentiment d'appropriation et de responsabilité dans un environnement CDMO dynamique et la capacité d'équilibrer la conformité, les attentes des clients et la faisabilité opérationnelle, en assurant l'exécution efficace et fiable des objectifs du programme

• Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et en allemand est un avantage et l'expérience avec les systèmes pertinents (p. ex. TrackWise, LIMS, Documentum, Veeva) est un avantage.

Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès sinon un succès éthique.

Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Lead and inspire a QA Material Management & Supply Chain team, ensuring GMP compliance, supplier quality, and seamless material lifecycle management from sourcing to release. Bring your leadership expertise and strong stakeholder management skills to drive quality excellence, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration in a dynamic pharmaceutical environment. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:
●      An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
●      An inclusive and ethical workplace.
●      Compensation programs that recognize high performance.
In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits
Our local benefits: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

What you will do:

• Lead, develop, and manage the QA Material Management & Supply Chain team across different seniority levels, ensuring performance, capability, and compliance.

• Ensure GMP compliance across the full lifecycle of raw materials and primary packaging materials from sourcing to release.

• Ensure QA oversight for raw material release and warehousing practices. Ensure QA governance of warehouse and logistics processes, including goods receipt, material flow, and master data integrity. Oversee supplier quality management, including supplier qualification, quality agreements, performance monitoring, and supply chain integrity.

• Oversee introduction and lifecycle management of new materials and suppliers, ensuring GMP compliance and cross-functional alignment. Review and approve critical QA documentation, including specifications, SOPs, validation documents, deviations, and changes, where applicable.

• Act as escalation point and decision authority for complex quality issues related to materials, suppliers, and supply chain.

• Support audits and inspections, ensuring readiness across local supplier management, material processes, and logistics.

• Drive continuous improvement, KPI management, and cross-functional collaboration across QA, QC, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing

What we are looking for:

• You are an experienced people leader and you emphasize listening to and coaching your team.

• You have proven experience in building strong relationships – also with difficult stakeholders or stakeholder groups

• Extensive experience in QA in pharmaceutical GMP environment with focus on material management as well as supply chain (warehousing and supplier quality management)

• Academic degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry, or related field

• Fluency in English is a must. Fluency in German is a plus.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è in Stein, AG, Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.

Guidare e ispirare un team di QA Material Management & Supply Chain, assicurando la conformità GMP, la qualità dei fornitori e la gestione del ciclo di vita del materiale senza soluzione di continuità da approvvigionamento a rilascio. Porta le tue competenze di leadership e le forti capacità di gestione degli stakeholder per guidare l'eccellenza della qualità, il miglioramento continuo e la collaborazione interfunzionale in un ambiente farmaceutico dinamico. Scopri il tuo Career in Drug Product Services a Lonza!

Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di medicinali ai massimi standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa otterrai:
● Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.
● Un posto di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.
● Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.
Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero.
L'elenco completo dei nostri benefici globali è disponibile qui: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits
I nostri vantaggi locali: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

Cosa farai:

• Guidare, sviluppare e gestire il team QA Material Management & Supply Chain attraverso diversi livelli di seniority, garantendo prestazioni, capacità e conformità.

• Assicurare la conformità GMP attraverso il ciclo di vita completo di materie prime e materiali di imballaggio primari da approvvigionamento a rilascio.

• Assicurare la supervisione di QA per il rilascio di materie prime e pratiche di stoccaggio. Assicurare la governance di QA dei processi di magazzino e logistica, compresa la ricevuta di merci, il flusso materiale e l'integrità dei dati master. Superare la gestione della qualità dei fornitori, tra cui la qualificazione dei fornitori, accordi di qualità, monitoraggio delle prestazioni e integrità della supply chain.

• Superare l'introduzione e la gestione del ciclo di vita di nuovi materiali e fornitori, assicurando la conformità GMP e l'allineamento trasversale. Rivedere e approvare la documentazione critica del QA, comprese le specifiche, le SOP, i documenti di convalida, le deviazioni e le modifiche, ove applicabile.

• Agire come punto di escalation e autorità di decisione per problemi di qualità complessi relativi a materiali, fornitori e catena di fornitura.

• Supporta audit e ispezioni, assicurando la disponibilità nella gestione dei fornitori locali, nei processi materiali e nella logistica.

• Miglioramento continuo, gestione KPI e collaborazione interfunzionale tra QA, QC, Supply Chain e Manufacturing

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Sei un leader di persone con esperienza e sottolinea l'ascolto e l'allenatore della tua squadra.

• Hai dimostrato esperienza nella costruzione di relazioni forti – anche con parti interessate difficili o gruppi di stakeholder

• Ampia esperienza nel QA in ambiente farmaceutico GMP con focus sulla gestione dei materiali e catena di fornitura (consapevolezza e gestione della qualità dei fornitori)

• Laurea accademica in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Chimica, Biochimica, o campo relativo

• La fluidità in inglese è un must. La fluidità in tedesco è un vantaggio.

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti i background portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.
Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applica ora.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Der tatsächliche Standort dieses Jobs befindet sich in Stein, AG, Schweiz. Umzugshilfe ist für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien zur Verfügung, wenn nötig.

Führen und inspirieren Sie ein QA Material Management & Supply Chain Team, das die GMP-Compliance, Lieferantenqualität und ein nahtloses Materiallebenszyklusmanagement von der Beschaffung bis zur Veröffentlichung sicherstellt. Bringen Sie Ihre Führungskompetenz und Ihre starken Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management ein, um Qualität, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit in einem dynamischen pharmazeutischen Umfeld zu fördern. Schauen Sie sich Ihre Karriere in Drug Product Services bei Lonza!

Dies ist eine vollständig ortsbezogene Rolle. Die persönliche Zusammenarbeit unterstützt eine enge Echtzeit-Zusammenarbeit und die technische Präzision, die erforderlich ist, um Arzneimittel nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards herzustellen.

Was Sie bekommen werden:
Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.
● Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz.
● Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung erkennen.
Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt können Sie zahlreiche Lifestyle-, Familien- und Freizeitvorteile erwarten.
Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Vorteile finden Sie hier: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits
Unsere lokalen Vorteile: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

Was Sie tun werden:

• Führen, entwickeln und verwalten Sie das QA Material Management & Supply Chain-Team auf verschiedenen Führungsebenen und gewährleisten Sie Leistung, Leistungsfähigkeit und Compliance.

• Gewährleistung der GMP-Compliance über den gesamten Lebenszyklus von Rohstoffen und Primärverpackungsmaterialien von der Beschaffung bis zur Veröffentlichung.

• Gewährleistung der QS-Aufsicht über die Freisetzung und Lagerung von Rohstoffen. Gewährleistung der QA-Governance von Lager- und Logistikprozessen, einschließlich Wareneingang, Materialfluss und Integrität der Stammdaten. Beaufsichtigen Sie das Lieferantenqualitätsmanagement, einschließlich Lieferantenqualifizierung, Qualitätsvereinbarungen, Leistungsüberwachung und Integrität der Lieferkette.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Einführung und das Lebenszyklusmanagement neuer Materialien und Lieferanten, um die GMP-Compliance und die funktionsübergreifende Ausrichtung sicherzustellen. Überprüfung und Genehmigung kritischer QS-Dokumentationen, einschließlich Spezifikationen, SOPs, Validierungsdokumente, Abweichungen und Änderungen, soweit zutreffend.

• Handeln Sie als Eskalationspunkt und Entscheidungsinstanz für komplexe Qualitätsfragen in Bezug auf Materialien, Lieferanten und Lieferkette.

• Unterstützen Sie Audits und Inspektionen, um die Bereitschaft für das lokale Lieferantenmanagement, die Materialprozesse und die Logistik sicherzustellen.

• Steigern Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserung, KPI-Management und funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit in QA, QC, Supply Chain und Fertigung

Was wir suchen:

• Sie sind eine erfahrene Führungskraft und legen Wert darauf, Ihrem Team zuzuhören und zu coachen.

• Sie haben nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Aufbau starker Beziehungen – auch mit schwierigen Stakeholdern oder Stakeholdergruppen

• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in QA im pharmazeutischen GMP-Umfeld mit Fokus auf Materialmanagement sowie Supply Chain (Lagerhaltung und Lieferantenqualitätsmanagement)

• Akademischer Abschluss in Pharmazeutischen Wissenschaften, Chemie, Biochemie oder verwandten Bereichen

• Englisch fließend ist ein Muss. Fließend in Deutsch ist ein Plus.

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. Mit mehr als 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams jeden Tag zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Kernwerte Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Alle Ideen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der Sie teilnehmen sollen.
Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen mit allen Hintergründen ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven auf den Tisch bringen. Bei Lonza legen wir Wert auf Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter zu schaffen. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzuwandeln, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.
Bereit, die Zukunft der Biowissenschaften zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben.

Lonza ist weltweit führend in der Pharma- und Biotech-Fertigung. Das Unternehmen betreibt große Produktionsstätten in Visp (Valais), Basel, und Stein (Aargau), Schweiz.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'emplacement réel de ce travail est à Stein, AG, Suisse. Une aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats admissibles et à leur famille, au besoin.

Dirigez et inspirez une équipe de gestion des matériaux et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement de l'AQ, assurant la conformité aux BPF, la qualité des fournisseurs et la gestion transparente du cycle de vie des matériaux, de l'approvisionnement à la mainlevée. Apportez votre expertise en leadership et de solides compétences en gestion des intervenants pour stimuler l'excellence en qualité, l'amélioration continue et la collaboration interfonctionnelle dans un environnement pharmaceutique dynamique. Découvrez votre carrière dans les services de médicaments à Lonza!

C'est un rôle entièrement basé sur le site. Travailler ensemble en personne soutient une collaboration étroite et en temps réel et la précision technique nécessaire pour fabriquer des médicaments répondant aux normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées.

Ce que vous obtiendrez :
● Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.
● Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.
● Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé.
En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreuses prestations de vie de famille et de loisirs.
La liste complète de nos avantages globaux peut être consultée ici: https://www.lonza.com/careers/bénéfices
Nos prestations locales: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

Ce que vous ferez :

• Diriger, développer et gérer l'équipe de gestion du matériel et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement de l'AQ à différents niveaux d'ancienneté, en assurant le rendement, la capacité et la conformité.

• Assurer la conformité aux BPF tout au long du cycle de vie des matières premières et des matériaux d'emballage primaires, depuis l'approvisionnement jusqu'au rejet.

• Assurer la surveillance de l'AQ pour les pratiques de rejet et d'entreposage des matières premières. Assurer la gouvernance de l'AQ des processus d'entreposage et de logistique, y compris la réception des marchandises, la circulation des matières et l'intégrité des données maîtresses. Superviser la gestion de la qualité des fournisseurs, y compris la qualification des fournisseurs, les accords de qualité, la surveillance du rendement et l'intégrité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.

• Superviser l'introduction et la gestion du cycle de vie des nouveaux matériaux et fournisseurs, en assurant la conformité aux BPF et l'alignement interfonctionnel. Examiner et approuver la documentation essentielle sur l'AQ, y compris les spécifications, les SOP, les documents de validation, les écarts et les changements, le cas échéant.

• Agir en tant que point d'escalade et pouvoir de décision pour les questions complexes de qualité liées aux matériaux, aux fournisseurs et à la chaîne d'approvisionnement.

• Appuyer les vérifications et les inspections, en veillant à ce que la gestion des fournisseurs locaux, les processus matériels et la logistique soient prêts.

• Favoriser l'amélioration continue, la gestion de l'ICP et la collaboration interfonctionnelle entre l'AQ, le QC, la chaîne d'approvisionnement et la fabrication

Ce que nous cherchons :

• Vous êtes un leader expérimenté et vous insistez sur l'écoute et l'encadrement de votre équipe.

• Vous avez prouvé votre expérience dans l'établissement de relations solides – aussi avec des intervenants ou des groupes d'intervenants difficiles

• Expérience approfondie en matière d'AQ dans l'environnement des BPF pharmaceutiques, en mettant l'accent sur la gestion des matériaux et la chaîne d'approvisionnement (logement et gestion de la qualité des fournisseurs)

• Diplôme universitaire en sciences pharmaceutiques, chimie, biochimie ou domaine connexe

• La maîtrise de l'anglais est incontournable. La fluidité en allemand est un plus.

À propos de Lonza
À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites répartis sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.
L'innovation prospère lorsque des gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous avons hâte de vous accueillir à bord.
Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

Se necessario, i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie saranno assistiti in movimento.

Per rafforzare il nostro team logistico, siamo alla ricerca di una personalità impegnata e affidabile come Professional Supply Chain - BioLOG G30 (m/f/d).
In questo ruolo, si supporta la logistica amministrativa e operativa nel BioLOG G30 e si occupa di attività di spedizione a temperatura controllata incl. Rispetto di tutte le specifiche GMP/GDP e merci pericolose.

Cosa ti offriamo:

• Una cura Agile e cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

• Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi benefici nelle aree di stile di vita, famiglia e tempo libero. L'elenco completo dei nostri servizi globali è disponibile anche in: Benefits - Visp

I vostri compiti:

• Accettazione degli ordini di spedizione così come la loro ulteriore elaborazione e tempestiva, corretta preparazione di spedizione

• Attuazione dei trasporti a temperatura controllata (per i clienti, 3PL, trasporti interni di fabbrica).

• Utilizzo di sistemi di imballaggio convalidati e monitoraggio dei dati di logger e monitoraggio.

• Documentazione completa di tutti i dati di spedizione e temperatura in conformità con le normative.

• Assicurare il rispetto dei requisiti IATA, ADR e CBTA.

• Partecipazione alla formazione obbligatoria

• Assicurare la conformità a tutti i requisiti GMP/GDP e requisiti normativi.

• Controllo continuo dei processi interni e corretta attuazione delle misure di ottimizzazione trasversali

• Supporto flessibile per team logistici cross-divisionali nella logistica centrale.

Il vostro profilo di requisito:

• Formazione commerciale o logistica completata con certificato federale di abilità.

• Esperienza professionale in un'azienda farmaceutica o in un ambiente logistico regolamentato da GMP.

• Buona conoscenza di GMP/PIL, trasporto merci pericolose (IATA, ADR) e gestione a catena fredda.

• Esperienza pratica con SAP EWM / WM.

• Alta flessibilità, forza di comunicazione, capacità di carico e affidabilità.

• Buone competenze in inglese nelle parole e nella scrittura.

Informazioni su Lonza:

A Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra massima forza. In più di 30 sedi in cinque continenti, i nostri team di rete a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali: collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, ed è quello che vogliamo che tu condividi.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di diversa provenienza portano nelle loro prospettive uniche. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo in un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti a tradurre le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applicare ora

descriptionByLocale.en:
Where necessary, eligible candidates and their families will be assisted in moving.

To strengthen our logistics team, we are looking for a committed and reliable personality as a Supply Chain Professional - BioLOG G30 (m/f/d).
In this role, you support administrative and operational logistics in the BioLOG G30 and take on tasks in temperature-controlled shipping incl. Compliance with all GMP/GDP and hazardous goods specifications.

What we offer you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. The full list of our global services can also be found at: Benefits - Visp

Your tasks:

• Acceptance of shipping orders as well as their further processing and timely, correct dispatch preparation

• Implementation of temperature controlled transports (for customers, 3PL, internal factory transports).

• Use of validated packaging systems and monitoring of logger & monitoring data.

• Complete documentation of all shipping and temperature data in accordance with regulations.

• Ensure compliance with IATA, ADR and CBTA requirements.

• Participation in mandatory training

• Ensure compliance with all GMP/GDP requirements and regulatory requirements.

• Ongoing review of internal processes and ensuring the correct implementation of cross-cutting optimisation measures

• Flexible support for cross-divisional logistics teams in central logistics.

Your requirement profile:

• Completed commercial or logistical training with federal certificate of ability.

• Professional experience in a pharmaceutical company or in a GMP-regulated logistics environment.

• Good knowledge of GMP/GDP, dangerous goods shipping (IATA, ADR) and cold chain handling.

• Practical experience with SAP EWM / WM.

• High flexibility, communication strength, load capacity and reliability.

• Good English skills in words and writing.

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland.

As a member of the MSAT (Manufacturing Science & Technology) Mammalian organization in Visp, you will be part of a dynamic, high-energy environment that fosters collaboration, continuous learning, and an enjoyable team spirit (Mammalian Drug Manufacturing | Lonza).

Duration: 12 months.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

What you'll do:

• Support process validation activities across both Upstream (USP) and Downstream (DSP) operations.

• Assist in drafting, reviewing, and executing process validation protocols, sampling plans, and final reports.

• Collect, organize, and analyze process data to support validation assessments and ensure process robustness and compliance.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., MSAT Process Experts, Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Quality Control) during validation preparation and execution.

• Contribute to the creation and maintenance of GMP-compliant documentation related to process validation activities.

• Support investigations of validation-related deviations and contribute to associated change management processes.

What we are looking for:

• University student (engineering, chemistry, chemical engineering, biotechnology or related field).

• Strong communication and teamwork skills.

• Analytical and structured way of working, with attention to detail

• Good IT skills (Microsoft Office and Microsoft Visio)

• Fluent in English.

• German language skills is a plus.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Visp, in Svizzera.

Come membro dell'organizzazione MSAT (Manufacturing Science & Technology) mammifero di Visp, sarete parte di un ambiente dinamico e ad alta energia che favorisce la collaborazione, l'apprendimento continuo e un piacevole spirito di squadra (Mammalian Drug Manufacturing | Lonza).

Durata: 12 mesi.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

• Una varietà di vantaggi dipende dal ruolo e dalla posizione.

Cosa farai:

• Supporta le attività di validazione del processo in entrambe le operazioni Upstream (USP) e Downstream (DSP).

• Assistere nella redazione, nella revisione e nell'esecuzione dei protocolli di convalida del processo, nei piani di campionamento e nei rapporti finali.

• Raccogliere, organizzare e analizzare i dati di processo per supportare le valutazioni di convalida e garantire la robustezza e la conformità dei processi.

• Collabora con team interfunzionali (ad esempio, esperti di processo MSAT, produzione, assicurazione qualità, controllo qualità) durante la preparazione e l'esecuzione della validazione.

• Contribuisci alla creazione e alla manutenzione della documentazione conforme a GMP relativa alle attività di validazione dei processi.

• Sostenere le indagini sulle deviazioni relative alla validazione e contribuire ai processi di gestione dei cambiamenti associati.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Studente universitario (ingegneria, chimica, ingegneria chimica, biotecnologia o campo correlato).

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e di lavoro di squadra.

• Analitico e strutturato modo di lavorare, con attenzione ai dettagli

• Buone competenze IT (Microsoft Office e Microsoft Visio)

• Fluente in inglese.

• Le competenze linguistiche tedesche sono un vantaggio.

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

The Integrated Biologics R&D Portfolio Lead is responsible for shaping, prioritizing, and advancing the R&D innovation portfolio to accelerate R&D impact and deliver measurable business value. The role operates at the intersection of science, strategy, operations, and commercial value creation, ensuring that investments, resources, and innovation efforts are focused on the opportunities with the highest strategic and financial impact.
Working in a highly matrixed environment, the R&D Portfolio Lead navigates ambiguity, drives alignment without formal authority, and enables innovation delivery from ideation through implementation and value realisation. The role serves as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, combining strong business acumen, advanced stakeholder management, and innovation insights to influence decision-making and portfolio direction.

Key responsibilities:

Portfolio strategy & prioritization

• Translate R&D and business strategy into a balanced portfolio of initiatives, investments, and innovation opportunities

• Establish portfolio prioritization frameworks, governance and process based on strategic fit, value, risk, feasibility, and resource requirements

• Leverage technology trends, competitive intelligence, market insights, and external innovation signals to identify areas where R&D investment should be increased, accelerated, redirected, or reduced, ensuring a robust and future-ready innovation portfolio + network beyond R&D (SM, CD consolidate inputs… -> actionalable)

• Support leadership in making data-driven investment and resource allocation decisions

• Continuously assess portfolio performance and recommend adjustments to maximise value delivery

Innovation insights

• Identify emerging scientific, technological, market, and industry trends that could influence R&D strategy and competitive positioning

• Generate actionable innovation insights through external scouting, benchmarking, competitive intelligence, and collaboration with internal experts

• Translate innovation opportunities into strategic options, business cases, and investment recommendations

• Support development of long-term innovation roadmaps and strategic growth opportunities

Business value & financial acumen

• Build and evaluate business cases, investment proposals, and portfolio recommendations.

• Quantify value creation opportunities, including productivity improvements, cost reduction, revenue growth, risk mitigation, and customer impact.

• Partner with R&D, Finance, Business and Operations stakeholders to assess ROI, financial viability, and strategic trade-offs.

• Establish KPIs and value realization metrics to track outcomes and benefits realization.

Stakeholder management & executive influence

• Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across R&D, Operations, Commercial Development, Finance, and external partners

• Drive alignment among diverse stakeholders with competing priorities and perspectives

• Facilitate executive discussions, strategic workshops, and governance forums

• Influence decision-making through structured problem solving, compelling communication, and evidence-based recommendations

• Act as a translator between scientific, technical, operational, and business communities

Portfolio governance & decision support

• Establish governance processes that improve transparency, accountability, and decision quality

• Develop executive-level portfolio reviews and performance reporting

• Prepare strategic recommendations for leadership teams and governance bodies

• Ensure decisions are supported by robust analysis, insights, and risk assessment

Core competencies
Business acumen

• Strong understanding of business strategy, value creation drivers, and financial performance

• Ability to build and challenge business cases, investment decisions, and portfolio trade-offs

• Deep understanding of how R&D activities translate into commercial and operational value

Advanced stakeholder management

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders without formal authority

• Strong executive presence with outstanding communication and facilitation skills

• Proven ability to align diverse stakeholder groups around common objectives

• Skilled in navigating organizational complexity and competing priorities

Innovation insights & capability building

• Strong strategic thinking and innovation mindset

• Ability to identify emerging trends and convert insights into actionable opportunities

• Experience translating scientific and technical developments into business implications and strategic recommendations

• Drive capability building and foster a culture of innovation and continuous learning across the R&D network

Portfolio & program leadership

• Expertise in portfolio management, prioritization, and governance

• Ability to balance short-term delivery with long-term strategic objectives

• Strong systems thinking and end-to-end perspective

Execution excellence

• Ability to structure complex and ambiguous problems

• Strong analytical and decision-making capabilities

• Results-oriented mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes, delivery excellence and value realization

• Brings structure and clarity to uncertain situations

Qualifications & experience

Education

• Ph.D., Master's degree, or equivalent experience in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Engineering, Business, or related discipline

Experience

• Significant experience in portfolio management, strategy, innovation, consulting, business transformation, or R&D leadership

• Experience in strategic and/or management consulting is highly desirable

• Proven track record of leading complex cross-functional initiatives within matrix organizations

• Demonstrated experience developing business cases, investment strategies, and portfolio recommendations

• Strong understanding of R&D, product development, manufacturing, and commercialization processes

• Experience engaging with senior leadership and facilitating strategic decision-making

• Demonstrated ability to drive outcomes through influence rather than direct authority

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.
People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.
